1.def:
of Hebrew origin; the first letter of the alphabet; figuratively, only
(from its use as a numeral) the first: --Alpha. Often used (usually
an, before a vowel) also in composition (as a contraction from 427) in
the sense of privation; so, in many words, beginning with this letter;
occasionally in the sense of union (as a contraction of 260).

2.def: of Hebrew origin (175); Aaron, the brother of Moses:--Aaron.

3.def: of Hebrew origin (11); a destroying angel:--Abaddon.

4.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 922; weightless, i.e.
(figuratively) not burdensome:--from being burdensome.

5.def: of Chaldee origin (2); father as a vocative:--Abba.

6.def: of Hebrew origin (1893); Abel, the son of Adam:--Abel.

7.def: of Hebrew origin (29); Abijah, the name of two Israelites:--Abia.

8.def: of Hebrew origin (54); Abiathar, an Israelite:--Abiathar.

9.def: of foreign origin (compare 58); Abilene, a region of Syria:--Abilene.

10.def: of Hebrew origin (31); Abihud, an Israelite:--Abiud.

11.def:
of Hebrew origin (85); Abraham, the Hebrew patriarch:--Abraham. (In
Acts 7:16 the text should probably read Jacob.)

12.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a variation of 1037; depthless,
i.e. (specially) (infernal) "abyss":--deep, (bottomless) pit.

13.def: of Hebrew origin (compare 2285); Agabus, an Israelite:--Agabus.

14.def: from 18 and 2041; to work good:--do good.

15.def:
from 17; to be a well-doer (as a favor or a duty):--(when) do good
(well).

17.def: from 18 and 4160; a well-doer, i.e. virtuous:--them that do well.

18.def:
a primary word; "good" (in any sense, often as noun):--benefit,
good(-s, things), well. Compare 2570.

19.def: from 18; goodness, i.e. virtue or beneficence:--goodness.

21.def:
from agan (much) and 242; properly, to jump for joy, i.e. exult:--be
(exceeding) glad, with exceeding joy, rejoice (greatly).

22.def: from 1 (as a negative particle) and 1062; unmarried:--unmarried.

23.def:
from agan (much) and achthos (grief; akin to the base of 43); to be
greatly afflicted, i.e. (figuratively) indignant:--be much (sore)
displeased, have (be moved with, with) indignation.

25.def:
perhaps from agan (much) (or compare 5689); to love (in a social or
moral sense):--(be-)love(-ed). Compare 5368.

26.def:
from 25; love, i.e. affection or benevolence; specially (plural) a
love-feast:--(feast of) charity(-ably), dear, love.

28.def: of Hebrew origin (1904); Hagar, the concubine of Abraham:--Hagar.

29.def:
of foreign origin (compare 104); properly, to be a courier, i.e. (by
implication) to press into public service:--compel (to go).

30.def:
from aggos (a pail, perhaps as bent; compare the base of 43); a
receptacle:--vessel.

31.def: from 32; an announcement, i.e. (by implication) precept:--message.

32.def:
from aggello (probably derived from 71; compare 34) (to bring
tidings); a messenger; especially an "angel"; by implication, a
pastor:--angel, messenger.

35.def:
from 1 (as negative particle) and 1075; unregistered as to
birth:--without descent.

36.def:
from 1 (as negative particle) and 1085; properly, without kin, i.e.
(of unknown descent, and by implication) ignoble:--base things.

37.def:
from 40; to make holy, i.e. (ceremonially) purify or consecrate;
(mentally) to venerate:--hallow, be holy, sanctify.

38.def:
from 37; properly, purification, i.e. (the state) purity; concretely
(by Hebraism) a purifier:--holiness, sanctification.

43.def: from agkos (a bend, "ache"); an arm (as curved):--arm.

44.def: from the same as 43; a hook (as bent):--hook.

45.def: from the same as 43; an "anchor" (as crooked):--anchor.

46.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and the same as 1102; properly,
unfulled, i.e. (by implication) new (cloth):--new.

48.def:
from 53; to make clean, i.e. (figuratively) sanctify (ceremonially or
morally):--purify (self).

49.def:
from 48; a cleansing (the act), i.e. (ceremonially)
lustration:--purification.

50.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 3539; not to know (through lack of
information or intelligence); by implication, to ignore (through
disinclination):--(be) ignorant(-ly), not know, not understand,
unknown.

51.def: from 50; a thing ignored, i.e. shortcoming:--error.

53.def:
from the same as 40; properly, clean, i.e. (figuratively) innocent,
modest, perfect:--chaste, clean, pure.

56.def:
from 1 (as negative particle) and 1108; ignorance (properly, the
state):--ignorance, not the knowledge.

58.def:
from ageiro (to gather; probably akin to 1453); properly, the
town-square (as a place of public resort); by implication, a market or
thoroughfare:--market(-place), street.

59.def:
from 58; properly, to go to market, i.e. (by implication) to purchase;
specially, to redeem:--buy, redeem.

60.def:
from 58; relating to the market-place, i.e. forensic (times); by
implication, vulgar:--baser sort, low.

61.def:
from 71; (abstractly) a catching (of fish); also (concretely) a haul
(of fish):--draught.

62.def:
from 1 (as negative particle) and 1121; unlettered, i.e.
illiterate:--unlearned.

63.def:
from 68 and 832 (in the sense of 833); to camp out:--abide in the
field.

64.def: from 61; to hunt, i.e. (figuratively) to entrap:--catch.

65.def: from 66 and 1636; an oleaster:--olive tree (which is) wild.

66.def:
from 68; wild (as pertaining to the country), literally (natural) or
figuratively (fierce):--wild, raging.

67.def:
apparently from 66 and 2462; wild-horse tamer; Agrippas, one of the
Herods:--Agrippa.

68.def:
from 71; a field (as a drive for cattle); genitive case, the country;
specially, a farm, i.e. hamlet:--country, farm, piece of ground, land.

69.def:
ultimately from 1 (as negative particle) and 5258; to be sleepless,
i.e. keep awake:--watch.

70.def: from 69; sleeplessness, i.e. a keeping awake:--watch.

71.def:
a primary verb; properly, to lead; by implication, to bring, drive,
(reflexively) go, (specially) pass (time), or (figuratively)
induce:--be, bring (forth), carry, (let) go, keep, lead away, be open.

72.def:
reduplicated from 71; a bringing up, i.e. mode of living:--manner of
life.

73.def:
from 71; properly, a place of assembly (as if led), i.e. (by
implication) a contest (held there); figuratively, an effort or
anxiety:--conflict, contention, fight, race.

74.def:
from 73; a struggle (properly, the state), i.e. (figuratively)
anguish:--agony.

75.def:
from 73; to struggle, literally (to compete for a prize), figuratively
(to contend with an adversary), or genitive case (to endeavor to
accomplish something):--fight, labor fervently, strive.

76.def:
of Hebrew origin (121); Adam, the first man; typically (of Jesus) man
(as his representative):--Adam.

77.def:
from 1 (as negative particle); and 1160; costless, i.e.
gratuitous:--without expense.

78.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare 5716); Addi, an Israelite:--Addi.

79.def: fem of 80; a sister (naturally or ecclesiastically):--sister.

80.def:
from 1 (as a connective particle) and delphus (the womb); a brother
(literally or figuratively) near or remote (much like 1):--brother.

81.def:
from 80; brotherhood (properly, the feeling of brotherliness), i.e.
the (Christian) fraternity:--brethren, brotherhood.

82.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 1212; hidden, figuratively,
indistinct:--appear not, uncertain.

85.def:
from a derivative of adeo (to be sated to loathing); to be in distress
(of mind):--be full of heaviness, be very heavy.

86.def:
from 1 (as negative particle) and 1492; properly, unseen, i.e. "Hades"
or the place (state) of departed souls:--grave, hell.

87.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of 1252; properly,
undistinguished, i.e. (actively) impartial:--without partiality.

88.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of 1223
and 3007; unintermitted, i.e. permanent:--without ceasing, continual.

89.def:
adverb from 88; uninterruptedly, i.e. without omission (on an
appropriate occasion):--without ceasing.

91.def:
from 94; to be unjust, i.e. (actively) do wrong (morally, socially or
physically):--hurt, injure, be an offender, be unjust, (do, suffer,
take) wrong.

92.def: from 91; a wrong done:--evil doing, iniquity, matter of wrong.

93.def:
from 94; (legal) injustice (properly, the quality, by implication, the
act); morally, wrongfulness (of character, life or act):--iniquity,
unjust, unrighteousness, wrong.

94.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 1349; unjust; by extension wicked;
by implication, treacherous; specially, heathen:--unjust, unrighteous.

97.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle; and 1388; undeceitful, i.e.
(figuratively) unadulterated:--sincere.

98.def:
from Adramutteion (a place in Asia Minor); Adramyttene or belonging to
Adramyttium:--of Adramyttium.

99.def:
from Adria (a place near its shore); the Adriatic sea (including the
Ionian):--Adria.

101.def: from 102; to be unable, i.e. (passively) impossible:--be impossible.

102.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 1415; unable, i.e. weak (literally
or figuratively); passively, impossible:--could not do, impossible,
impotent, not possible, weak.

105.def: from the same as 109; an eagle (from its wind-like flight):--eagle.

106.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2219; unleavened, i.e.
(figuratively) uncorrupted; (in the neutral plural) specially (by
implication) the Passover week:--unleavened (bread).

107.def: of Hebrew origin (compare 5809); Azor, an Israelite:--Azorigin

108.def:
of Hebrew origin (795); Azotus (i.e. Ashdod), a place in
Palestine:--Azotus.

109.def:
from aemi (to breathe unconsciously, i.e. respire; by analogy, to
blow); "air" (as naturally circumambient):--air. Compare 5594.

110.def:
from a compound of 1 (as a negative particle) and 2288;
deathlessness:--immortality.

112.def: from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2316; godless:--without God.

114.def:
from a compound of 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of
5087; to set aside, i.e. (by implication) to disesteem, neutralize or
violate:--cast off, despise, disannul, frustrate, bring to nought,
reject.

115.def:
from 114; cancellation (literally or figuratively):--disannulling, put
away.

116.def:
plural of Athene (the goddess of wisdom, who was reputed to have
founded the city); Athenoe, the capitol of Greece:-- Athens.

117.def: from 116; an Athenoean or inhabitant of Athenae:--Athenian.

118.def:
from athlos (a contest in the public lists); to contend in the
competitive games:--strive.

120.def:
from a compound of 1 (as a negative particle) and 2372; to be
spiritless, i.e. disheartened:--be dismayed.

121.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and probably a derivative of 5087
(meaning a penalty); not guilty:--innocent.

122.def: from aix (a goat); belonging to a goat:--goat.

123.def:
from aisso (to rush) and 251 (in the sense of the sea; a beach (on
which the waves dash):--shore.

124.def: from 125; an Ægyptian or inhabitant of Ægyptus:--Egyptian.

125.def: of uncertain derivation:--Ægyptus, the land of the Nile:--Egypt.

126.def:
from 104; everduring (forward and backward, or forward
only):--eternal, everlasting.

127.def:
perhaps from 1 (as a negative particle) and 1492 (through the idea of
downcast eyes); bashfulness, i.e. (towards men), modesty or (towards
God) awe:--reverence, shamefacedness.

128.def:
from aitho (to scorch) and ops (the face, from 3700); an Æthiopian (as
a blackamoor):--Ethiopian.

129.def:
of uncertain derivation; blood, literally (of men or animals),
figuratively (the juice of grapes) or specially (the atoning blood of
Christ); by implication, bloodshed, also kindred:--blood.

130.def:
from 129 and a derivative of 1632; an effusion of blood:--shedding of
blood.

131.def:
from 129 and 4482; to flow blood, i.e. have a hoemorrhage:--diseased
with an issue of blood.

132.def: of uncertain derivation; Aeneas, an Israelite:--Aeneas.

133.def:
from 134; a praising (the act), i.e. (specially) a
thank(-offering):--praise.

135.def:
from a derivative of 136 (in its primary sense); an obscure saying
("enigma"), i.e. (abstractly) obscureness:--X darkly.

136.def:
apparently a prime word; properly, a story, but used in the sense of
1868; praise (of God):--praise.

137.def:
of Hebrew origin (a derivative of 5869, place of springs); Ænon, a
place in Palestine:--Ænon.

139.def:
from 138; properly, a choice, i.e. (specially) a party or (abstractly)
disunion:--heresy (which is the Greek word itself), sect.

140.def: from a derivative of 138; to make a choice:--choose.

141.def: from the same as 140; a schismatic:--heretic (the Greek word itself).

142.def:
a primary root; to lift up; by implication, to take up or away;
figuratively, to raise (the voice), keep in suspense (the mind),
specially, to sail away (i.e. weigh anchor); by Hebraism (compare
5375) to expiate sin:--away with, bear (up), carry, lift up, loose,
make to doubt, put away, remove, take (away, up).

143.def:
of uncertain derivation; to apprehend (properly, by the
senses):--perceive.

145.def:
from a derivative of 143; properly, an organ of perception, i.e.
(figuratively) judgment:--senses.

146.def:
from 150 and kerdos (gain); sordid:--given to (greedy of) filthy
lucre.

147.def: adverb from 146; sordidly:--for filthy lucre's sake.

150.def: from the same as 153; shameful, i.e. base (specially, venal):--filthy.

152.def:
from 153; shame or disgrace (abstractly or concretely):--dishonesty,
shame.

153.def:
from aischos (disfigurement, i.e. disgrace); to feel shame (for
oneself):--be ashamed.

154.def:
of uncertain derivation; to ask (in genitive case):--ask, beg, call
for, crave, desire, require. Compare 4441.

155.def:
from 154; a thing asked or (abstractly) an asking:--petition, request,
required.

156.def:
from the same as 154; a cause (as if asked for), i.e. (logical) reason
(motive, matter), (legal) crime (alleged or proved):--accusation,
case, cause, crime, fault, (wh-)ere(-fore).

157.def: from a derivative of 156; a thing charged:--complaint.

158.def: neuter of 159; a reason or crime (like 156):--cause, fault.

159.def: from the same as 154; causative, i.e. (concretely) a causer:--author.

163.def: from 164; to make captive:--lead away captive, bring into captivity.

164.def:
from aichme (a spear) and a derivative of the same as 259; properly, a
prisoner of war, i.e. (genitive case) a captive:--captive.

165.def:
from the same as 104; properly, an age; by extension, perpetuity (also
past); by implication, the world; specially (Jewish) a Messianic
period (present or future):--age, course, eternal, (for) ever(-more),
(n-)ever, (beginning of the , while the) world (began, without end).
Compare 5550.

166.def:
from 165; perpetual (also used of past time, or past and future as
well):--eternal, for ever, everlasting, world (began).

167.def: from 169; impurity (the quality), physically or morally:--uncleanness.

169.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of 2508
(meaning cleansed); impure (ceremonially, morally (lewd) or specially,
(demonic)):--foul, unclean.

170.def:
from a compound of 1 (as a negative particle) and 2540 (meaning
unseasonable); to be inopportune (for oneself), i.e. to fail of a
proper occasion:--lack opportunity.

171.def: adverb from the same as 170; inopportunely:--out of season.

172.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2556; not bad, i.e. (objectively)
innocent or (subjectively) unsuspecting:--harmless, simple.

173.def: probably from the same as 188; a thorn:--thorn.

175.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2590; barren (literally or
figuratively):--without fruit, unfruitful.

176.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of 2607;
unblamable:--that cannot be condemned.

177.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of a compound of 2596
and 2572; unveiled:--uncovered.

178.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of 2632; without
(legal) trial:--uncondemned.

179.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of 2647;
indissoluble, i.e. (figuratively) permanent:--endless.

180.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of 2664;
unrefraining:--that cannot cease.

181.def: from 182; instability, i.e. disorder:--commotion, confusion, tumult.

182.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of 2525;
inconstant:--unstable.

184.def:
of Chaldee origin (meaning field of blood; corresponding to 2506 and
1818); Akeldama, a place near Jerusalem:--Aceldama.

185.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of 2767;
unmixed, i.e. (figuratively) innocent:--harmless, simple.

186.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2827; not leaning, i.e.
(figuratively) firm:--without wavering.

187.def:
from the same as 188; to make a point, i.e. (figuratively) mature:--be
fully ripe.

188.def:
accusative case of a noun ("acme") akin to ake (a point) and meaning
the same; adverbially, just now, i.e. still:--yet.

189.def:
from 191; hearing (the act, the sense or the thing heard):--audience,
ear, fame, which ye heard, hearing, preached, report, rumor.

190.def:
from 1 (as a particle of union) and keleuthos (a road); properly, to
be in the same way with, i.e. to accompany (specially, as a
disciple):--follow, reach.

191.def:
a primary verb; to hear (in various senses):--give (in the) audience
(of), come (to the ears), (shall) hear(-er, -ken), be noised, be
reported, understand.

193.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2904; powerless, i.e. without
self-control:--incontinent.

194.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of 2767;
undiluted:--without mixture.

195.def: from the same as 196; exactness:--perfect manner.

196.def:
superlative of akribes (a derivative of the same as 206); most
exact:--most straitest.

198.def:
from the same as 196; to be exact, i.e. ascertain:--enquire
diligently.

199.def:
adverb from the same as 196; exactly:--circumspectly, diligently,
perfect(-ly).

200.def:
apparently from the same as 206; a locust (as pointed, or as lighting
on the top of vegetation):--locust.

202.def:
from akroaomai (to listen; apparently an intensive of 191); a hearer
(merely):--hearer.

203.def:
from 206 and probably a modified form of posthe (the penis or male
sexual organ); the prepuce; by implication, an uncircumcised (i.e.
gentile, figuratively, unregenerate) state or person:--not
circumcised, uncircumcised (with 2192), uncircumcision.

204.def: from 206 and 1137; belonging to the extreme corner:--chief corner.

205.def:
from 206 and this (a heap); properly (in the plural) the top of the
heap, i.e. (by implication) best of the booty:--spoils.

206.def:
neuter of an adjective probably akin to the base of 188; the
extremity:--one end... other, tip, top, uttermost participle

207.def: probably for Latin aquila (an eagle); Akulas, an Israelite:--Aquila.

208.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2964; to invalidate:--disannul,
make of none effect.

209.def:
adverb from a compound of 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative
of 2967; in an unhindered manner, i.e. freely:--no man forbidding him.

210.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 1635; unwilling:--against the
will.

212.def:
from 213; braggadocio, i.e. (by implication)
self-confidence:--boasting, pride.

214.def:
from alale ( a shout, "halloo"); to vociferate, i.e. (by implication)
to wail; figuratively, to clang:--tinkle, wail.

215.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a derivative of 2980;
unspeakable:--unutterable, which cannot be uttered.

216.def: from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2980; mute:--dumb.

218.def:
from 1 (as particle of union) and the base of 3045; to oil (with
perfume):--anoint.

219.def:
from 220 and 5456; cock-crow, i.e. the third
night-watch:--cockcrowing.

220.def: from aleko (to ward off); a cock or male fowl:--cock.

221.def:
from Alexandreia (the city so called); an Alexandreian or inhabitant
of Alexandria:--of Alexandria, Alexandrian.

222.def:
from the same as 221; Alexandrine, or belonging to Alexandria:--of
Alexandria.

223.def:
from the same as (the first part of) 220 and 435; man-defender;
Alexander, the name of three Israelites and one other man:--Alexander.

225.def: from 227; truth:--true, X truly, truth, verity.

226.def:
from 227; to be true (in doctrine and profession):--speak (tell) the
truth.

227.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 2990; true (as not
concealing):--true, truly, truth.

229.def: from the same as 224; to grind:--grind.

230.def:
adverb from 227; truly:--indeed, surely, of a surety, truly, of a (in)
truth, verily, very.

231.def:
from 251; a sailor (as engaged on the salt water), i.e. (by
implication) a fisher:--fisher(-man).

232.def:
from 231; to be a fisher, i.e. (by implication) to fish:--go
a-fishing.

235.def:
neuter plural of 243; properly, other things, i.e. (adverbially)
contrariwise (in many relations):--and, but (even), howbeit, indeed,
nay, nevertheless, no, notwithstanding, save, therefore, yea, yet.

238.def:
from 243 and agoreo (to harangue (compare 58)); to allegorize:--be an
allegory (the Greek word itself).

239.def:
of Hebrew origin (imperative of 1984 and 3050); praise ye Jah!, an
adoring exclamation:--alleluiah.

240.def:
Genitive plural from 243 reduplicated; one another:--each other,
mutual, one another, (the other), (them-, your-)selves, (selves)
together (sometimes with 3326 or 4314).

241.def: from 243 and 1085; foreign, i.e. not a Jew:--stranger.

242.def:
middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to jump; figuratively, to
gush:--leap, spring up.

244.def:
from 245 and 1985; overseeing others' affairs, i.e. a meddler
(specially, in Gentile customs):--busybody in other men's matters.

245.def:
from 243; another's, i.e. not one's own; by extension foreign, not
akin, hostile:--alien, (an-)other (man's, men's), strange(-r).

246.def:
from 243 and 5443; foreign, i.e. (specially) Gentile:--one of another
nation.

248.def: from the same as 257; to tread out grain:--thresh, tread out the corn.

249.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and 3056; irrational:--brute,
unreasonable.

254.def: of uncertain derivation; a fetter or manacle:--bonds, chain.

255.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and the base of 3081; gainless, i.e.
(by implication) pernicious:--unprofitable.

256.def: of Hebrew origin (compare 2501); Alphoeus, an Israelite:--Alpheus.

257.def:
probably from the base of 1507; a threshing-floor (as rolled hard),
i.e. (figuratively) the grain (and chaff, as just threshed):--floor.

258.def:
of uncertain derivation; a fox, i.e. (figuratively) a cunning
person:--fox.

259.def: from a collateral form of 138; capture, be taken.

260.def:
a primary particle; properly, at the "same" time, but freely used as a
preposition or adverb denoting close association:--also, and,
together, with(-al).

262.def:
from 263; "amaranthine", i.e. (by implication) fadeless:--that fadeth
not away.

263.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a presumed derivative of 3133;
unfading, i.e. (by implication) perpetual:--that fadeth not away.

264.def:
perhaps from 1 (as a negative particle) and the base of 3313;
properly, to miss the mark (and so not share in the prize), i.e.
(figuratively) to err, especially (morally) to sin:--for your faults,
offend, sin, trespass.

267.def:
from 1 (as a negative particle) and a form of 3144;
unattested:--without witness.

268.def: from 264; sinful, i.e. a sinner:--sinful, sinner.

269.def: from 1 (as a negative particle) and 3163; peaceable:--not a brawler.

270.def:
from 260; properly, to collect, i.e. (by implication) reap:--reap
down.

271.def:
