1338.def:
from 1223 and the base of 2425; to reach through, i.e.
penetrate:--pierce.

1339.def:
from 1223 and 2476; to stand apart, i.e. (reflexively) to remove,
intervene:--go further, be parted, after the space of.

1340.def:
from 1223 and a derivative of 2478; to stout it through, i.e.
asservate:--confidently (constantly) affirm.

1341.def: from 1342 and 2920; a just sentence:--righteous judgment.

1342.def:
from 1349; equitable (in character or act); by implication, innocent,
holy (absolutely or relatively):--just, meet, right(-eous).

1343.def:
from 1342; equity (of character or act); specially (Christian)
justification:--righteousness.

1344.def:
from 1342; to render (i.e. show or regard as) just or innocent:--free,
justify(-ier), be righteous.

1345.def:
from 1344; an equitable deed; by implication, a statute or
decision:--judgment, justification, ordinance, righteousness.

1348.def: from a derivative of 1349; a judger:--judge.

1349.def:
probably from 1166; right (as self-evident), i.e. justice (the
principle, a decision, or its execution):--judgment, punish,
vengeance.

1350.def:
probably from a primary verb diko (to cast); a seine (for
fishing):--net.

1351.def:
from 1364 and 3056; equivocal, i.e. telling a different
story:--double-tongued.

1352.def:
from 1223 and 3739; through which thing, i.e. consequently:--for which
cause, therefore, wherefore.

1353.def: from 1223 and 3593; to travel through:--go throughout, pass through.

1354.def: from Dionusos (Bacchus); reveller; Dionysius, an Athenian:--Dionysius.

1355.def: from 1352 and 4007; on which very account:--wherefore.

1356.def:
from the alternate of 2203 and the alternate of 4098; sky-fallen (i.e.
an aerolite):--which fell down from Jupiter.

1357.def:
from a compound of 1223 and a derivative of 3717, meaning to
straighten thoroughly; rectification, i.e. (specially) the Messianic
restauration:--reformation.

1358.def: from 1223 and 3736; to penetrate burglariously:--break through (up).

1359.def:
from the alternate of 2203 and a form of the base of 2877; sons of
Jupiter, i.e. the twins Dioscuri:--Castor and Pollux.

1360.def:
from 1223 and 3754; on the very account that, or inasmuch as:--because
(that), for, therefore.

1361.def:
from the alternate of 2203 and 5142; Jove-nourished; Diotrephes, an
opponent of Christianity:--Diotrephes.

1362.def:
from 1364 and (probably) the base of 4119; two-fold:--double, two-fold
more.

1365.def:
from 1364; properly, to duplicate, i.e. (mentally) to waver (in
opinion):--doubt.

1366.def: from 1364 and 4750; double-edged:--with two edges, two-edged.

1368.def:
from 1223 and hulizo hoo-lid'-zo (to filter); to strain out:--strain
at (probably by misprint).

1369.def:
from a derivative of 1364; to make apart, i.e. sunder (figuratively,
alienate):--set at variance.

1370.def:
from a derivative of 1364 and 4714; disunion, i.e. (figuratively)
dissension:--division, sedition.

1371.def:
from a compound of a derivative of 1364 and a derivative of
temno (to cut); to bisect, i.e. (by extension) to flog
severely:--cut asunder (in sunder).

1372.def:
from a variation of 1373; to thirst for (literally or
figuratively):--(be, be a-)thirst(-y).

1374.def:
from 1364 and 5590; two-spirited, i.e. vacillating (in opinion or
purpose):--double minded.

1377.def:
a prolonged (and causative) form of a primary verb dio (to flee;
compare the base of 1169 and 1249); to pursue (literally or
figuratively); by implication, to persecute:--ensue, follow (after),
given to, (suffer) persecute(-ion), press forward.

1378.def:
from the base of 1380; a law (civil, ceremonial or
ecclesiastical):--decree, ordinance.

1379.def:
from 1378; to prescribe by statute, i.e. (reflexively) to submit to,
ceremonially rule:--be subject to ordinances.

1380.def:
a prolonged form of a primary verb, doko dok'-o (used only in an
alternate in certain tenses; compare the base of 1166) of the same
meaning; to think; by implication, to seem (truthfully or
uncertainly):--be accounted, (of own) please(-ure), be of reputation,
seem (good), suppose, think, trow.

1381.def:
from 1384; to test (literally or figuratively); by implication, to
approve:--allow, discern, examine, X like, (ap-)prove, try.

1382.def:
from the same as 1384; test (abstractly or concretely); by
implication, trustiness:--experience(-riment), proof, trial.

1383.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 1382; a testing; by implication,
trustworthiness:--trial, trying.

1384.def:
from 1380; properly, acceptable (current after assayal), i.e.
approved:--approved, tried.

1385.def: from 1209 (through the idea of holding up); a stick of timber:--beam.

1389.def:
from 1388; to ensnare, i.e. (figuratively) adulterate:--handle
deceitfully.

1390.def: from the base of 1325; a present:--gift.

1391.def:
from the base of 1380; glory (as very apparent), in a wide application
(literal or figurative, objective or subjective):--dignity,
glory(-ious), honour, praise, worship.

1392.def:
from 1391; to render (or esteem) glorious (in a wide
application):--(make) glorify(-ious), full of (have) glory, honour,
magnify.

1394.def:
from the base of 1325; a giving; by implication, (concretely) a
gift:--gift, giving.

1395.def: from the base of 1325; a giver:--giver.

1396.def:
from a presumed compound of 1401 and 71; to be a slave-driver, i.e. to
enslave (figuratively, subdue):--bring into subjection.

1398.def:
from 1401; to be a slave to (literal or figurative, involuntary or
voluntary):--be in bondage, (do) serve(-ice).

1399.def:
feminine of 1401; a female slave (involuntarily or
voluntarily):--handmaid(-en).

1402.def:
from 1401; to enslave (literally or figuratively):--bring into (be
under) bondage, X given, become (make) servant.

1403.def: from 1209; a reception, i.e. convivial entertainment:--feast.

1404.def:
probably from an alternate form of derkomai (to look); a fabulous kind
of serpent (perhaps as supposed to fascinate):--dragon.

1405.def:
perhaps akin to the base of 1404 (through the idea of capturing); to
grasp, i.e. (figuratively) entrap:--take.

1406.def:
from 1405; a drachma or (silver) coin (as handled):--piece (of
silver).

1407.def:
from drepo (to pluck); a gathering hook (especially for
harvesting):--sickle.

1408.def:
from the alternate of 5143; a race, i.e. (figuratively)
career:--course.

1409.def:
a feminine diminutive of Drusus (a Roman name); Drusilla, a member of
the Herodian family:--Drusilla.

1410.def:
of uncertain affinity; to be able or possible:--be able, can (do, +
-not), could, may, might, be possible, be of power.

1411.def:
from 1410; force (literally or figuratively); specially, miraculous
power (usually by implication, a miracle itself):--ability, abundance,
meaning, might(-ily, -y, -y deed), (worker of) miracle(-s), power,
strength, violence, mighty (wonderful) work.

1413.def: from 1410; a ruler or officer:--of great authority, mighty, potentate.

1415.def:
from 1410; powerful or capable (literally or figuratively); neuter
possible:--able, could, (that is) mighty (man), possible, power,
strong.

1416.def:
or dumi doo'-mee

prolonged forms of an obsolete primary
duo doo'-o (to sink)

to go "down":--set.

1419.def: from 1418 and a derivative of 941; oppressive:--grievous to be borne.

1420.def:
from 1418 and a comparative of 1787 (meaning a bowel); a
"dysentery":--bloody flux.

1421.def:
from 1418 and a presumed derivative of 2059; difficult of
explanation:--hard to be uttered.

1422.def:
from 1418 and kolon (food); properly, fastidious about eating
(peevish), i.e. (genitive case) impracticable:--hard.

1424.def:
from 1416; the sun-set, i.e. (by implication) the western
region:--west.

1425.def:
from 1418 and a derivative of 3539; difficult of perception:--hard to
be understood.

1426.def: from a compound of 1418 and 5345; defamation:--evil report.

1427.def: from 1417 and 1176; two and ten, i.e. a dozen:--twelve.

1429.def: from 1427 and 5443; the commonwealth of Israel:--twelve tribes.

1430.def:
from demo (to build); properly, an edifice, i.e. (specially) a
roof:--housetop.

1432.def:
accusative case of 1431 as adverb; gratuitously (literally or
figuratively):--without a cause, freely, for naught, in vain.

1433.def: middle voice from 1435; to bestow gratuitously:--give.

1435.def: a present; specially, a sacrifice:--gift, offering.

1436.def:
apparent imperative of 1439; properly, let it be, i.e. (as
interjection) aha!:--let alone.

1437.def:
from 1487 and 302; a conditional particle; in case that, provided,
etc.; often used in connection with other particles to denote
indefiniteness or uncertainty:--before, but, except, (and) if, (if)
so, (what-, whither-)soever, though, when (-soever), whether (or), to
whom, (who-)so(-ever). See 3361.

1439.def:
of uncertain affinity; to let be, i.e. permit or leave alone:--commit,
leave, let (alone), suffer. See also 1436.

1440.def:
from 1442 and a modified form of 1176; seventy:--seventy, three score
and ten.

1441.def: multiple adverb from 1440; seventy times:--seventy times.

1443.def: of Hebrew origin (5677); Eber, a patriarch:--Eber.

1445.def: from 1443; a Hebræan (i.e. Hebrew) or Jew:--Hebrew.

1446.def:
from 1443; the Hebraistic (Hebrew) or Jewish (Chaldee)
language:--Hebrew.

1447.def:
adverb from 1446; Hebraistically or in the Jewish (Chaldee)
language:--in (the) Hebrew (tongue).

1448.def:
from 1451; to make near, i.e. (reflexively) approach:--approach, be at
hand, come (draw) near, be (come, draw) nigh.

1450.def:
from 1722 and guion (a limb); pledged (as if articulated by a member),
i.e. a bondsman:--surety.

1451.def:
from a primary verb agcho (to squeeze or throttle; akin to the base of
43); near (literally or figuratively, of place or time):--from , at
hand, near, nigh (at hand, unto), ready.

1452.def: neuter of the comparative of 1451; nearer:--nearer.

1453.def:
probably akin to the base of 58 (through the idea of collecting one's
faculties); to waken (transitively or intransitively), i.e. rouse
(literally, from sleep, from sitting or lying, from disease, from
death; or figuratively, from obscurity, inactivity, ruins,
nonexistence):--awake, lift (up), raise (again, up), rear up, (a-)rise
(again, up), stand, take up.

1455.def:
from 1722 and a derivative of 2524; subinduced, i.e. surreptitiously
suborned as a lier-in-wait:--spy.

1456.def:
neuter plural of a presumed compound from 1722 and 2537; innovatives,
i.e. (specially) renewal (of religious services after the Antiochian
interruption):--dedication.

1457.def: from 1456; to renew, i.e. inaugurate:--consecrate, dedicate.

1458.def:
from 1722 and 2564; to call in (as a debt or demand), i.e. bring to
account (charge, criminate, etc.):--accuse, call in question, implead,
lay to the charge.

1459.def:
from 1722 and 2641; to leave behind in some place, i.e. (in a good
sense) let remain over, or (in a bad sense) to desert:--forsake,
leave.

1460.def:
from 1722 and 2730; to settle down in a place, i.e. reside:--dwell
among.

1461.def:
from 1722 and a derivative of 2759; to prick in, i.e. ingraft:--graff
in(-to).

1462.def:
from 1458; an accusation, i.e. offence alleged:--crime laid against,
laid to charge.

1463.def:
middle voice from 1722 and komboo (to gird); to engirdle oneself (for
labor), i.e. figuratively (the apron as being a badge of servitude) to
wear (in token of mutual deference):--be clothed with.

1465.def:
from 1722 and 2875; to cut into, i.e. (figuratively) impede,
detain:--hinder, be tedious unto.

1467.def:
middle voice from 1468; to exercise self-restraint (in diet and
chastity):--can(-not) contain, be temperate.

1468.def:
from 1722 and 2904; strong in a thing (masterful), i.e. (figuratively
and reflexively) self-controlled (in appetite, etc.):--temperate.

1469.def:
from 1722 and 2919; to judge in, i.e. count among:--make of the
number.

1470.def: from 1722 and 2928; to conceal in, i.e. incorporate with:--hid in.

1471.def:
from 1722 and the base of 2949; swelling inside, i.e. pregnant:--great
with child.

1472.def: from 1722 and 5548; to rub in (oil), i.e. besmear:--anoint.

1473.def:
a primary pronoun of the first person I (only expressed when
emphatic):--I, me. For the other cases and the plural see 1691, 1698,
1700, 2248, 2249, 2254, 2257, etc.

1474.def: from 1475; to raze:--lay even with the ground.

1475.def: from the base of 1476; a basis (bottom), i.e. the soil:--ground.

1476.def:
from a derivative of hezomai (to sit); sedentary, i.e. (by
implication) immovable:--settled, stedfast.

1477.def:
from a derivative of 1476; a support, i.e. (figuratively)
basis:--ground.

1478.def:
of Hebrew origin (2396); Ezekias (i.e. Hezekeiah), an
Israelite:--Ezekias.

1479.def:
from 2309 and 2356; voluntary (arbitrary and unwarranted) piety, i.e.
sanctimony:--will worship.

1480.def:
from 1485; to accustom, i.e. (neuter passive participle)
customary:--custom.

1481.def: from 1484 and 746; the governor (not king) of a district:--ethnarch.

1483.def: adverb from 1482; as a Gentile:--after the manner of Gentiles.

1485.def:
from 1486; a usage (prescribed by habit or law):--custom, manner, be
wont.

1486.def:
a primary verb; to be used (by habit or conventionality); neuter
perfect participle usage:--be custom (manner, wont).

1487.def:
a primary particle of conditionality; if, whether, that,
etc.:--forasmuch as, if, that, (al-)though, whether. Often used in
connection or composition with other particles, especially as in 1489,
1490, 1499, 1508, 1509, 1512, 1513, 1536, 1537. See also 1437.

1488.def: second person singular present of 1510; thou art:--art, be.

1489.def:
from 1487 and 1065; if indeed, seeing that, unless, (with negative)
otherwise:--if (so be that, yet).

1490.def:
from 1487, 1161, and 3361 (sometimes with 1065 added); but if
not:--(or) else, if (not, otherwise), otherwise.

1491.def:
from 1492; a view, i.e. form (literally or figuratively):--appearance,
fashion, shape, sight.

1492.def:
a primary verb; used only in certain past tenses, the others being
borrowed from the equivalent 3700 and 3708; properly, to see
(literally or figuratively); by implication, (in the perfect tense
only) to know:--be aware, behold, X can (+ not tell), consider, (have)
know(-ledge), look (on), perceive, see, be sure, tell, understand,
wish, wot. Compare 3700.

1493.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 1497; an image-fane:--idol's
temple.

1494.def:
neuter of a compound of 1497 and a presumed derivative of 2380; an
image-sacrifice, i.e. part of an idolatrous offering:--(meat, thing
that is) offered (in sacrifice, sacrificed) to (unto) idols.

1496.def:
from 1497 and the base of 3000; an image- (servant or) worshipper
(literally or figuratively):--idolater.

1497.def:
from 1491; an image (i.e. for worship); by implication, a heathen god,
or (plural) the worship of such:--idol.

1498.def:
optative (i.e. English subjunctive) present of 1510 (including the
other person); might (could, would, or should) be:--mean, + perish,
should be, was, were.

1499.def: from 1487 and 2532; if also (or even):--if (that), though.

1500.def:
probably from 1502 (through the idea of failure); idly, i.e. without
reason (or effect):--without a cause, (in) vain(-ly).

1502.def:
apparently a primary verb; properly, to be weak, i.e. yield:--give
place.

1503.def:
apparently a primary verb (perhaps akin to 1502 through the idea of
faintness as a copy); to resemble:--be like.

1504.def:
from 1503; a likeness, i.e. (literally) statue, profile, or
(figuratively) representation, resemblance:--image.

1506.def:
from heile (the sun's ray) and 2919; judged by sunlight, i.e. tested
as genuine (figuratively):--pure, sincere.

1507.def:
a prolonged form of a primary but defective verb heilo (of the same
meaning); to coil or wrap:--roll together. See also 1667.

1508.def:
from 1487 and 3361; if not:--but, except (that), if not, more than,
save (only) that, saving, till.

1509.def: from 1508 and the neuter of 5100; if not somewhat:--except.

1510.def:
the first person singular present indicative; a prolonged form of a
primary and defective verb; I exist (used only when emphatic):--am,
have been, X it is I, was. See also 1488, 1498, 1511, 1527, 2258,
2071, 2070, 2075, 2076, 2771, 2468, 5600.

1511.def:
present infinitive from 1510; to exist:--am, was. come, is, X lust
after, X please well, there is, to be, was.

1512.def: from 1487 and 4007; if perhaps:--if so be (that), seeing, though.

1513.def: from 1487 and 4458; if somehow:--if by any means.

1514.def:
from 1515; to be (act) peaceful:--be at (have, live in) peace, live
peaceably.

1515.def:
probably from a primary verb eiro (to join); peace (literally or
figuratively); by implication, prosperity:--one, peace, quietness,
rest, + set at one again.

1517.def:
from 1518; to be a peace-maker, i.e. (figuratively) to
harmonize:--make peace.

1519.def:
a primary preposition; to or into (indicating the point reached or
entered), of place, time, or (figuratively) purpose (result, etc.);
also in adverbial phrases:--(abundant-)ly, against, among, as, at,
(back-)ward, before, by, concerning, + continual, + far more
exceeding, for (intent, purpose), fore,
+ forth, in (among, at, unto, -so much that, -to), to the
intent that, + of one mind, + never, of, (up-)on, + perish, + set at
one again, (so) that, therefore(-unto), throughout, til, to (be, the
end, -ward), (here-)until(-to), ...ward, (where-)fore, with. Often
used in composition with the same general import, but only with verbs
(etc.) expressing motion (literally or figuratively).

1520.def:
(including the neuter (etc.) hen); a primary numeral; one:--a(-n, -ny,
certain), + abundantly, man, one (another), only, other, some. See
also 1527, 3367, 3391, 3762.

1521.def:
from 1519 and 71; to introduce (literally or figuratively):--bring
in(-to), (+ was to) lead into.

1523.def: from 1519 and 1209; to take into one's favor:--receive.

1524.def: from 1519 and eimi (to go); to enter:--enter (go) into.

1525.def:
from 1519 and 2064; to enter (literally or figuratively):--X arise,
come (in, into), enter in(-to), go in (through).

1527.def: from 1520 repeated with 2596 inserted; severally:--one by one.

1528.def: from 1519 and 2564; to invite in:--call in.

1529.def:
from 1519 and 3598; an entrance (literally or figuratively):--coming,
enter(-ing) in (to).

1530.def: from 1519 and pedao (to leap); to rush in:--run (spring) in.

1531.def:
from 1519 and 4198; to enter (literally or figuratively):--come
(enter) in, go into.

1532.def: from 1519 and 5143; to hasten inward:--run in.

1533.def:
from 1519 and 5342; to carry inward (literally or
figuratively):--bring (in), lead into.

1534.def:
of uncertain affinity; a particle of succession (in time or logical
enumeration), then, moreover:--after that(-ward), furthermore, then.
See also 1899.

1535.def: from 1487 and 5037; if too:--if, or, whether.

1536.def:
from 1487 and 5100; if any:--he that, if a(-ny) man('s thing, from
any, ought), whether any, whosoever.

1537.def:
or ex ex

a primary preposition denoting origin (the point whence action or
motion proceeds), from, out (of place, time, or cause; literal or
figurative; direct or remote):--after, among, X are, at,
betwixt(-yond), by (the means of), exceedingly, (+ abundantly above),
for(- th), from (among, forth, up), + grudgingly, + heartily, X
heavenly, X hereby, + very highly, in, ...ly, (because, by reason) of,
off (from), on, out among (from, of), over, since, X thenceforth,
through,
X unto, X vehemently, with(-out). Often used in composition,
with the same general import; often of completion.

1538.def:
as if a superlative of hekas (afar); each or every:--any, both, each
(one), every (man, one, woman), particularly.

1539.def: as if from 1538 and 5119; at every time:--always.

1542.def:
from 1540 and a presumed derivative of 4111; a hundred
times:--hundredfold.

1543.def:
or hekatontarchos hek-at-on'-tar-khos

from 1540 and 757; the captain of one hundred men:--centurion.

1545.def:
from a compound of 1537 and the base of 939 (meaning to go out); an
exit (literally or figuratively):--end, way to escape.

1546.def:
from 1544; ejection, i.e. (specially) a throwing overboard of the
cargo:--+ lighten the ship.

1549.def:
neuter of a derivative of a compound of 1537 and 1096; a descendant,
i.e. (specially) grandchild:--nephew.

1550.def:
from 1537 and 1159; to expend (wholly), i.e. (figuratively)
exhaust:--spend.

1551.def:
from 1537 and 1209; to accept from some source, i.e. (by implication)
to await:--expect, look (tarry) for, wait (for).

1553.def:
from a compound of 1537 and 1218; to emigrate, i.e. (figuratively)
vacate or quit:--be absent.

1554.def:
from 1537 and 1325; to give forth, i.e. (specially) to lease:--let
forth (out).

1555.def:
from 1537 and a compound of 1223 and 2233; to narrate through
wholly:--declare.

1558.def:
from 1537 and 1349; carrying justice out, i.e. a punisher:--a
(re-)venger.

1559.def:
from 1537 and 1377; to pursue out, i.e. expel or persecute
implacably:--persecute.

1560.def:
from 1537 and a derivative of 1325; given out or over, i.e.
surrendered:--delivered.

1562.def:
from 1537 and the base of 1416; to cause to sink out of, i.e.
(specially as of clothing) to divest:--strip, take off from, unclothe.

1563.def:
of uncertain affinity; there; by extension, thither:--there,
thither(-ward), (to) yonder (place).

1564.def: from 1563; thence:--from that place, (from) thence, there.

1565.def:
from 1563; that one (or (neuter) thing); often intensified by the
article prefixed:--he, it, the other (same), selfsame, that (same,
very), X their, X them, they, this, those. See also 3778.

1568.def: from 1569; to astonish utterly:--affright, greatly (sore) amaze.

1570.def:
from 1537 and a derivative of 5087; put out, i.e. exposed to
perish:--cast out.

1573.def:
from 1537 and 2556; to be (bad or) weak, i.e. (by implication) to fail
(in heart):--faint, be weary.

1574.def: from 1537 and the base of 2759; to transfix:--pierce.

1576.def: from 1537 and 2808; to shut out (literally or figuratively):--exclude.

1577.def:
from a compound of 1537 and a derivative of 2564; a calling out, i.e.
(concretely) a popular meeting, especially a religious congregation
(Jewish synagogue, or Christian community of members on earth or
saints in heaven or both):--assembly, church.

1578.def:
from 1537 and 2827; to deviate, i.e. (absolutely) to shun (literally
or figuratively), or (relatively) to decline (from piety):--avoid,
eschew, go out of the way.

1579.def: from 1537 and 2860; to escape by swimming:--swim out.

1580.def: from 1537 and 2865; to bear forth (to burial):--carry out.

1581.def:
from 1537 and 2875; to exscind; figuratively, to frustrate:--cut down
(off, out), hew down, hinder.

1582.def:
middle voice from 1537 and 2910; to hang upon the lips of a speaker,
i.e. listen closely:--be very attentive.

1584.def: from 1537 and 2989; to be resplendent:--shine forth.

1585.def: middle voice from 1537 and 2990; to be utterly oblivious of:--forget.

1586.def:
middle voice from 1537 and 3004 (in its primary sense); to
select:--make choice, choose (out), chosen.

1587.def: from 1537 and 3007; to omit, i.e. (by implication) cease (die):--fail.

1588.def: from 1586; select; by implication, favorite:--chosen, elect.

1590.def: from 1537 and 3089; to relax (literally or figuratively):--faint.

1591.def:
from 1537 and the base of 3145; to knead out, i.e. (by analogy) to
wipe dry:--wipe.

1592.def: from 1537 and 3456; to sneer outright at:--deride.

1593.def:
from 1537 and 3506; (by analogy) to slip off, i.e. quietly
withdraw:--convey self away.

1594.def:
from 1537 and 3525; (figuratively) to rouse (oneself) out of
stupor:--awake.

1595.def: neuter of a derivative from 1635; voluntariness:--willingly.

1596.def: adverb from the same as 1595; voluntarily:--wilfully, willingly.

1597.def:
from 1537 and 3819; long ago, for a long while:--of a long time, of
old.

1600.def:
from 1537 and a form of 4072; to fly out, i.e. (by analogy) to
extend:--stretch forth.

1601.def:
from 1537 and 4098; to drop away; specially, be driven out of one's
course; figuratively, to lose, become inefficient:--be cast, fail,
fall (away, off), take none effect.

1602.def: from 1537 and 4126; to depart by ship:--sail (away, thence).

1605.def: from 1537 and 4141; to strike with astonishment:--amaze, astonish.

1606.def: from 1537 and 4154; to expire:--give up the ghost.

1607.def:
from 1537 and 4198; to depart, be discharged, proceed, project:--come
(forth, out of), depart, go (forth, out), issue, proceed (out of).

whenever, as soon as:--when.

1876.def:
neuter of a presumed compound of 1909 and 318; (adverbially) on
necessity, i.e. necessarily:--necessary.

1877.def:
from 1909 and 321; to lead up on, i.e. (technical) to put out (to
sea); (intransitively) to return:--launch (thrust) out, return.

1878.def: from 1909 and 363; to remind of:--put in mind.

1879.def:
middle voice from 1909 and 373; to settle on; literally (remain) or
figuratively (rely):--rest in (upon).

1880.def: from 1909 and 424; to come up on, i.e. return:--come again, return.

1881.def:
middle voice from 1909 and 450; to stand up on, i.e. (figuratively) to
attack:--rise up against.

1882.def:
from a compound of 1909 and 461; a straightening up again, i.e.
(figuratively) rectification (reformation):-- correction.

1883.def:
from 1909 and 507; up above, i.e. over or on (of place, amount, rank,
etc.):--above, more than, (up-)on, over.

1884.def: from 1909 and 714; to avail for, i.e. help:--relieve.

1886.def:
from 1909 and an equivalent of 833; a hut over the head, i.e. a
dwelling:--habitation.

1887.def:
from 1909 and 839; occurring on the succeeding day, i.e. (2250 being
implied) to-morrow:--day following, morrow, next day (after).

1890.def:
from 1909 and 875; to foam upon, i.e. (figuratively) to exhibit (a
vile passion):--foam out.

1891.def:
from 1909 (in the sense of devoted to) and Aphrodite (Venus);
Epaphroditus, a Christian:--Epaphroditus. Compare 1889.

1892.def:
from 1909 and 1453; to rouse upon, i.e. (figuratively) to excite
against:--raise, stir up.

1893.def:
from 1909 and 1487; thereupon, i.e. since (of time or
cause):--because, else, for that (then, -asmuch as), otherwise, seeing
that, since, when.

1894.def:
from 1893 and 1211; since now, i.e. (of time) when, or (of cause)
whereas:--after that, because, for (that, -asmuch as), seeing, since.

1898.def: from a compound of 1909 and 1521; a superintroduction:--bringing in.

1900.def:
from 1909 and (the accusative case plural neuter of) 1565; upon those
parts of, i.e. on the further side of:--beyond.

1901.def:
middle voice from 1909 and 1614; to stretch (oneself) forward
upon:--reach forth.

1902.def:
middle voice from 1909 and 1746; to invest upon oneself:--be clothed
upon.

1903.def: from 1902; a wrapper, i.e. outer garment:--fisher's coat.

1904.def:
from 1909 and 2064; to supervene, i.e. arrive, occur, impend, attack,
(figuratively) influence:--come (in, upon).

1905.def:
from 1909 and 2065; to ask for, i.e. inquire, seek:--ask (after,
questions), demand, desire, question.

1907.def:
from 1909 and 2192; to hold upon, i.e. (by implication) to retain; (by
extension) to detain; (with implication, of 3563) to pay attention
to:--give (take) heed unto, hold forth, mark, stay.

1908.def:
from a comparative of 1909 and (probably) areia (threats); to insult,
slander:--use despitefully, falsely accuse.

1909.def:
a primary preposition; properly, meaning superimposition (of time,
place, order, etc.), as a relation of distribution (with the genitive
case), i.e. over, upon, etc.; of rest (with the dative case) at, on,
etc.; of direction (with the accusative case) towards, upon,
etc.:--about (the times), above, after, against, among, as long as
(touching), at, beside, X have charge of, (be-, (where-))fore, in (a
place, as much as, the time of, -to), (because) of, (up-)on (behalf
of), over, (by, for) the space of, through(-out), (un-)to(-ward),
with. In compounds it retains essentially the same import, at, upon,
etc. (literally or figuratively).

1911.def:
from 1909 and 906; to throw upon (literal or figurative, transitive or
reflexive; usually with more or less force); specially (with 1438
implied) to reflect; impersonally, to belong to:--beat into, cast
(up-)on, fall, lay (on), put (unto), stretch forth, think on.

1912.def:
from 1909 and 916; to be heavy upon, i.e. (pecuniarily) to be
expensive to; figuratively, to be severe towards:--be chargeable to,
overcharge.

1913.def:
from 1909 and a reduplicated derivative of the base of 939 (compare
307); to cause to mount (an animal):--set on.

1914.def:
from 1909 and 991; to gaze at (with favor, pity or partiality):--look
upon, regard, have respect to.

1917.def:
from a presumed compound of 1909 and 1014; a plan against someone,
i.e. a plot:--laying (lying) in wait.

1918.def:
from 1909 and a derivative of 1062; to form affinity with, i.e.
(specially) in a levirate way:--marry.

1919.def:
from 1909 and 1093; worldly (physically or morally):--earthly, in
earth, terrestrial.

1920.def: from 1909 and 1096; to arrive upon, i.e. spring up (as a wind):--blow.

1921.def:
from 1909 and 1097; to know upon some mark, i.e. recognize; by
implication, to become fully acquainted with, to acknowledge:--(ac-,
have, take)know(-ledge, well), perceive.

1922.def:
from 1921; recognition, i.e. (by implication) full discernment,
acknowledgement:--(ac-)knowledge(-ing, - ment).

1924.def:
from 1909 and 1125; to inscribe (physically or
mentally):--inscription, write in (over, thereon).

1925.def: from 1909 and 1166; to exhibit (physically or mentally):--shew.

1926.def:
from 1909 and 1209; to admit (as a guest or (figuratively)
teacher):--receive.

1927.def:
from a compound of 1909 and 1218; to make oneself at home, i.e. (by
extension) to reside (in a foreign country):--(be) dwelling (which
were) there, stranger.

1928.def:
middle voice from 1909 and 1299; to appoint besides, i.e. supplement
(as a codicil):--add to.

1929.def:
from 1909 and 1325; to give over (by hand or surrender):--deliver
unto, give, let (+ (her drive)), offer.

1930.def:
from 1909 and a derivative of 3717; to straighten further, i.e.
(figuratively) arrange additionally:--set in order.

1931.def: from 1909 and 1416; to set fully (as the sun):--go down.

1932.def:
from 1933; suitableness, i.e. (by implication) equity,
mildness:--clemency, gentleness.

1933.def:
from 1909 and 1503; appropriate, i.e. (by implication) mild:--gentle,
moderation, patient.

1934.def:
from 1909 and 2212; to search (inquire) for; intensively, to demand,
to crave:--desire, enquire, seek (after, for).

1935.def: from 1909 and 2288; doomed to death:--appointed to death.

1936.def: from 2007; an imposition (of hands officially):--laying (putting) on.

1937.def:
from 1909 and 2372; to set the heart upon, i.e. long for (rightfully
or otherwise):--covet, desire, would fain, lust (after).

1939.def:
from 1937; a longing (especially for what is
forbidden):--concupiscence, desire, lust (after).

1940.def: from 1909 and 2523; to seat upon:--set on.

1941.def:
middle voice from 1909 and 2564; to entitle; by implication, to invoke
(for aid, worship, testimony, decision, etc.):--appeal (unto), call
(on, upon), surname.

1943.def: from 1909 and 2572; to conceal, i.e. (figuratively) forgive:--cover.

1944.def:
from 1909 and a derivative of 2672; imprecated, i.e.
execrable:--accursed.

1946.def:
from Epikouros (compare 1947) (a noted philosopher); an Epicurean or
follower of Epicurus:--Epicurean.

1947.def:
from a compound of 1909 and a (prolonged) form of the base of 2877 (in
the sense of servant); assistance:--help.

1949.def:
middle voice from 1909 and 2983; to seize (for help, injury,
attainment, or any other purpose; literally or figuratively):--catch,
lay hold (up-)on, take (by, hold of, on).

1950.def:
middle voice from 1909 and 2990; to lose out of mind; by implication,
to neglect:--(be) forget(-ful of).

1951.def: middle voice from 1909 and 3004; to surname, select:--call, choose.

1952.def:
from 1909 and 3007; to leave upon, i.e. (figuratively) to be
insufficient for:--fail.

1953.def: from a derivative of 1950; negligence:--X forgetful.

1954.def: from 1909 and 3062; left over, i.e. remaining:--rest.

1956.def:
from 1909 and 3089; to solve further, i.e. (figuratively) to explain,
decide:--determine, expound.

1957.def: from 1909 and 3140; to attest further, i.e. corroborate:--testify.

1958.def:
from 1959; carefulness, i.e. kind attention (hospitality):--+ refresh
self.

1959.def:
middle voice from 1909 and the same as 3199; to care for (physically
or otherwise):--take care of.

1960.def: adverb from a derivative of 1959; carefully:--diligently.

1961.def:
from 1909 and 3306; to stay over, i.e. remain (figuratively,
persevere):--abide (in), continue (in), tarry.

1962.def:
from 1909 and 3506; to nod at, i.e. (by implication) to
assent:--consent.

1963.def:
from 1909 and 3563; attention of the mind, i.e. (by implication)
purpose:--thought.

1965.def:
from 1909 and 3727; on oath, i.e. (falsely) a forswearer:--perjured
person.

1966.def:
feminine singular participle of a comparative of 1909 and
heimi (to go); supervening, i.e. (2250 or 3571 being expressed
or implied) the ensuing day or night:--following, next.

1967.def:
perhaps from the same as 1966; tomorrow's; but more probably from 1909
and a derivative of the present participle feminine of 1510; for
subsistence, i.e. needful:--daily.

1968.def:
from 1909 and 4098; to embrace (with affection) or seize (with more or
less violence; literally or figuratively):--fall into (on, upon) lie
on, press upon.

1969.def:
from 1909 and 4141; to chastise, i.e. (with words) to
upbraid:--rebuke.

1971.def:
from 1909 and potheo (to yearn); to dote upon, i.e. intensely crave
possession (lawfully or wrongfully):--(earnestly) desire (greatly),
(greatly) long (after), lust.

1973.def:
from 1909 and a derivative of the latter part of 1971; yearned upon,
i.e. greatly loved:--longed foreign

1975.def: from 1909 and 4198; to journey further, i.e. travel on (reach):--come.

1976.def:
from 1909 and the base of 4476; to stitch upon, i.e. fasten with the
needle:--sew on.

1977.def:
from 1909 and 4496; to throw upon (literally or figuratively):--cast
upon.

1978.def:
from 1909 and some form of the base of 4591; remarkable, i.e.
(figuratively) eminent:--notable, of note.

1979.def:
from a compound of 1909 and a derivative of 4621; a provisioning, i.e.
(concretely) food:--victuals.

1980.def:
middle voice from 1909 and the base of 4649; to inspect, i.e. (by
implication) to select; by extension, to go to see, relieve:--look
out, visit.

1981.def:
from 1909 and 4637; to tent upon, i.e. (figuratively) abide with
:--rest upon.

1982.def:
from 1909 and a derivative of 4639; to cast a shade upon, i.e. (by
analogy) to envelop in a haze of brilliancy; figuratively, to invest
with preternatural influence:--overshadow.

1983.def:
from 1909 and 4648; to oversee; by implication, to beware:--look
diligently, take the oversight.

1985.def:
from 1909 and 4649 (in the sense of 1983); a superintendent, i.e.
Christian officer in genitive case charge of a (or the) church
(literally or figuratively):--bishop, overseer.

1986.def:
from 1909 and 4685; to draw over, i.e. (with 203 implied) efface the
mark of circumcision (by recovering with the foreskin):--become
uncircumcised.

1987.def:
apparently a middle voice of 2186 (with 3563 implied); to put the mind
upon, i.e. comprehend, or be acquainted with:--know, understand.

1988.def:
from 1909 and a presumed derivative of 2476; an appointee over, i.e.
commander (teacher):--master.

1989.def:
from 1909 and 4724; to enjoin (by writing), i.e. (genitive case) to
communicate by letter (for any purpose):--write (a letter, unto).

1991.def:
from 1909 and 4741; to support further, i.e. reestablish:--confirm,
strengthen.

1993.def:
from 1909 and 4750; to put something over the mouth, i.e.
(figuratively) to silence:--stop mouths.

1994.def:
from 1909 and 4762; to revert (literally, figuratively or
morally):--come (go) again, convert, (re-)turn (about, again).

1996.def:
from 1909 and 4863; to collect upon the same place:--gather
(together).

1997.def:
from 1996; a complete collection; especially a Christian meeting (for
worship):--assembling (gathering) together.

1998.def:
from 1909 and 4936; to hasten together upon one place (or a particular
occasion):--come running together.

2000.def:
from a compound of 1909 and sphallo (to trip); figuratively,
insecure:--dangerous.

2001.def:
from 1909 and 2480; to avail further, i.e. (figuratively) insist
stoutly:--be the more fierce.

2002.def:
from 1909 and 4987; to accumulate further, i.e. (figuratively) seek
additionally:--heap.

2003.def:
from 2004; an injunction or decree; by implication,
authoritativeness:--authority, commandment.

2004.def:
from 1909 and 5021; to arrange upon, i.e. order:--charge, command,
injoin.

2006.def:
from epitedes (enough); serviceable, i.e. (by implication)
requisite:--things which are needful.

2007.def:
from 1909 and 5087; to impose (in a friendly or hostile sense):--add
unto, lade, lay upon, put (up) on, set on (up),
+ surname, X wound.

2008.def:
from 1909 and 5091; to tax upon, i.e. censure or admonish; by
implication, forbid:--(straitly) charge, rebuke.

2009.def:
from a compound of 1909 and 5092; properly, esteem, i.e. citizenship;
used (in the sense of 2008) of a penalty:--punishment.

2010.def:
from 1909 and the base of 5157; to turn over (transfer), i.e.
allow:--give leave (liberty, license), let, permit, suffer.

2011.def: from 2010; permission, i.e. (by implication) full power:--commission.

2012.def:
from 1909 and 5158 (in the sense of 2011); a commissioner, i.e.
domestic manager, guardian:--steward, tutor.

2013.def:
from 1909 and 5177; to chance upon, i.e. (by implication) to
attain:--obtain.

2014.def:
from 1909 and 5316; to shine upon, i.e. become (literally) visible or
(figuratively) known:--appear, give light.

2015.def:
from 2016; a manifestation, i.e. (specially) the advent of Christ
(past or future):--appearing, brightness.

2017.def: a form of 2014; to illuminate (figuratively):--give light.

2018.def:
from 1909 and 5342; to bear upon (or further), i.e. adduce (personally
or judicially (accuse, inflict)), superinduce:--add, bring (against),
take.

2019.def:
from 1909 and 5455; to call at something, i.e. exclaim:--cry
(against), give a shout.

2020.def: a form of 2017; to begin to grow light:--begin to dawn, X draw on.

2021.def:
from 1909 and 5495; to put the hand upon, i.e. undertake:--go about,
take in hand (upon).

2022.def: from 1909 and cheo (to pour); --to pour upon:--pour in.

2023.def:
from 1909 and 5524; to furnish besides, i.e. fully supply,
(figuratively) aid or contribute:--add, minister (nourishment, unto).

2026.def:
from 1909 and 3618; to build upon, i.e. (figuratively) to rear
up:--build thereon (thereupon, on, upon).

2027.def:
from 1909 and okello (to urge); to drive upon the shore, i.e. to beach
a vessel:--run aground.

2028.def: from 1909 and 3687; to name further, i.e. denominate:--call.

2029.def: from 1909 and a derivative of 3700; to inspect, i.e. watch:--behold.

2030.def:
from 1909 and a presumed derivative of 3700; a
looker-on:--eye-witness.

2032.def: from 1909 and 3772; above the sky:--celestial, (in) heaven(-ly), high.

2035.def: from 2034 and 5507; seven times a thousand:--seven thousand.
