a primary verb (used only in the definite past tense, the others being
borrowed from 2046, 4483, and 5346); to speak or say (by word or
writing):--answer, bid, bring word, call, command, grant, say (on),
speak, tell. Compare 3004.

2037.def: from erao (to love); beloved; Erastus, a Christian:--Erastus.

2038.def:
middle voice from 2041; to toil (as a task, occupation, etc.), (by
implication) effect, be engaged in or with, etc.:--commit, do, labor
for, minister about, trade (by), work.

2039.def:
from 2040; occupation; by implication, profit, pains:--craft,
diligence, gain, work.

2040.def: from 2041; a toiler; figuratively, a teacher:--labourer, worker(-men).

2041.def:
from a primary (but obsolete) ergo (to work); toil (as an effort or
occupation); by implication, an act:--deed, doing, labour, work.

2042.def:
from a presumed prolonged form of 2054; to stimulate (especially to
anger):--provoke.

2043.def:
of obscure affinity; to prop, i.e. (reflexively) get fast:--stick
fast.

2044.def:
of uncertain affinity; to belch, i.e. (figuratively) to speak
out:--utter.

2045.def:
apparently from 2046 (through the idea of inquiry); to seek, i.e.
(figuratively) to investigate:--search.

2046.def:
probably a fuller form of 4483; an alternate for 2036 in certain
tenses; to utter, i.e. speak or say:--call, say, speak (of), tell.

2048.def:
of uncertain affinity; lonesome, i.e. (by implication) waste (usually
as a noun, 5561 being implied):--desert, desolate, solitary,
wilderness.

2049.def:
from 2048; to lay waste (literally or figuratively):--(bring to, make)
desolate(-ion), come to nought.

2052.def:
perhaps as the same as 2042; properly, intrigue, i.e. (by implication)
faction:--contention(-ious), strife.

2054.def:
of uncertain affinity; a quarrel, i.e. (by implication)
wrangling:--contention, debate, strife, variance.

2055.def:
from 2056; a kidling, i.e. (genitive case) goat (symbolically, wicked
person):--goat.

2056.def:
perhaps from the same as 2053 (through the idea of hairiness); a kid
or (genitive case) goat:--goat, kid.

2059.def:
from a presumed derivative of 2060 (as the god of language); to
translate:--interpret.

2060.def:
perhaps from 2046; Hermes, the name of the messenger of the Greek
deities; also of a Christian:--Hermes, Mercury.

2061.def:
from 2060 and 1096; born of Hermes; Hermogenes, an apostate
Christian:--Hermogenes.

2062.def:
neuter of a derivative of herpo (to creep); a reptile, i.e. (by
Hebraism (compare 7431)) a small animal:--creeping thing, serpent.

2063.def: of uncertain affinity; red, i.e. (with 2281) the Red Sea:--red.

2064.def:
middle voice of a primary verb

(used only in the present and imperfect tenses, the others being
supplied by a kindred (middle voice)

eleuthomai el-yoo'-thom-ahee, or (active)
eltho el'-tho,

which do not otherwise occur)

to come or go (in a great variety of applications, literally and
figuratively):--accompany, appear, bring, come, enter, fall out, go,
grow, X light, X next, pass, resort, be set.

2065.def:
apparently from 2046 (compare 2045); to interrogate; by implication,
to request:--ask, beseech, desire, intreat, pray. Compare 4441.

2066.def: from hennumi (to clothe); dress:--apparel, clothing, raiment, robe.

2068.def:
strengthened for a primary edo (to eat); used only in certain tenses,
the rest being supplied by 5315; to eat (usually literal):--devour,
eat, live.

2069.def: of Hebrew origin (probably for 454); Esli, an Israelite:--Esli.

2070.def:
first person plural indicative of 1510; we are:--are, be, have our
being, X have hope, + (the gospel) was (preached unto) us.

2071.def:
future of 1510; will be:--shall (should) be (have), (shall) come (to
pass), X may have, X fall, what would follow, X live long, X sojourn.

2072.def:
from 1519 and a presumed derivative of 3700; a mirror (for looking
into):--glass. Compare 2734.

2073.def:
feminine of an adjective hesperos (evening); the eve (5610 being
implied):--evening(-tide).

2074.def: of Hebrew origin (2696); Esrom (i.e. Chetsron), an Israelite:--Esrom.

2075.def:
second person plural present indicative of 1510; ye are:--be, have
been, belong.

2076.def:
third person singular present indicative of 1510; he (she or it) is;
also (with neuter plural) they are:--are, be(-long), call, X
can(-not), come, consisteth, X dure for a while, + follow, X have,
(that) is (to say), make, meaneth, X must needs, + profit, +
remaineth, + wrestle.

2079.def:
adverb from 2078; finally, i.e. (with 2192) at the extremity of
life:--point of death.

2081.def:
from 2080; from inside; also used as equivalent to 2080
(inside):--inward(-ly), (from) within, without.

2083.def: from etes (a clansman); a comrade:--fellow, friend.

2084.def:
from 2087 and 1100; other- tongued, i.e. a foreigner:--man of other
tongue.

2085.def:
from 2087 and 1320; to instruct differently:--teach other
doctrine(-wise).

2086.def:
from a compound of 2087 and 2218; to yoke up differently, i.e.
(figuratively) to associate discordantly:--unequally yoke together
with.

2089.def:
perhaps akin to 2094; "yet," still (of time or degree):--after that,
also, ever, (any) further, (t-)henceforth (more), hereafter, (any)
longer, (any) more(-one), now, still, yet.

2090.def: from 2092; to prepare:--prepare, provide, make ready. Compare 2680.

2092.def:
from an old noun heteos (fitness); adjusted, i.e. ready:--prepared,
(made) ready(-iness, to our hand).

2094.def: apparently a primary word; a year:--year.

2095.def:
neuter of a primary eus (good); (adverbially) well:--good, well
(done).

2097.def:
from 2095 and 32; to announce good news ("evangelize") especially the
gospel:--declare, bring (declare, show) glad (good) tidings, preach
(the gospel).

2098.def: from the same as 2097; a good message, i.e. the gospel:--gospel.

2099.def: from 2097; a preacher of the gospel:--evangelist.

2102.def: adverb from 2101; quite agreeably:--acceptably, + please well.

2103.def: from 2095 and 1014; good-willer; Eubulus, a Christian:--Eubulus.

2104.def:
from 2095 and 1096; well born, i.e. (literally) high in rank, or
(figuratively) generous:--more noble, nobleman.

2105.def:
feminine from 2095 and the alternate of 2203 (as the god of the
weather); a clear sky, i.e. fine weather:--fair weather.

2108.def:
from 2110; beneficence (genitive case or specially):--benefit, good
deed done.

2110.def:
from 2095 and the base of 2041; a worker of good, i.e. (specially) a
philanthropist:--benefactor.

2111.def:
from 2095 and a derivative of 5087; well placed, i.e. (figuratively)
appropriate:--fit, meet.

2112.def:
adverb from 2117; directly, i.e. at once or soon:--anon, as soon as,
forthwith, immediately, shortly, straightway.

2113.def:
from 2117 and 1408; to lay a straight course, i.e. sail
direct:--(come) with a straight course.

2114.def:
from 2115; to cheer up, i.e. (intransitively) be cheerful; neuter
comparative (adverbially) more cheerfully:--be of good cheer (merry).

2115.def:
from 2095 and 2372; in fine spirits, i.e. cheerful:--of good cheer,
the more cheerfully.

2116.def:
from 2117; to straighten (level); technically, to steer:--governor,
make straight.

2117.def:
perhaps from 2095 and 5087; straight, i.e. (literally) level, or
(figuratively) true; adverbially (of time) at once:--anon, by and by,
forthwith, immediately, straightway.

2119.def:
from 2121; to have good time, i.e. opportunity or leisure:--have
leisure (convenient time), spend time.

2121.def:
from 2095 and 2540; well-timed, i.e. opportune:--convenient, in time
of need.

2123.def:
comparative of a compound of 2095 and 2873; better for toil, i.e. more
facile:--easier.

2124.def:
from 2126; properly, caution, i.e. (religiously) reverence (piety); by
implication, dread (concretely):--fear(-ed).

2125.def:
middle voice from 2126; to be circumspect, i.e. (by implication) to be
apprehensive; religiously, to reverence:--(moved with) fear.

2126.def:
from 2095 and 2983; taking well (carefully), i.e. circumspect
(religiously, pious):--devout.

2129.def:
from the same as 2127; fine speaking, i.e. elegance of language;
commendation ("eulogy"), i.e. (reverentially) adoration; religiously,
benediction; by implication, consecration; by extension, benefit or
largess:--blessing (a matter of) bounty (X -tifully), fair speech.

2130.def:
from 2095 and a presumed derivative of 3330; good at imparting, i.e.
liberal:--ready to distribute.

2131.def: from 2095 and 3529; victorious; Eunice, a Jewess:--Eunice.

2132.def:
from a compound of 2095 and 3563; to be well- minded, i.e.
reconcile:--agree.

2133.def:
from the same as 2132; kindness; euphemistically, conjugal
duty:--benevolence, good will.

2135.def:
from eune (a bed) and 2192; a castrated person (such being employed in
Oriental bed-chambers); by extension an impotent or unmarried man; by
implication, a chamberlain (state-officer):--eunuch.

2136.def:
from the same as 2137; fine travelling; Euodia, a Christian
woman:--Euodias.

2137.def:
from a compound of 2095 and 3598; to help on the road, i.e.
(passively) succeed in reaching; figuratively, to succeed in business
affairs:--(have a) prosper(-ous journey).

2138.def:
from 2095 and 3982; good for persuasion, i.e. (intransitively)
complaint:--easy to be intreated.

2139.def:
from 2095 and a derivative of a presumed compound of 4012 and 2476;
well standing around, i.e. (a competitor) thwarting (a racer) in every
direction (figuratively, of sin in genitive case):--which doth so
easily beset.

2140.def:
from a compound of 2095 and 4160; well-doing, i.e. beneficence:--to do
good.

2141.def:
from a compound of 2090 and the base of 4197; (intransitively) to be
good for passing through, i.e. (figuratively) have pecuniary
means:--ability.

2142.def: from the same as 2141; pecuniary resources:--wealth.

2143.def:
from a compound of 2095 and 4241; good suitableness, i.e.
gracefulness:--grace.

2144.def:
from 2095 and a derivative of 4327; well-received, i.e. approved,
favorable:--acceptable(-ted).

2146.def:
from a compound of 2095 and 4383; to be of good countenance, i.e.
(figuratively) to make a display:--make a fair show.

2147.def:
heuro hyoo'-ro, which
(together with another cognate form)

heureo hyoo-reh'-o is used for it in all the tenses
except the present and imperfect

to find (literally or figuratively):--find, get, obtain, perceive,
see.

2150.def: from 2152; piety; specially, the gospel scheme:--godliness, holiness.

2151.def:
from 2152; to be pious, i.e. (towards God) to worship, or (towards
parents) to respect (support):--show piety, worship.

2152.def: from 2095 and 4576; well-reverent, i.e. pious:--devout, godly.

2154.def:
from 2095 and the base of 4591; well indicated, i.e. (figuratively)
significant:--easy to be understood.

2155.def:
from 2095 and 4698; well compassioned, i.e. sympathetic:--pitiful,
tender-hearted.

2158.def:
from 2095 and 4976; well-formed, i.e. (figuratively) decorous, noble
(in rank):--comely, honourable.

2160.def:
from a compound of 2095 and a derivative of the base of 5157 (meaning
well-turned, i.e. ready at repartee, jocose); witticism, i.e. (in a
vulgar sense) ribaldry:--jesting.

2161.def:
from 2095 and a derivative of 5177; well- fated, i.e. fortunate;
Eutychus, a young man:--Eutychus.

2162.def:
from 2163; good language ("euphemy"), i.e. praise (repute):--good
report.

2163.def: from 2095 and 5345; well spoken of, i.e. reputable:--of good report.

2164.def:
from 2095 and 5409; to bear well, i.e. be fertile:--bring forth
abundantly.

2165.def:
from 2095 and 5424; to put (middle voice or passively, be) in a good
frame of mind, i.e. rejoice:--fare, make glad, be (make) merry,
rejoice.

2166.def:
of foreign origin (compare 6578); Euphrates, a river of
Asia:--Euphrates.

2167.def: from the same as 2165; joyfulness:--gladness, joy.

2168.def:
from 2170; to be grateful, i.e. (actively) to express gratitude
(towards); specially, to say grace at a meal:--(give) thank(-ful, -s).

2169.def:
from 2170; gratitude; actively, grateful language (to God, as an act
of worship):--thankfulness, (giving of) thanks(-giving).

2170.def:
from 2095 and a derivative of 5483; well favored, i.e. (by
implication) grateful:--thankful.

2171.def:
from 2172; properly, a wish, expressed as a petition to God, or in
votive obligation:--prayer, vow.

2172.def:
middle voice of a primary verb; to wish; by implication, to pray to
God:--pray, will, wish.

2173.def:
from 2095 and 5543; easily used, i.e. useful:--profitable, meet for
use.

2174.def:
from a compound of 2095 and 5590; to be in good spirits, i.e. feel
encouraged:--be of good comfort.

2175.def:
from a compound of 2095 and a derivative of 3605; good-scentedness,
i.e. fragrance:--sweet savour (smell, -smelling).

2176.def:
from 2095 and 3686; properly, well-named (good-omened), i.e. the left
(which was the lucky side among the pagan Greeks); neuter as
adverbial, at the left hand:--(on the) left.

2177.def: from 1909 and 242; to spring upon:--leap on.

2178.def: from 1909 and 530; upon one occasion (only):--(at) once (for all).

2180.def:
from 2181; an Ephesian or inhabitant of Ephesus:--Ephesian, of
Ephesus.

2181.def: probably of foreign origin; Ephesus, a city of Asia Minor:--Ephesus.

2182.def:
from a compound of 1909 and 2147; a discoverer, i.e.
contriver:--inventor.

2183.def:
from 2184; diurnality, i.e. (specially) the quotidian rotation or
class of the Jewish priests' service at the Temple, as distributed by
families:--course.

2184.def: from 1909 and 2250; for a day ("ephemeral"), i.e. diurnal:--daily.

2185.def:
from 1909 and a cognate of 2240; to arrive upon, i.e. extend
to:--reach.

2186.def:
from 1909 and 2476; to stand upon, i.e. be present (in various
applications, friendly or otherwise, usually literal); --assault, come
(in, to, unto, upon), be at hand (instant), present, stand (before,
by, over).

2187.def:
of Hebrew origin (669 or better 6085); Ephraim, a place in
Palestine:--Ephraim.

2189.def:
feminine of 2190; hostility; by implication, a reason for
opposition:--enmity, hatred.

2190.def:
from a primary echtho (to hate); hateful (passively, odious, or
actively, hostile); usually as a noun, an adversary (especially
Satan):--enemy, foe.

2191.def:
of uncertain origin; an adder or other poisonous snake (literally or
figuratively):--viper.

2192.def:
scheo skheh'-o; (used in certain tenses only)

a primary verb; to hold (used in very various applications, literally
or figuratively, direct or remote; such as possession; ability,
contiuity, relation, or condition):--be (able, X hold, possessed
with), accompany, + begin to amend, can(+ -not), X conceive, count,
diseased, do + eat, + enjoy, + fear, following, have, hold, keep, +
lack, + go to law, lie, + must needs, + of necessity, + need, next, +
recover, + reign, + rest, + return, X sick, take for, + tremble, +
uncircumcised, use.

2193.def:
of uncertain affinity; a conjunction, preposition and adverb of
continuance, until (of time and place):--even (until, unto), (as) far
(as), how long, (un-)til(-l), (hither-, un-, up) to, while(-s).

2194.def:
of Hebrew origin (2074); Zabulon (i.e. Zebulon), a region of
Palestine:--Zabulon.

2195.def: of Hebrew origin (compare 2140); Zacchaeus, an Israelite:--Zacchaeus.

2196.def: of Hebrew origin (2226); Zara, (i.e. Zerach), an Israelite:--Zara.

2197.def:
of Hebrew origin (2148); Zacharias (i.e. Zechariah), the name of two
Israelites:--Zacharias.

2198.def:
a primary verb; to live (literally or figuratively):--life(-time),
(a-)live(-ly), quick.

2199.def: of Hebrew origin (compare 2067); Zebedaeus, an Israelite:--Zebedee.

2200.def:
from 2204; boiled, i.e. (by implication) calid (figuratively,
fervent):--hot.

2201.def:
from the same as 2218; a couple, i.e. a team (of oxen yoked together)
or brace (of birds tied together):--yoke, pair.

2202.def:
feminine of a derivative (at the second stage) from the same as 2218;
a fastening (tiller-rope):--band.

2203.def:
of uncertain affinity; in the oblique cases there is used instead of
it a (probably cognate) name

Dis deece, which is otherwise obsolete

Zeus or Dis (among the Latins, Jupiter or Jove), the supreme deity of
the Greeks:--Jupiter.

2204.def:
a primary verb; to be hot (boil, of liquids; or glow, of solids), i.e.
(figuratively) be fervid (earnest):--be fervent.

2205.def:
from 2204; properly, heat, i.e. (figuratively) "zeal" (in a favorable
sense, ardor; in an unfavorable one, jealousy, as of a husband
(figuratively, of God), or an enemy, malice):--emulation, envy(-ing),
fervent mind, indignation, jealousy, zeal.

2206.def:
from 2205; to have warmth of feeling for or against:--affect, covet
(earnestly), (have) desire, (move with) envy, be jealous over, (be)
zealous(-ly affect).

2209.def:
probably akin to the base of 1150 (through the idea of violence);
detriment:--damage, loss.

2210.def:
from 2209; to injure, i.e. (reflexively or passively) to experience
detriment:--be cast away, receive damage, lose, suffer loss.

2211.def:
probably contracted from a poetic form of 2203 and 1435; Jove-given;
Zenas, a Christian:--Zenas.

2212.def:
of uncertain affinity; to seek (literally or figuratively); specially,
(by Hebraism) to worship (God), or (in a bad sense) to plot (against
life):--be (go) about, desire, endeavour, enquire (for), require, (X
will) seek (after, for, means). Compare 4441.

2213.def:
from 2212; a search (properly concretely), i.e. (in words) a
debate:--question.

2214.def:
from 2212; a searching (properly, the act), i.e. a dispute or its
theme:--question.

2215.def: of uncertain origin; darnel or false grain:--tares.

2216.def:
of Hebrew origin (2216); Zorobabel (i.e. Zerubbabel), an
Israelite:--Zorobabel.

2217.def:
akin to the base of 3509; gloom (as shrouding like a
cloud):--blackness, darkness, mist.

2218.def:
from the root of zeugnumi (to join, especially by a "yoke"); a
coupling, i.e. (figuratively) servitude (a law or obligation); also
(literally) the beam of the balance (as connecting the scales):--pair
of balances, yoke.

2219.def: probably from 2204; ferment (as if boiling up):--leaven.

2221.def:
from the same as 2226 and 64; to take alive (make a prisoner of war),
i.e. (figuratively) to capture or ensnare:--take captive, catch.

2223.def:
probably akin to the base of 2218; a belt; by implication, a
pocket:--girdle, purse.

2224.def: from 2223; to bind about (especially with a belt):--gird.

2226.def: neuter of a derivative of 2198; a live thing, i.e. an animal:--beast.

2227.def:
from the same as 2226 and 4160; to (re-)vitalize (literally or
figuratively):--make alive, give life, quicken.

2228.def:
a primary particle of distinction between two connected terms;
disjunctive, or; comparative, than:--and, but (either), (n-)either,
except it be, (n-)or (else), rather, save, than, that, what, yea.
Often used in connection with other particles. Compare especially
2235, 2260, 2273.

2229.def:
an adverb of confirmation; perhaps intensive of 2228; used only (in
the New Testament) before 3303; assuredly:--surely.

2230.def: from 2232; to act as ruler:--be governor.

2231.def: from 2232; government, i.e. (in time) official term:--reign.

2232.def:
from 2233; a leader, i.e. chief person (or figuratively, place) of a
province:--governor, prince, ruler.

2233.def:
middle voice of a (presumed) strengthened form of 71; to lead, i.e.
command (with official authority); figuratively, to deem, i.e.
consider:--account, (be) chief, count, esteem, governor, judge, have
the rule over, suppose, think.

2234.def:
adverb from a derivative of the base of 2237; sweetly, i.e.
(figuratively) with pleasure:--gladly.

2235.def:
apparently from 2228 (or possibly 2229) and 1211; even now:--already,
(even) now (already), by this time.

2236.def:
neuter plural of the superlative of the same as 2234; with great
pleasure:--most (very) gladly.

2237.def:
from handano (to please); sensual delight; by implication,
desire:--lust, pleasure.

2238.def:
neuter of the compound of the same as 2234 and 3744; a sweet-scented
plant, i.e. mint:--mint.

2239.def:
a strengthened form of 1485; usage, i.e. (plural) moral
habits:--manners.

2240.def:
a primary verb; to arrive, i.e. be present (literally or
figuratively):--come.

2241.def: of Hebrew origin (410 with pronominal suffix); my God:-- Eli.

2243.def: of Hebrew origin (452); Helias (i.e. Elijah), an Israelite:--Elias.

2244.def: from the same as 2245; maturity (in years or size):--age, stature.

2245.def:
from helix (a comrade, i.e. one of the same age); as big as, i.e.
(interjectively) how much:--how (what) great.

2246.def:
from hele (a ray; perhaps akin to the alternate of 138); the sun; by
implication, light:--+ east, sun.

2247.def: of uncertain affinity; a stud, i.e. spike:--nail.

2248.def: accusative case plural of 1473; us:--our, us, we.

2249.def:
nominative plural of 1473; we (only used when emphatic):--us, we
(ourselves).

2250.def:
feminine (with 5610 implied) of a derivative of hemai (to sit; akin to
the base of 1476) meaning tame, i.e. gentle; day, i.e. (literally) the
time space between dawn and dark, or the whole 24 hours (but several
days were usually reckoned by the Jews as inclusive of the parts of
both extremes); figuratively, a period (always defined more or less
clearly by the context):--age, + alway, (mid-)day (by day, (-ly)), +
for ever, judgment, (day) time, while, years.

2251.def: from 2349; our:--our, your (by a different reading).

2253.def:
from a presumed compound of the base of 2255 and 2348; half dead, i.e.
entirely exhausted:--half dead.

2254.def:
dative case plural of 1473; to (or for, with, by) us:--our, (for) us,
we.

2255.def:
neuter of a derivative from an inseparable prefix akin to 260 (through
the idea of partition involved in connection) and meaning semi-; (as
noun) half:--half.

2256.def: from the base of 2255 and 5610; a half-hour:--half an hour.

2257.def: genitive case plural of 1473; of (or from) us:--our (company), us, we.

2258.def:
imperfect of 1510; I (thou, etc.) was (wast or were):--+ agree, be, X
have (+ charge of), hold, use, was(-t), were.

2259.def: of uncertain affinity; at which time:--when.

2260.def: from 2228 and 4007; than at all (or than perhaps, than indeed):--than.

2261.def: probably from 2031; properly, affable, i.e. mild or kind:--gentle.

2262.def: of Hebrew origin (6147); Er, an Israelite:--Er.

2263.def:
perhaps by transposition from 2048 (through the idea of stillness);
tranquil:--quiet.

2264.def:
compound of heros (a "hero") and 1491; heroic; Herod, the name of four
Jewish kings:--Herod.

2265.def:
plural of a derivative of 2264; Herodians, i.e. partisans of
Herod:--Herodians.

2266.def: from 2264; Herodias, a woman of the Heodian family:--Herodias.

2268.def:
of Hebrew origin (3470); Hesaias (i.e. Jeshajah), an
Israelite:--Esaias.

2269.def: of Hebrew origin (6215); Esau, an Edomite:--Esau.

2271.def:
feminine of 2272; (as noun) stillness, i.e. desistance from bustle or
language:--quietness, silence.

2272.def:
a prolonged form of a compound probably of a derivative of the base of
1476 and perhaps 2192; properly, keeping one's seat (sedentary), i.e.
(by implication) still (undisturbed, undisturbing):--peaceable, quiet.

2274.def:
from the same as 2276; to make worse, i.e. vanquish (literally or
figuratively); by implication, to rate lower:--be inferior, overcome.

2275.def:
from 2274; a deterioration, i.e. (objectively) failure or
(subjectively) loss:--diminishing, fault.

2276.def:
neuter of comparative of heka (slightly) used for that of 2556; worse
(as noun); by implication, less (as adverb):--less, worse.

2278.def: from 2279; to make a loud noise, i.e. reverberate:--roar, sound.

2279.def:
of uncertain affinity; a loud or confused noise ("echo"), i.e. roar;
figuratively, a rumor:--fame, sound.

2280.def: of uncertain origin; Thaddaeus, one of the Apostles:--Thaddaeus.

2281.def:
probably prolonged from 251; the sea (genitive case or
specially):--sea.

2282.def:
probably akin to thallo (to warm); to brood, i.e. (figuratively) to
foster:--cherish.

2283.def: of Hebrew origin (8559); Thamar (i.e. Tamar), an Israelitess:--Thamar.

2284.def: from 2285; to stupefy (with surprise), i.e. astound:--amaze, astonish.

2285.def:
akin to an obsolete tapho (to dumbfound); stupefaction (by surprise),
i.e. astonishment:--X amazed, + astonished, wonder.

2287.def:
from (the feminine form of) 2288 and 5342; death-bearing, i.e.
fatal:--deadly.

2288.def:
from 2348; (properly, an adjective used as a noun) death (literally or
figuratively):--X deadly, (be...) death.

2289.def:
from 2288 to kill (literally or figuratively):--become dead, (cause to
be) put to death, kill, mortify.

2290.def: a primary verb; to celebrate funeral rites, i.e. inter:--bury.

2291.def:
of Hebrew origin (8646); Thara (i.e. Terach), the father of
Abraham:--Thara.

2292.def:
another form for 2293; to exercise courage:--be bold, X boldly, have
confidence, be confident. Compare 5111.

2293.def: from 2294; to have courage:--be of good cheer (comfort). Compare 2292.

2295.def:
apparently from a form of 2300; wonder (properly concrete; but by
implication, abstract):--admiration.

2296.def:
from 2295; to wonder; by implication, to admire:--admire, have in
admiration, marvel, wonder.

2297.def:
from 2295; wondrous, i.e. (neuter as noun) a miracle:--wonderful
thing.

2298.def:
from 2296; wondered at, i.e. (by implication)
wonderful:--marvel(-lous).

2300.def:
a prolonged form of a primary verb; to look closely at, i.e. (by
implication) perceive (literally or figuratively); by extension to
visit:--behold, look (upon), see. Compare 3700.

2301.def: from 2302; to expose as a spectacle:--make a gazing stock.

2302.def:
from 2300; a place for public show ("theatre"), i.e. general
audience-room; by implication, a show itself
(figuratively):--spectacle, theatre.

2303.def:
probably neuter of 2304 (in its original sense of flashing);
sulphur:--brimstone.

2304.def: from 2316; godlike (neuter as noun, divinity): - divine, godhead.

2307.def:
from the prolonged form of 2309; a determination (properly, the
thing), i.e. (actively) choice (specially, purpose, decree;
abstractly, volition) or (passively) inclination:-- desire, pleasure,
will.

2308.def: from 2309; determination (properly, the act), i.e. option:--will.

2310.def:
from a derivative of 5087; something put down, i.e. a substruction (of
a building, etc.), (literally or figuratively):--foundation.

2311.def:
from 2310; to lay a basis for, i.e. (literally) erect, or
(figuratively) consolidate:--(lay the) found(- ation), ground, settle.

2312.def: from 2316 and 1321; divinely instructed:--taught of God.

2314.def: from 2316 and 3164; an opponent of deity:--to fight against God.

2315.def:
from 2316 and a presumed derivative of 4154; divinely breathed
in:--given by inspiration of God.

2316.def:
of uncertain affinity; a deity, especially (with 3588) the supreme
Divinity; figuratively, a magistrate; by Hebraism, very:--X exceeding,
God, god(-ly, -ward).

2318.def: from 2316 and 4576; reverent of God, i.e. pious:--worshipper of God.

2319.def:
from 2316 and the base of 4767; hateful to God, i.e. impious:--hater
of God.

2321.def:
from 2316 and 5384; friend of God; Theophilus, a
Christian:--Theophilus.

2322.def:
from 2323; attendance (specially, medical, i.e. cure); figuratively
and collectively, domestics:--healing, household.

2323.def:
from the same as 2324; to wait upon menially, i.e. (figuratively) to
adore (God), or (specially) to relieve (of disease):--cure, heal,
worship.

2324.def:
apparently a participle from an otherwise obsolete derivative of the
base of 2330; a menial attendant (as if cherishing):--servant.

2325.def: from 2330 (in the sense of the crop); to harvest:--reap.

2330.def: from a primary thero (to heat); properly, heat, i.e. summer:--summer.

2331.def:
from 2332; a Thessalonican, i.e. inhabitant of
Thessalonice:--Thessalonian.

2332.def:
from Thessalos (a Thessalian) and 3529; Thessalonice, a place in Asia
Minor:--Thessalonica.

2333.def: of uncertain origin; Theudas, an Israelite:--Theudas.

2334.def:
from a derivative of 2300 (perhaps by addition of 3708); to be a
spectator of, i.e. discern, (literally, figuratively (experience) or
intensively (acknowledge)):--behold, consider, look on, perceive, see.
Compare 3700.

2335.def:
from the same as 2334; spectatorship, i.e. (concretely) a
spectacle:--sight.

2337.def:
from thele (the nipple); to suckle, (by implication) to suck:--(give)
suck(-ling).

2338.def: from the same as 2337; female:--female, woman.

2339.def:
from ther (a wild animal, as game); hunting, i.e. (figuratively)
destruction:--trap.

2340.def:
from 2339; to hunt (an animal), i.e. (figuratively) to carp
at:--catch.

2341.def:
from a compound of 2342 and 3164; to be a beast-fighter (in the
gladiatorial show), i.e. (figuratively) to encounter (furious
men):--fight with wild beasts.

2342.def:
diminutive from the same as 2339; a dangerous animal:--(venomous,
wild) beast.

2343.def:
from 2344; to amass or reserve (literally or figuratively):--lay up
(treasure), (keep) in store, (heap) treasure (together, up).

2344.def:
from 5087; a deposit, i.e. wealth (literally or
figuratively):--treasure.

2345.def:
a prolonged form of an obsolete primary thigo (to finger); to
manipulate, i.e. have to do with; by implication, to injure:--handle,
touch.

2346.def:
akin to the base of 5147; to crowd (literally or
figuratively):--afflict, narrow, throng, suffer tribulation, trouble.

2347.def:
from 2346; pressure (literally or figuratively):--afflicted(-tion),
anguish, burdened, persecution, tribulation, trouble.

2348.def:
a strengthened form of a simpler primary thano than'-o (which is used
for it only in certain tenses); to die (literally or
figuratively):--be dead, die.

2350.def:
from 2351; to be in tumult, i.e. disturb, clamor:--make ado (a noise),
trouble self, set on an uproar.

2351.def: from the base of 2360; a disturbance:--tumult, uproar.

2352.def: a primary verb; to crush:--bruise. Compare 4486.

2353.def: from 5142; stock (as raised on a farm):--cattle.

2356.def:
from a derivative of 2357; ceremonial observance:--religion,
worshipping.

2357.def:
probably from the base of 2360; ceremonious in worship (as
demonstrative), i.e. pious:--religious.

2358.def:
from a prolonged compound of the base of 2360; and a derivative of 680
(meaning a noisy iambus, sung in honor of Bacchus); to make an
acclamatory procession, i.e. (figuratively) to conquer or (by
Hebraism) to give victory:--(cause) to triumph (over).

2359.def:
genitive case trichos, etc.; of uncertain derivation; hair:--hair.
Compare 2864.

2360.def:
from threomai to wail; to clamor, i.e. (by implication) to
frighten:--trouble.

2361.def: perhaps from 5142 (in the sense of thickening); a clot:--great drop.

2362.def:
from thrao (to sit); a stately seat ("throne"); by implication, power
or (concretely) a potentate:--seat, throne.

2363.def: of uncertain derivation; Thyatira, a place in Asia Minor:--Thyatira.

2364.def:
apparently a primary word (compare "daughter"); a female child, or (by
Hebraism) descendant (or inhabitant):--daughter.

2366.def: from 2380 (in the sense of blowing) a storm:--tempest.

2367.def:
from a derivative of 2380 (in the sense of blowing; denoting a certain
fragrant tree); made of citron-wood:--thyine.

2368.def:
from 2370; an aroma, i.e. fragrant powder burnt in religious service;
by implication, the burning itself:--incense, odour.

2369.def:
from a derivative of 2370; a place of fumigation, i.e. the alter of
incense (in the Temple):--censer.

2370.def:
from a derivative of 2380 (in the sense of smoking); to fumigate, i.e.
offer aromatic fumes:--burn incense.

2371.def:
from a presumed compound of 2372 and 3164; to be in a furious fight,
i.e. (figuratively) to be exasperated:--be highly displeased.

2372.def:
from 2380; passion (as if breathing hard):--fierceness, indignation,
wrath. Compare 5590.

2373.def: from 2372; to put in a passion, i.e. enrage:--be wroth.

2374.def:
apparently a primary word (compare "door"); a portal or entrance (the
opening or the closure, literally or figuratively):--door, gate.

2377.def:
from 2374 and ouros (a watcher); a gate- warden:--that kept the door,
porter.

2378.def:
from 2380; sacrifice (the act or the victim, literally or
figuratively):--sacrifice.

2379.def:
from a derivative of 2378; a place of sacrifice, i.e. an altar
(special or genitive case, literal or figurative):--altar.

2380.def:
a primary verb; properly, to rush (breathe hard, blow, smoke), i.e.
(by implication) to sacrifice (properly, by fire, but genitive case);
by extension to immolate (slaughter for any purpose):--kill, (do)
sacrifice, slay.

2381.def:
of Chaldee origin (compare 8380); the twin; Thomas, a
Christian:--Thomas.

2382.def:
of uncertain affinity; the chest ("thorax"), i.e. (by implication) a
corslet:--breast-plate.

2383.def: of Hebrew origin (2971); Jairus (i.e. Jair), an Israelite:--Jairus.

2384.def:
of Hebrew origin (3290); Jacob (i.e. Ja`akob), the progenitor of the
Israelites:--also an Israelite:--Jacob.

2385.def:
the same as 2384 Graecized; Jacobus, the name of three
Israelites:--James.

2387.def: of Egyptian origin; Jambres, an Egyptian:--Jambres.

2388.def: probably of Hebrew origin (compare 3238); Janna, an Israelite:--Janna.

2389.def: of Egyptian origin; Jannes, an Egyptian:--Jannes.

2390.def:
middle voice of apparently a primary verb; to cure (literally or
figuratively):--heal, make whole.

2391.def: of Hebrew origin (3382); Jared (i.e. Jered), an antediluvian:--Jared.

2393.def: probably of foreign origin (see 3471); "jasper", a gem:--jasper.

2394.def:
future active participle masculine of 2390; about to cure; Jason, a
Christian:--Jason.

2396.def:
second person singular imperative active of 1492; used as an
interjection to denote surprise; lo!:--behold, lo, see.

2398.def:
of uncertain affinity; pertaining to self, i.e. one's own; by
implication, private or separate:--X his acquaintance, when they were
alone, apart, aside, due, his (own, proper, several), home, (her, our,
thine, your) own (business), private(-ly), proper, severally, their
(own).

2399.def:
from 2398; a private person, i.e. (by implication) an ignoramus
(compare "idiot"):--ignorant, rude, unlearned.

2400.def:
second person singular imperative middle voice of 1492; used as
imperative lo!; --behold, lo, see.

2401.def:
of Hebrew origin (123); Idumaea (i.e. Edom), a region East (and South)
of Palestine:--Idumaea.

2402.def: a strengthened form of a primary idos (sweat): perspiration:--sweat.

2403.def:
of Hebrew origin (348); Jezabel (i.e. Jezebel), a Tyrian woman (used
as a synonym of a termagant or false teacher):--Jezabel.

2404.def:
from 2413 and 4172; holy city; Hierapolis, a place in Asia
Minor:--Hierapolis.

2405.def:
from 2407; priestliness, i.e. the sacerdotal function:--office of the
priesthood, priest's office.

2406.def:
from 2407; the priestly fraternity, i.e. sacerdotal order
(figuratively):--priesthood.

2407.def:
prolongation from 2409; to be a priest, i.e. perform his
functions:--execute the priest's office.

2408.def:
of Hebrew origin (3414); Hieremias (i.e. Jermijah), an
Israelite:--Jeremiah.

2409.def: from 2413; a priest (literally or figuratively):--(high) priest.

2410.def: of Hebrew origin (3405); Jericho, a place in Palestine:--Jericho.

2411.def:
neuter of 2413; a sacred place, i.e. the entire precincts (whereas
3485 denotes the central sanctuary itself) of the Temple (at Jerusalem
or elsewhere):--temple.

2412.def: from 2413 and the same as 4241; reverent:--as becometh holiness.

2414.def:
of Hebrew origin (3389); Hierosolyma (i.e. Jerushalaim, the capitol
of Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare 2419.

2415.def:
from 2414; a Hierosolymite, i.e. inhabitant of Hierosolyma:--of
Jerusalem.

2416.def: from 2417; to be a temple-robber (figuratively):--commit sacrilege.

2417.def: from 2411 and 4813; a temple-despoiler:--robber of churches.

2418.def:
from a compound of 2411 and the base of 2041; to be a temple-worker,
i.e. officiate as a priest (figuratively):--minister.

2419.def:
of Hebrew origin (3389); Hierusalem (i.e. Jerushalem), the capitol of
Palestine:--Jerusalem. Compare 2414.

2420.def:
from 2413; sacredness, i.e. (by implication) the priestly
office:--priesthood.

2421.def: of Hebrew origin (3448); Jessae (i.e. Jishai), an Israelite:--Jesse.

2422.def:
of Hebrew origin (3316); Jephthae (i.e. Jiphtach), an
Israelite:--Jephthah.

2423.def:
of Hebrew origin (3204); Jechonias (i.e. Jekonjah), an
Israelite:--Jechonias.

2424.def:
of Hebrew origin (3091); Jesus (i.e. Jehoshua), the name of our Lord
and two (three) other Israelites:--Jesus.

2425.def:
from hiko (hikano or hikneomai, akin to 2240) (to arrive); competent
(as if coming in season), i.e. ample (in amount) or fit (in
character):--able, + content, enough, good, great, large, long
(while), many, meet, much, security, sore, sufficient, worthy.

2427.def: from 2425; to enable, i.e. qualify:--make able (meet).

2428.def:
from a derivative of the base of 2425 (through the idea of approaching
for a favor); intreaty:--supplication.

2430.def:
perhaps from 1504; image-like; Iconium, a place in Asia
Minor:--Iconium.

2431.def:
from the same as 2436; propitious or merry ("hilarious"), i.e. prompt
or willing:--cheerful.

2433.def:
middle voice from the same as 2436; to conciliate, i.e. (transitively)
to atone for (sin), or (intransitively) be propitious:--be merciful,
make reconciliation for.

2435.def:
neuter of a derivative of 2433; an expiatory (place or thing), i.e.
(concretely) an atoning victim, or (specially) the lid of the Ark (in
the Temple):--mercyseat, propitiation.

2436.def:
perhaps from the alternate form of 138; cheerful (as attractive), i.e.
propitious; adverbially (by Hebraism) God be gracious!, i.e. (in
averting some calamity) far be it:--be it far, merciful.

2437.def:
neuter of an adjective from a name of uncertain derivation: (the)
Illyrican (shore), i.e. (as a name itself) Illyricum, a region of
Europe:--Illyricum.

2438.def:
perhaps from the same as 260; a strap, i.e. (specially) the tie (of a
sandal) or the lash (of a scourge):--latchet, thong.

2440.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of ennumi (to put on); a dress (inner
or outer):--apparel, cloke, clothes, garment, raiment, robe, vesture.

2442.def:
middle voice from himeros (a yearning; of uncertain affinity); to long
for:--be affectionately desirous.

2443.def:
probably from the same as the former part of 1438 (through the
demonstrative idea; compare 3588); in order that (denoting the purpose
or the result):--albeit, because, to the intent (that), lest, so as,
(so) that, (for) to. Compare 3363.

2445.def:
of Hebrew origin (3305); Joppe (i.e. Japho), a place in
Palestine:--Joppa.

2446.def:
of Hebrew origin (3383); the Jordanes (i.e. Jarden), a river of
Palestine:--Jordan.

2447.def:
perhaps from eimi (to go) or hiemi (to send); rust (as if emitted by
metals); also venom (as emitted by serpents):--poison, rust.

2448.def:
of Hebrew origin (3063 or perhaps 3194); Judah (i.e. Jehudah or
Juttah), a part of (or place in) Palestine:--Judah.

2449.def:
feminine of 2453 (with 1093 implied); the Judaean land (i.e. Judaea),
a region of Palestine:--Judaea.

2450.def: from 2453; to become a Judaean, i.e. "Judaize":--live as the Jews.

2451.def: from 2453; Judaic, i.e. resembling a Judaean:--Jewish.

2452.def:
adverb from 2451; Judaically or in a manner resembling a Judaean:--as
do the Jews.

2453.def:
from 2448 (in the sense of 2455 as a country); Judaean, i.e. belonging
to Jehudah:--Jew(-ess), of Judaea.

2454.def:
from 2450; "Judaism", i.e. the Jewish faith and usages:--Jews'
religion.

2455.def:
of Hebrew origin (3063); Judas (i.e. Jehudah), the name of ten
Israelites; also of the posterity of one of them and its
region:--Juda(-h, -s); Jude.

2456.def: feminine of the same as 2457; Julia, a Christian woman:--Julia.

2457.def: of Latin origin; Julius, a centurion:--Julius.

2459.def:
of Latin origin ("just"); Justus, the name of three
Christian:--Justus.

2460.def: from 2462; an equestrian, i.e. member of a cavalry corps:--horseman.

2463.def:
perhaps from 2046 (as a symbol of the female messenger of the pagan
deities); a rainbow ("iris"):--rainbow.

2464.def:
of Hebrew origin (3327); Isaac (i.e. Jitschak), the son of
Abraham:--Isaac.

2465.def: from 2470 and 32; like an angel, i.e. angelic:--equal unto the angels.

2466.def:
of Hebrew origin (3485); Isachar (i.e. Jissaskar), a son of Jacob
(figuratively, his descendant):--Issachar.

2468.def:
second person imperative present of 1510; be thou:--+ agree, be, X
give thyself wholly to.

2470.def:
probably from 1492 (through the idea of seeming); similar (in amount
and kind):--+ agree, as much, equal, like.

2471.def:
likeness (in condition or proportion); by implication,
equity:--equal(-ity).

2472.def: from 2470 and 5092; of equal value or honor:--like precious.

2474.def:
of Hebrew origin (3478); Israel (i.e. Jisrael), the adopted name of
Jacob, including his descendants (literally or figuratively):--Israel.

2475.def:
from 2474; an "Israelite", i.e. descendant of Israel (literally or
figuratively):--Israelite.

2476.def:
a prolonged form of a primary stao stah'-o (of the same meaning, and
used for it in certain tenses); to stand (transitively or
intransitively), used in various applications (literally or
figuratively):--abide, appoint, bring, continue, covenant, establish,
hold up, lay, present, set (up), stanch, stand (by, forth, still, up).
Compare 5087.

2477.def:
from a derivative of 1492; to be knowing (learned), i.e. (by
implication) to visit for information (interview):--see.

2478.def:
from 2479; forcible (literally or figuratively):--boisterous,
mighty(-ier), powerful, strong(-er, man), valiant.

2480.def:
from 2479; to have (or exercise) force (literally or
figuratively):--be able, avail, can do(-not), could, be good, might,
prevail, be of strength, be whole, + much work.

2481.def: adverb from 2470; likely, i.e. perhaps:--it may be.

2482.def: probably of foreign origin; Italia, a region of Europe:--Italy.

2483.def: from 2482; Italic, i.e. belonging to Italia:--Italian.

2484.def:
of Hebrew origin (3195); Ituraea (i.e. Jetur), a region of
Palestine:--Ituraea.

2485.def: diminutive from 2486; a petty fish:--little (small) fish.

2487.def:
from ikneomai (to arrive; compare 2240); a track
(figuratively):--step.

2488.def:
of Hebrew origin (3147); Joatham (i.e. Jotham), an
Israelite:--Joatham.

2489.def: feminine of the same as 2491; Joanna, a Christian:--Joanna.

2490.def: a form of 2491; Joannas, an Israelite:--Joannas.

2491.def:
of Hebrew origin (3110); Joannes (i.e. Jochanan), the name of four
Israelites:--John.

2492.def: of Hebrew origin (347); Job (i.e. Ijob), a patriarch:--Job.

2493.def: of Hebrew origin (3100); Joel, an Israelite:--Joel.

2494.def: probably for 2491 or 2495; Jonan, an Israelite:--Jonan.

2495.def:
of Hebrew origin (3124); Jonas (i.e. Jonah), the name of two
Israelites:--Jonas.

2496.def: of Hebrew origin (3141); Joram, an Israelite:--Joram.

2498.def:
of Hebrew origin (3092); Josaphat (i.e. Jehoshaphat), an
Israelite:--Josaphat.

2499.def: genitive case of 2500; Jose, an Israelite:--Jose.

2500.def:
perhaps for 2501; Joses, the name of two Israelites:--Joses. Compare
2499.

2501.def:
of Hebrew origin (3130); Joseph, the name of seven
Israelites:--Joseph.

2502.def: of Hebrew origin (2977); Josias (i.e. Joshiah), an Israelite:--Josias.

2503.def:
of Hebrew origin (the tenth letter of the Hebrew alphabet); "iota",
the name of the eighth letter of the Greek alphabet, put
(figuratively) for a very small part of anything:--jot.

2504.def:
from 2532 and 1473; so also the dative case

kamoi kam-oy', and accusative case
kame kam-eh'

and (or also, even, etc.) I, (to) me:--(and, even, even so, so) I
(also, in like wise), both me, me also.

2505.def:
from 2596 and the neuter plural of 3739; according to which things,
i.e. just as:--as.

2506.def:
from 2507; demolition; figuratively, extinction:--destruction, pulling
down.

2507.def:
from 2596 and 138 (including its alternate); to lower (or with
violence) demolish (literally or figuratively):--cast (pull, put,
take) down, destroy.

2508.def:
from 2513; to cleanse, i.e. (specially) to prune; figuratively, to
expiate:--purge.

2509.def: from 2505 and 4007; exactly as:--(even, as well) as.

2510.def: from 2596 and 680; to seize upon:--fasten on.

2511.def:
from 2513; to cleanse (literally or figuratively):--(make) clean(-se),
purge, purify.

2512.def:
from 2511; a washing off, i.e. (ceremonially) ablution, (morally)
expiation:--cleansing, + purge, purification(-fying).

2513.def:
of uncertain affinity; clean (literally or figuratively):--clean,
clear, pure.

2515.def:
from 2596 and the same as 1476; a bench (literally or
figuratively):--seat.

2516.def: from 2596 and the base of 1476; to sit down:--sit.

2517.def:
from 2596 and 1836; thereafter, i.e. consecutively; as a noun (by
ellipsis of noun) a subsequent person or time:--after(-ward), by (in)
order.

2518.def:
from 2596 and heudo (to sleep); to lie down to rest, i.e. (by
implication) to fall asleep (literally or figuratively):--(be
a-)sleep.

2519.def:
from a compound of 2596 and 2233; a guide, i.e. (figuratively) a
teacher:--master.

2520.def:
from 2596 and 2240; to reach to, i.e. (neuter of present active
participle, figuratively as adjective) becoming:-- convenient, fit.

2521.def:
from 2596; and hemai (to sit; akin to the base of 1476); to sit down;
figuratively, to remain, reside:--dwell, sit (by, down).

2523.def:
another (active) form for 2516; to seat down, i.e. set (figuratively,
appoint); intransitively, to sit (down); figuratively, to settle
(hover, dwell):--continue, set, sit (down), tarry.

2524.def: from 2596; and hiemi (to send); to lower:--let down.

2526.def:
from 2596 and 3739; according to which thing, i.e. precisely as, in
proportion as:--according to that, (inasmuch) as.

2527.def: from 2596 and 3650; on the whole, i.e. entirely:--at all.

2528.def: from 2596; and 3695; to equip fully with armor:--arm.

2529.def:
from 2596 and 3708; to behold fully, i.e. (figuratively) distinctly
apprehend:--clearly see.

2530.def:
from 2596; and 3739 and 5100; according to which certain thing, i.e.
as far (or inasmuch) as:--(according, forasmuch) as, because (that).

2531.def:
from 2596 and 5613; just (or inasmuch) as, that:--according to,
(according, even) as, how, when.

2532.def:
apparently, a primary particle, having a copulative and sometimes also
a cumulative force; and, also, even, so then, too, etc.; often used in
connection (or composition) with other particles or small words:--and,
also, both, but, even, for, if, or, so, that, then, therefore, when,
yet.

2533.def:
of Chaldee origin; the dell; Caiaphas (i.e. Cajepha), an
Israelite:--Caiaphas.

2535.def: of Hebrew origin (7014); Cain, (i.e. Cajin), the son of Adam:--Cain.

2536.def:
of Hebrew origin (7018); Cainan (i.e. Kenan), the name of two
patriarchs:--Cainan.

2537.def:
of uncertain affinity; new (especially in freshness; while 3501 is
properly so with respect to age:--new.

2539.def:
from 2532 and 4007; and indeed, i.e. nevertheless or
notwithstanding:--and yet, although.

2540.def:
of uncertain affinity; an occasion, i.e. set or proper time:--X
always, opportunity, (convenient, due) season, (due, short, while)
time, a while. Compare 5550.

2541.def: of Latin origin; Caesar, a title of the Roman emperor:--Caesar.

2542.def: from 2541; Caesaria, the name of two places in Palestine:--Caesarea.

2543.def: from 2532 and 5104; and yet, i.e. nevertheless:--although.

2544.def:
from 2543 and 1065; and yet indeed, i.e. although
really:--nevertheless, though.

2545.def:
apparently a primary verb; to set on fire, i.e. kindle or (by
implication) consume:--burn, light.

2546.def:
from 2532 and 1563; likewise in that place:--and there, there
(thither) also.

2547.def:
from 2532 and 1564; likewise from that place (or time):--and afterward
(from) (thence), thence also.

2548.def:
from 2532 and 1565; likewise that (or those):--and him (other, them),
even he, him also, them (also), (and) they.

2550.def:
from a compound of 2556 and 2239; bad character, i.e. (specially)
mischievousness:--malignity.

2551.def: from a compound of 2556 and 3056; to revile:--curse, speak evil of.

2552.def: from a compound of 2256 and 3806; hardship:--suffering affliction.

2553.def:
from the same as 2552; to undergo hardship:--be afflicted, endure
afflictions (hardness), suffer trouble.

2554.def:
from 2555; to be a bad-doer, i.e. (objectively) to injure, or
(genitive) to sin:--do(ing) evil.

2555.def:
from 2556 and 4160; a bad-doer; (specially), a criminal:--evil-doer,
malefactor.

2556.def:
apparently a primary word; worthless (intrinsically, such; whereas
4190 properly refers to effects), i.e. (subjectively) depraved, or
(objectively) injurious:--bad, evil, harm, ill, noisome, wicked.

2557.def:
from 2556 and the base of 2041; a wrong-doer, i.e.
criminal:--evil-doer, malefactor.

2558.def:
from a presumed compound of 2556 and 2192; to maltreat:--which suffer
adversity, torment.

2559.def:
from 2556; to injure; figuratively, to exasperate:--make evil
affected, entreat evil, harm, hurt, vex.

2560.def:
from 2556; badly (physically or morally):--amiss, diseased, evil,
grievously, miserably, sick, sore.

2562.def:
feminine of 2563; a stalk of grain, i.e. (collectively)
stubble:--stubble.

2563.def:
or uncertain affinity; a reed (the plant or its stem, or that of a
similar plant); by implication, a pen:--pen, reed.

2564.def:
akin to the base of 2753; to "call" (properly, aloud, but used in a
variety of applications, directly or otherwise):--bid, call (forth),
(whose, whose sur-)name (was (called)).

2565.def:
from the base of 2566 and 1636; a cultivated olive tree, i.e. a
domesticated or improved one:--good olive tree.

2566.def:
neuter of the (irregular) comparative of 2570; (adverbially) better
than many:--very well.

2567.def: from 2570 and 1320; a teacher of the right:--teacher of good things.

2568.def:
plural of 2570 and 3040; Good Harbors, i.e. Fairhaven, a bay of
Crete:--fair havens.

2569.def: from 2570 and 4160; to do well, i.e. live virtuously:--well doing.

2570.def:
of uncertain affinity; properly, beautiful, but chiefly (figuratively)
good (literally or morally), i.e. valuable or virtuous (for appearance
or use, and thus distinguished from 18, which is properly
intrinsic):--X better, fair, good(-ly), honest, meet, well, worthy.

2572.def:
akin to 2813 and 2928; to cover up (literally or
figuratively):--cover, hide.

2573.def:
adverb from 2570; well (usually morally):--(in a) good (place),
honestly, + recover, (full) well.

2576.def:
from a compound of 2596 and the base of 3466; to shut down, i.e. close
the eyes:--close.

2577.def:
apparently a primary verb; properly, to toil, i.e. (by implication) to
tire (figuratively, faint, sicken):--faint, sick, be wearied.

2578.def: apparently a primary verb; to bend:--bow.

2579.def:
from 2532 and 1437; and (or even) if:--and (also) if (so much as), if
but, at the least, though, yet.

2580.def: of Hebrew origin (compare 7071); Cana, a place in Palestine:--Cana.

2582.def: of foreign origin:--Candace, an Egyptian queen:--Candace.

2583.def:
from kane (a straight reed, i.e. rod); a rule ("canon"), i.e.
(figuratively) a standard (of faith and practice); by implication, a
boundary, i.e. (figuratively) a sphere (of activity):--line, rule.

2584.def:
of Hebrew origin (probably 3723 and 5151); Capernaum (i.e.
Caphanachum), a place in Palestine:--Capernaum.

2585.def:
from kapelos (a huckster); to retail, i.e. (by implication) to
adulterate (figuratively):--corrupt.

2587.def: of foreign origin; Cappadocia, a region of Asia Minor:--Cappadocia.

2588.def:
prolonged from a primary kar (Latin cor, "heart"); the heart, i.e.
(figuratively) the thoughts or feelings (mind); also (by analogy) the
middle:--(+ broken-)heart(-ed).

2589.def: from 2588 and 1097; a heart-knower:--which knowest the hearts.

2590.def:
probably from the base of 726; fruit (as plucked), literally or
figuratively:--fruit.

2591.def: perhaps for 2590; Carpus, probably a Christian:--Carpus.

2592.def:
from 2593; to be fertile (literally or figuratively):--be (bear, bring
forth) fruit(-ful).

2594.def:
from a derivative of 2904 (transposed); to be strong, i.e.
(figuratively) steadfast (patient):--endure.

2595.def: from karpho (to wither); a dry twig or straw:--mote.

2596.def:
a primary particle; (prepositionally) down (in place or time), in
varied relations (according to the case (genitive, dative or
accusative) with which it is joined):--about, according as (to),
after, against, (when they were) X alone, among, and, X apart, (even,
like) as (concerning, pertaining to touching), X aside, at, before,
beyond, by, to the charge of, (charita-)bly, concerning, + covered,
(dai-)ly, down, every, (+ far more) exceeding, X more excellent, for,
from ... to, godly, in(-asmuch, divers, every, -to, respect of), ...
by, after the manner of, + by any means, beyond (out of) measure, X
mightily, more, X natural, of (up-)on (X part), out (of every), over
against, (+ your) X own, + particularly, so, through(-oughout,
-oughout every), thus, (un-)to(-gether, -ward), X uttermost,
where(-by), with. In composition it retains many of these
applications, and frequently denotes opposition, distribution, or
intensity.

2597.def:
from 2596 and the base of 939; to descend (literally or
figuratively):--come (get, go, step) down, fall (down).

2602.def:

2607.def:

2608.def:

2610.def:

2616.def:

2618.def:

2619.def: from 2596 and 2572; to cover wholly, i.e. veil:--cover, hide.

2623.def:

2624.def:

2625.def:
from 2596 and 2827; to recline down, i.e. (specially) to take a place

2626.def:

2629.def: from 2596 and 2875; to chop down, i.e. mangle:--cut.

2630.def:
from 2596 and a derivative of 2911; to precipitate down:--cast down

2632.def: from 2596 and 2919; to judge against, i.e. sentence:--condemn, damn.

2634.def:
from 2596 and 2961; to lord against, i.e. control,

2635.def:
from 2637; to be a traducer, i.e. to slander:--speak against (evil

2637.def:
from 2596 and the base of 2980; talkative against, i.e. a
slanderer:--backbiter.

2638.def:
from 2596 and 2983; to take eagerly, i.e. seize, possess, etc.

comprehend, find, obtain, perceive, (over-)take.

2639.def:
from 2596 and 3004 (in its original meaning); to lay down, i.e.
(figuratively) to enrol:--take into the number.

2641.def:
from 2596 and 3007; to leave down, i.e. behind; by implication, to
abandon, have remaining:--forsake, leave, reserve.

2642.def: from 2596 and 3034; to stone down, i.e. to death:--stone.

2643.def:
from 2644; exchange (figuratively, adjustment), i.e. restoration to

2644.def:
from 2596 and 236; to change mutually, i.e. (figuratively) to compound
a difference:--reconcile.

2645.def:
from 2596 and 3062; left down (behind), i.e remaining (plural the
rest):--residue.

2646.def:

(by implication) a lodging-place:-- guestchamber, inn.

2647.def:
from 2596 and 3089; to loosen down (disintegrate), i.e. (by
implication) to demolish (literally or figuratively); specially
(compare 2646) to halt for the night:--destroy, dissolve, be guest,
lodge, come to nought, overthrow, throw down.

2648.def:
from 2596 and 3129; to learn thoroughly, i.e. (by implication) to note
carefully:--consider.

2649.def: from 2596 and 3140; to testify against:--witness against.

2650.def: from 2596 and 3306; to stay fully, i.e. reside:--abide.

2655.def:
from 2596 and narkao (to be numb); to grow utterly torpid, i.e. (by
implication) slothful (figuratively, expensive):--be burdensome
(chargeable).

2656.def:
from 2596 and 3506; to nod down (towards), i.e. (by analogy) to make
signs to:--beckon.

2657.def:
from 2596 and 3539; to observe fully:--behold, consider, discover,
perceive.

2658.def:
from 2596 and a derivative of 473; to meet against, i.e. arrive at
(literally or figuratively):--attain, come.

2659.def:
from 2660; a prickling (sensation, as of the limbs asleep), i.e. (by
implication, (perhaps by some confusion with 3506 or even with 3571))
stupor (lethargy):--slumber.

2660.def:
from 2596 and 3572; to pierce thoroughly, i.e. (figuratively) to
agitate violently ("sting to the quick"):--prick.

2661.def: from 2596 and 515; to deem entirely deserving:--(ac-)count worthy.

2662.def:
from 2596 and 3961; to trample down; figuratively, to reject with
disdain:--trample, tread (down, underfoot).

2663.def: from 2664; reposing down, i.e. (by Hebraism) abode:--rest.

2664.def:
from 2596 and 3973; to settle down, i.e. (literally) to colonize, or
(figuratively) to (cause to) desist:--cease, (give) rest(-rain).

2665.def:
from a compound of 2596 and a congener of 4072; something spread
thoroughly, i.e. (specially) the door screen (to the Most Holy Place)
in the Jewish Temple:--vail.

2666.def:
from 2596 and 4095; to drink down, i.e. gulp entire (literally or
figuratively):--devour, drown, swallow (up).

2668.def:
from 2596 and 4126; to sail down upon a place, i.e. to land
at:--arrive.

2669.def:
from 2596 and a derivative of 4192; to labor down, i.e. wear with toil
(figuratively, harass):--oppress, vex.

2670.def:
from 2596 and a derivative of the same as 4195; to plunge down, i.e.
submerge:--drown, sink.

2672.def: middle voice from 2671; to execrate; by analogy, to doom:--curse.

2673.def:
from 2596 and 691; to be (render) entirely idle (useless), literally
or figuratively:--abolish, cease, cumber, deliver, destroy, do away,

2674.def: from 2596 and 705; to reckon among:--number with.

2675.def:
from 2596 and a derivative of 739; to complete thoroughly, i.e. repair
(literally or figuratively) or adjust:--fit, frame, mend, (make)
perfect(-ly join together), prepare, restore.

2678.def: from 2596 and 4579; to sway downward, i.e. make a signal:--beckon.

2679.def:
from 2596 and 4626; to undermine, i.e. (by implication) destroy:--dig
down, ruin.

2680.def:
from 2596 and a derivative of 4632; to prepare thoroughly (properly,
by external equipment; whereas 2090 refers rather to internal
fitness); by implication, to construct, create:--build, make, ordain,
prepare.

2681.def:
from 2596 and 4637; to camp down, i.e. haunt; figuratively, to
remain:--lodge, rest.

2682.def: from 2681; an encamping, i.e. (figuratively) a perch:--nest.

2683.def: from 2596 and a derivative of 4639; to overshade, i.e. cover:--shadow.

2684.def: from 2685; to be a sentinel, i.e. to inspect insidiously:--spy out.

2685.def:
from 2596 (intensive) and 4649 (in the sense of a watcher); a
reconnoiterer:--spy.

2686.def:
middle voice from 2596 and 4679; to be crafty against, i.e.
circumvent:--deal subtilly with.

2687.def: from 2596 and 4724; to put down, i.e. quell:--appease, quiet.

2688.def:
from 2525; properly, a position or condition, i.e. (subjectively)
demeanor:--behaviour.

2690.def: from 2596 and 4762; to turn upside down, i.e. upset:--overthrow.

2691.def:
from 2596 and 4763; to become voluptuous against:--begin to wax wanton
against.

2692.def:
from 2690; an overturn ("catastrophe"), i.e. demolition; figuratively,
apostasy:--overthrow, subverting.

2693.def:
from 2596 and 4766; to strew down, i.e. (by implication) to prostrate
(slay):--overthrow.

2694.def: from 2596 and 4951; to drag down, i.e. arrest judicially:--hale.

2695.def: from 2596 and 4969; to kill down, i.e. slaughter:--slay.

2697.def: from 2722; a holding down, i.e. occupancy:--possession.

2698.def:
from 2596 and 5087; to place down, i.e. deposit (literally or
figuratively):--do, lay, shew.

2699.def:
from a compound of 2596 and temno (to cut); a cutting down (off), i.e.
mutilation (ironically):--concision. Compare 609.

2701.def: from 2596 and 5143; to run down, i.e. hasten from a tower:--run down.

2702.def:
from 2596 and 5342 (including its alternate); to bear down, i.e.
(figuratively) overcome (with drowsiness); specially, to cast a
vote:--fall, give, sink down.

2704.def:
from 2596 and 5351; to spoil entirely, i.e. (literally) to destroy; or
(figuratively) to deprave; --corrupt, utterly perish.

2706.def: from 2596 and 5426; to think against, i.e. disesteem:--despise.

2708.def: from 2596 and cheo (to pour); to pour down (out):--pour.

2709.def:
from 2596 and chthon (the ground); subterranean, i.e. infernal
(belonging to the world of departed spirits):--under the earth.

2710.def: from 2596 and 5530; to overuse, i.e. misuse:--abuse.

2711.def: from 2596 and 5594; to cool down (off), i.e. refresh:--cool.

2712.def:
from 2596 (intensively) and 1497; utterly idolatrous:--wholly given to
idolatry.

2713.def: from 2596 and 1725; directly opposite:--before, over against.

2714.def:
from 2596 and 1799; directly in front of:--before (the presence of),
in the sight of.

2715.def:
from 2596 and 1850; to have (wield) full privilege over:--exercise
authority.

2716.def:
from 2596 and 2038; to work fully, i.e. accomplish; by implication, to
finish, fashion:--cause, to (deed), perform, work (out).

2718.def:
from 2596 and 2064 (including its alternate); to come (or go) down
(literally or figuratively):--come (down), depart, descend, go down,
land.

2719.def:
from 2596 and 2068 (including its alternate); to eat down, i.e. devour
(literally or figuratively):--devour.

2720.def:
from 2596 and 2116; to straighten fully, i.e. (figuratively)
direct:--guide, direct.

2721.def:
from 2596 and 2186; to stand over against, i.e. rush upon
(assault):--make insurrection against.

2722.def:
from 2596 and 2192; to hold down (fast), in various applications
(literally or figuratively):--have, hold (fast), keep (in memory),
let, X make toward, possess, retain, seize on, stay, take, withhold.

2723.def:
from 2725; to be a plaintiff, i.e. to charge with some
offence:--accuse, object.

2724.def:
from 2725; a complaint ("category"), i.e. criminal charge:--accusation
(X -ed).

2725.def:
from 2596 and 58; against one in the assembly, i.e. a complainant at

2726.def:

2728.def:
from 2596 and a derivative of 2447; to rust down, i.e.

2730.def:

2731.def:

2732.def: from a derivative of 2730; a dwelling-place:--habitation.

2733.def:

2738.def:

2747.def:
probably from kegchros (millet); Cenchreae, a port of

2748.def:

2750.def: of uncertain affinity; a swathe, i.e. winding-sheet:--graveclothes.

from a primary kello (to urge on); "hail"; to incite by word, i.e.

2755.def:
from 2756 and 1391; vainly glorifying, i.e. self-conceited:--desirous

2756.def:

(in) vain.

2757.def:
from a presumed compound of 2756 and 5456; empty sounding, i.e.

2758.def:
from 2756; to make empty, i.e. (figuratively) to abase, neutralize,
falsify:--make (of none effect, of no reputation, void), be in vain.

2759.def:
from kenteo (to prick); a point ("centre"), i.e. a sting

sting.

2760.def:

2761.def: adverb from 2756; vainly, i.e. to no purpose:--in vain.

2762.def:

2769.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 2768; something horned, i.e.

2770.def: from 2771; to gain (literally or figuratively):--(get) gain, win.

2771.def:

2772.def: from 2751; a clipping (bit), i.e. (specially) a coin:--money.

2773.def:
from a derivative of 2772; a handler of coins, i.e.
money-broker:--changer of money.

2774.def:
neuter of a derivative of 2776; a principal thing, i.e. main point;
specially, an amount (of money):--sum.

2775.def:
from the same as 2774; (specially) to strike on the head:--wound in
the head.

2776.def:

2777.def:

2778.def:
of Latin origin; properly, an enrollment ("census"), i.e. (by

2780.def:
from 2779 and ouros (a warden); a garden-keeper, i.e.
gardener:--gardener.

2782.def:
from 2784; a proclamation (especially of the gospel; by implication,
the gospel itself):--preaching.

2783.def:
from 2784; a herald, i.e. of divine truth (especially of the
gospel):--preacher.

2784.def:
of uncertain affinity; to herald (as a public crier), especially
divine truth (the gospel):--preacher(-er), proclaim, publish.

2785.def:
probably from the base of 5490; a huge fish (as gaping for
prey):--whale.

2786.def:
of Chaldee origin (compare 3710); the Rock; Cephas (i.e. Kepha), a

2787.def:
of uncertain derivation; a box, i.e. the sacred ark and that of

2789.def: from 2788; to play on a lyre:--harp.

2790.def:
from 2788 and a derivative of the same as 5603; a

2795.def:

2797.def: of Hebrew origin (7027); Cis (i.e. Kish), an Israelite:--Cis.

2798.def: from 2806; a twig or bough (as if broken off):--branch.

2799.def:

2807.def:
from 2808; a key (as shutting a lock), literally or

2808.def: a primary verb; to close (literally or figuratively):--shut (up).

2809.def:
from 2813; stealing (properly, the thing stolen, but used of the

2810.def:
probably contracted from Kleopatros (compound of 2811 and 3962);

2811.def: from a shorter form of 2564; renown (as if being called):--glory.

2812.def:
from 2813; a stealer (literally or figuratively):--thief. Compare

2814.def: from 2806; a limb or shoot (as if broken off):--branch.

2815.def:
of Latin origin; merciful; Clemes (i.e. Clemens), a

2816.def:
from 2818; to be an heir to (literally or figuratively):--be heir,

2817.def:
from 2818; heirship, i.e. (concretely) a patrimony or (genitive case)

2820.def:

2821.def: from a shorter form of 2564; an invitation (figuratively):--calling.

2822.def:

saint:--called.

2823.def: of uncertain derivation; an earthen pot used for baking in:--oven.

2824.def:
from 2827; a slope, i.e. (specially) a "clime" or tract of
country:--part, region.

2825.def:
from 2827; a couch (for sleep, sickness, sitting or eating):--bed,
table.

2826.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 2825; a pallet or little
couch:--bed.

2830.def:

2831.def:

2832.def:

2833.def:

2834.def: probably of foreign origin; Cnidus, a place in Asia Minor:--Cnidus.

2838.def: from 2837; sleeping, i.e. (by implication) repose:--taking of rest.

2843.def:
from 2844; communicative, i.e. (pecuniarily) liberal:--willing to
communicate.

2844.def:
from 2839; a sharer, i.e. associate:--companion, X fellowship,

2845.def:
from 2749; a couch; by extension, cohabitation; by implication, the

2847.def:

2855.def:

2856.def:
from a derivative of the base of 2849; to dock, i.e. (figuratively)

2857.def:

2859.def:
apparently a primary word; the bosom; by analogy, a bay:--bosom,
