3138.def: of Latin origin; Marcus, a Christian:--Marcus, Mark.

3139.def: from marmairo (to glisten); marble (as sparkling white):--marble.

3140.def:
from 3144; to be a witness, i.e. testify (literally or
figuratively):--charge, give (evidence), bear record, have (obtain,
of) good (honest) report, be well reported of, testify, give (have)
testimony, (be, bear, give, obtain) witness.

3141.def:
from 3144; evidence given (judicially or genitive case):--record,
report, testimony, witness.

3142.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 3144; something evidential, i.e.
(genitive case) evidence given or (specially), the Decalogue (in the
sacred Tabernacle):--to be testified, testimony, witness.

3143.def:
middle voice from 3144; to be adduced as a witness, i.e.
(figuratively) to obtest (in affirmation or exhortation):--take to
record, testify.

3144.def:
of uncertain affinity; a witness (literally (judicially) or
figuratively (genitive case)); by analogy, a "martyr":-- martyr,
record, witness.

3145.def: from a primary masso (to handle or squeeze); to chew:--gnaw.

3148.def:
probably from the base of 3145 (through the idea of contact); a whip
(literally, the Roman flagellum for criminals; figuratively, a
disease):--plague, scourging.

3149.def:
from the base of 3145; a (properly, female) breast (as if kneaded
up):--pap.

3150.def: from 3151; random talk, i.e. babble:--vain jangling.

3151.def:
from 3152 and 3004; an idle (i.e. senseless or mischievous) talker,
i.e. a wrangler:--vain talker.

3152.def:
from the base of 3155; empty, i.e. (literally) profitless, or
(specially), an idol:--vain, vanity.

3153.def:
from 3152; inutility; figuratively, transientness; morally,
depravity:--vanity.

3154.def:
from 3152; to render (passively, become) foolish, i.e. (morally)
wicked or (specially), idolatrous:--become vain.

3155.def:
accusative case of a derivative of the base of 3145 (through the idea
of tentative manipulation, i.e. unsuccessful search, or else of
punishment); folly, i.e. (adverbially) to no purpose:--in vain.

3157.def:
of Hebrew origin (4977); Matthan (i.e. Mattan), an
Israelite:--Matthan.

3160.def:
probably a shortened form of 3161 (compare 4992); Mattatha (i.e.
Mattithjah), an Israelite:--Mattatha.

3161.def:
of Hebrew origin (4993); Mattathias (i.e. Mattithjah), an Israelite
and a Christian:--Mattathias.

3162.def:
probably feminine of a presumed derivative of 3163; a knife, i.e.
dirk; figuratively, war, judicial punishment:--sword.

3163.def:
from 3164; a battle, i.e. (figuratively) controversy:--fighting,
strive, striving.

3164.def:
middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to war, i.e.
(figuratively) to quarrel, dispute:--fight, strive.

3167.def:
from 3173; magnificent, i.e. (neuter, plural as noun) a conspicuous
favor, or (subjectively) perfection:--great things, wonderful works.

3168.def:
from 3167; superbness, i.e. glory or splendor:--magnificence, majesty,
mighty power.

3169.def:
from 3173 and 4241; befitting greatness or magnificence
(majestic):--excellent.

3170.def:
from 3173; to make (or declare) great, i.e. increase or (figuratively)
extol:--enlarge, magnify, shew great.

3172.def:
from 3173; greatness, i.e. (figuratively) divinity (often God
himself):--majesty.

3173.def:
(including the prolonged forms, feminine megale, plural
megaloi, etc.; compare also 3176, 3187); big (literally or
figuratively, in a very wide application):--(+ fear) exceedingly,
great(-est), high, large, loud, mighty, + (be) sore (afraid), strong,
X to years.

3176.def: superlative of 3173; greatest or very great:--exceeding great.

3177.def:
from 3326 and 2059; to explain over, i.e. translate:--(by)
interpret(-ation).

3178.def:
apparently a primary word; an intoxicant, i.e. (by implication)
intoxication:--drunkenness.

3180.def:
from a compound of 3326 and 3593 (compare "method"); travelling over,
i.e. travesty (trickery):--wile, lie in wait.

3182.def: a prolonged (transitive) form of 3184; to intoxicate:--be drunk(-en).

3183.def: from 3184; tipsy, i.e. (as noun) a sot:--drunkard.

3184.def:
from another form of 3178; to drink to intoxication, i.e. get
drunk:--drink well, make (be) drunk(-en).

3187.def:
irregular comparative of 3173; larger (literally or figuratively,
specially, in age):--elder, greater(-est), more.

3190.def: of uncertain origin; Meleas, an Israelite:--Meleas.

3191.def:
from a presumed derivative of 3199; to take care of, i.e. (by
implication) revolve in the mind:--imagine, (pre-)meditate.

3194.def: of uncertain origin; Melita, an island in the Mediterranean:--Melita.

3195.def:
a strengthened form of 3199 (through the idea of expectation); to
intend, i.e. be about to be, do, or suffer something (of persons or
things, especially events; in the sense of purpose, duty, necessity,
probability, possibility, or hesitation):--about, after that, be
(almost), (that which is, things, + which was for) to come, intend,
was to (be), mean, mind, be at the point, (be) ready, + return, shall
(begin), (which, that) should (after, afterwards, hereafter) tarry,
which was for, will, would, be yet.

3196.def: of uncertain affinity; a limb or part of the body:--member.

3197.def:
of Hebrew origin (4428 with pronominal suffix, my king); Melchi (i.e.
Malki), the name of two Israelites:--Melchi.

3198.def:
of Hebrew origin (4442); Melchisedek (i.e. Malkitsedek), a
patriarch:--Melchisedec.

3199.def:
a primary verb; to be of interest to, i.e. to concern (only third
person singular present indicative used impersonally, it
matters):--(take) care.

3201.def: middle voice of an apparently primary verb; to blame:--find fault.

3202.def:
from a presumed derivative of 3201 and moira (fate; akin to the base
of 3313); blaming fate, i.e. querulous (discontented):--complainer.

3303.def:
a primary particle; properly, indicative of affirmation or concession
(in fact); usually followed by a contrasted clause with 1161 (this
one, the former, etc.):--even, indeed, so, some, truly, verily. Often
compounded with other particles in an intensive or asseverative sense.

3304.def:
from 3203 and 3767 and 1065; so then at least:--nay but, yea doubtless
(rather, verily).

3305.def:
from 3203 and 5104; indeed though, i.e. however:--also, but, howbeit,
nevertheless, yet.

3306.def:
a primary verb; to stay (in a given place, state, relation or
expectancy):--abide, continue, dwell, endure, be present, remain,
stand, tarry (for), X thine own.

3307.def:
from 3313; to part, i.e. (literally) to apportion, bestow, share, or
(figuratively) to disunite, differ:--deal, be difference between,
distribute, divide, give participle

3308.def: from 3307 (through the idea of distraction); solicitude:--care.

3309.def: from 3308; to be anxious about:--(be, have) care(-ful), take thought.

3310.def:
feminine of 3313; a portion, i.e. province, share or (abstractly)
participation:--part (X -akers).

3311.def: from 3307; a separation or distribution:--dividing asunder, gift.

3313.def:
from an obsolete but more primary form of meiromai (to get as a
section or allotment); a division or share (literally or figuratively,
in a wide application):--behalf, course, coast, craft, particular (+
-ly), part (+ -ly), piece, portion, respect, side, some sort(-what).

3314.def: from 3319 and 2250; midday; by implication, the south:--noon, south.

3315.def:
from 3316; to interpose (as arbiter), i.e (by implication) to ratify
(as surety):--confirm.

3316.def:
from 3319; a go-between, i.e. (simply) an internunciator, or (by
implication) a reconciler (intercessor):--mediator.

3317.def:
neuter of compound of 3319 and 3571; midnight (especially as a
watch):--midnight.

3318.def:
from 3319 and 4215; Mesopotamia (as lying between the Euphrates and
the Tigris; compare 0763), a region of Asia:--Mesopotamia.

3319.def:
from 3326; middle (as an adjective or (neuter) noun):--among, X before
them, between, + forth, mid(-day, -night), midst, way.

3321.def: from a presumed compound of 3319 and 3772; mid-sky:--midst of heaven.

3322.def:
from 3319; to form the middle, i.e. (in point of time), to be half-way
over:--be about the midst.

3323.def:
of Hebrew origin (4899); the Messias (i.e. Mashiach), or
Christ:--Messias.

3325.def: from 3324; to replenish, i.e. (by implication) to intoxicate:--fill.

3326.def:
a primary preposition (often used adverbially); properly, denoting
accompaniment; "amid" (local or causal); modified variously according
to the case (genitive association, or accusative succession) with
which it is joined; occupying an intermediate position between 575 or
1537 and 1519 or 4314; less intimate than 1722 and less close than
4862):--after(-ward), X that he again, against, among, X and,
+ follow, hence, hereafter, in, of, (up-)on, + our, X and
setting, since, (un-)to, + together, when, with (+ -out). Often used
in composition, in substantially the same relations of participation
or proximity, and transfer or sequence.

3327.def:
from 3326 and the base of 939; to change place:--depart, go, pass,
remove.

3328.def:
from 3326 and 906; to throw over, i.e. (middle voice figuratively) to
turn about in opinion:--change mind.

3329.def: from 3326 and 718; to lead over, i.e. transfer (direct):--turn about.

3330.def: from 3326 and 1325; to give over, i.e. share:--give, impart.

3331.def:
from 3346; transposition, i.e. transferral (to heaven),
disestablishment (of a law):--change, removing, translation.

3332.def: from 3326 and 142; to betake oneself, i.e. remove (locally):--depart.

3333.def:
from 3326 and 2564; to call elsewhere, i.e. summon:--call (for,
hither).

3334.def:
from 3326 and 2795; to stir to a place elsewhere, i.e. remove
(figuratively):--move away.

3335.def:
from 3326 and 2983; to participate; genitive case, to accept (and
use):--eat, have, be partaker, receive, take.

3338.def:
from 3326 and the middle voice of 3199; to care afterwards, i.e.
regret:--repent (self).

3339.def:
from 3326 and 3445; to transform (literally or figuratively,
"metamorphose"):--change, transfigure, transform.

3340.def:
from 3326 and 3539; to think differently or afterwards, i.e.
reconsider (morally, feel compunction):--repent.

3341.def:
from 3340; (subjectively) compunction (for guilt, including
reformation); by implication, reversal (of (another's)
decision):--repentance.

3343.def:
from 3326 and 3992; to send from elsewhere, i.e. (middle voice) to
summon or invite:--call (send) foreign

3344.def:
from 3326 and 4762; to turn across, i.e. transmute or (figuratively)
corrupt:--pervert, turn.

3346.def:
from 3326 and 5087; to transfer, i.e. (literally) transport, (by
implication) exchange, (reflexively) change sides, or (figuratively)
pervert:--carry over, change, remove, translate, turn.

3348.def:
from 3326 and 2192; to share or participate; by implication, belong
to, eat (or drink):--be partaker, pertain, take part, use.

3349.def:
from a compound of 3326 and a collateral form of 142 or perhaps rather
109 (compare "meteor"); to raise in mid-air, i.e. (figuratively)
suspend (passively, fluctuate or be anxious):--be of doubtful mind.

3351.def:
from the same as 3350; to transfer as a settler or captive, i.e
colonize or exile:--carry away, remove into.

3353.def:
from 3348; participant, i.e. (as noun) a sharer; by implication, an
associate:--fellow, partaker, partner.

3354.def:
from 3358; to measure (i.e. ascertain in size by a fixed standard); by
implication, to admeasure (i.e. allot by rule):--figuratively, to
estimate:--measure, mete.

3355.def:
from 3354; a measurer, i.e. (specially), a certain standard measure of
capacity for liquids:--firkin.

3356.def:
from a compound of the base of 3357 and 3806; to be moderate in
passion, i.e. gentle (to treat indulgently):--have compassion.

3357.def:
adverb from a derivative of 3358; moderately, i.e. slightly:--a
little.

3358.def:
an apparently primary word; a measure ("metre"), literally or
figuratively; by implication, a limited portion (degree):-- measure.

3359.def:
from 3326 and ops (the face); the forehead (as opposite the
countenance):--forehead.

3360.def:
or mechris mekh-ris'

from 3372; as far as, i.e. up to a certain point (as a preposition, of
extent (denoting the terminus, whereas 891 refers especially to the
space of time or place intervening) or conjunction):--till, (un-)to,
until.

3361.def:
a primary particle of qualified negation (whereas 3756 expresses an
absolute denial); (adverb) not, (conjunction) lest; also (as an
interrogative implying a negative answer (whereas 3756 expects an
affirmative one)) whether:--any but (that), X forbear, + God forbid, +
lack, lest, neither, never, no (X wise in), none, nor, (can-)not,
nothing, that not, un(-taken), without. Often used in compounds in
substantially the same relations. See also 3362, 3363, 3364, 3372,
3373, 3375, 3378.

3362.def:
i.e. 1437 and 3361; if not, i.e. unless:--X before, but, except, if,
no, (if, + whosoever) not.

3363.def:
i.e. 2443 and 3361; in order (or so) that not:--albeit not, lest,
that, no(-t, (-thing)).

3364.def:
i.e. 3756 and 3361; a double negative strengthening the denial; not at
all:--any more, at all, by any (no) means, neither, never, no (at
all), in no case (wise), nor ever, not (at all, in any wise). Compare
3378.

3365.def:
adverb from a compound of 3361 and amos (somebody); by no means:--not
so.

3366.def:
from 3361 and 1161; but not, not even; in a continued negation,
nor:--neither, nor (yet), (no) not (once, so much as).

3369.def: from 3366 and 4452; not even yet:--not yet.

3370.def:
of foreign origin (compare 4074); a Median, or inhabitant of
Media:--Mede.

3371.def:
from 3361 and 2089; no further:--any longer, (not) henceforth,
hereafter, no henceforward (longer, more, soon), not any more.

3372.def: probably akin to 3173; length (literally or figuratively) length.

3373.def: from 3372; to lengthen, i.e. (middle voice) to enlarge:--grow up.

3375.def:
a stronger form of 3303; a particle of affirmation (only with 2229);
assuredly:--+ surely.

3377.def:
probably from the same base as 3145 and 3415 (i.e. mao, to strive); to
disclose (through the idea of mental effort and thus calling to mind),
i.e. report, declare, intimate:--shew, tell.

3378.def:
i.e. 3361 and 3756; as interrogative and negative, is it not
that?:--neither (followed by no), + never, not. Compare 3364.

3379.def:
me pote may pot'-eh

from 3361 and 4218; not ever; also if (or lest) ever (or perhaps):--if
peradventure, lest (at any time, haply), not at all, whether or not.

3382.def: perhaps a primary word; a thigh:--thigh.

3383.def:
from 3361 and 5037; not too, i.e. (in continued negation) neither or
nor; also, not even:--neither, (n-)or, so as much.

3384.def:
apparently a primary word; a "mother" (literally or figuratively,
immediate or remote):--mother.

3385.def:
from 3361 and the neuter of 5100; whether at all:--not (the particle
usually not expressed, except by the form of the question).

3389.def:
from 3384 and the base of 257; a mother-thresher, i.e.
matricide:--murderer of mothers.

3391.def:
irregular feminine of 1520; one or first:--a (certain), + agree,
first, one, X other.

3392.def:
perhaps a primary verb; to sully or taint, i.e. contaminate
(ceremonially or morally):--defile.

3398.def:
mikroteros mik-rot'-er-os

apparently a primary word; small (in size, quantity, number or
(figuratively) dignity):--least, less, little, small.

3399.def: of uncertain origin; Miletus, a city of Asia Minor:--Miletus.

3400.def: of Latin origin; a thousand paces, i.e. a "mile":--mile.

3401.def: middle voice from mimos (a "mimic"); to imitate:--follow.

3404.def:
from a primary misos (hatred); to detest (especially to persecute); by
extension, to love less:--hate(-ful).

3405.def: from 3406; requital (good or bad):--recompence of reward.

3408.def:
apparently a primary word; pay for service (literally or
figuratively), good or bad:--hire, reward, wages.

3409.def: from 3408; to let out for wages, i.e. (middle voice) to hire:--hire.

3411.def: from 3409; a wage-worker (good or bad):--hired servant, hireling.

3412.def:
for mutilene (abounding in shellfish); Mitylene (or Mytilene), a town
on the island of Lesbos:--Mitylene.

3413.def: of Hebrew origin (4317); Michael, an archangel:--Michael.

3414.def: of Latin origin; a mna (i.e. mina), a certain weight:-- pound.

3415.def:
middle voice of a derivative of 3306 or perhaps of the base of 3145
(through the idea of fixture in the mind or of mental grasp); to bear
in mind, i.e. recollect; by implication, to reward or punish:--be
mindful, remember, come (have) in remembrance. Compare 3403.

3416.def: of uncertain origin; Mnason, a Christian:--Mnason.

3417.def:
from 3415 or 3403; recollection; by implication, recital:--mention,
remembrance.

3418.def:
from 3415; a memorial, i.e. sepulchral monument
(burial-place):--grave, sepulchre, tomb.

3419.def:
from 3420; a remembrance, i.e. cenotaph (place of interment):--grave,
sepulchre, tomb.

3421.def:
from a derivative of 3420; to exercise memory, i.e. recollect; by
implication, to punish; also to rehearse:--make mention; be mindful,
remember.

3423.def:
from a derivative of 3415; to give a souvenir (engagement present),
i.e. betroth:--espouse.

3424.def:
from 3425 and 2980; hardly talking, i.e. dumb (tongue-tied):--having
an impediment in his speech.

3425.def: adverb from a primary mogos (toil); with difficulty:--hardly.

3426.def:
of Latin origin; a modius, i.e. certain measure for things dry (the
quantity or the utensil):--bushel.

3428.def:
a prolonged form of the feminine of 3432; an adulteress (literally or
figuratively):--adulteress(-ous, -y).

3429.def: from 3432; (middle voice) to commit adultery:--commit adultery.

3432.def:
perhaps a primary word; a (male) paramour; figuratively,
apostate:--adulterer.

3433.def:
probably by variation for 3425; with difficulty:--hardly, scarce(-ly),
+ with much work.

3434.def: of Hebrew origin (4432); Moloch (i.e. Molek), an idol:--Moloch.

3437.def: from 3201; blame, i.e. (by implication), a fault:--quarrel.

3438.def:
from 3306; a staying, i.e. residence (the act or the place):--abode,
mansion.

3439.def: from 3441 and 1096; only-born, i.e. sole:--only (begotten, child).

3440.def: neuter of 3441 as adverb; merely:--alone, but, only.

3441.def:
probably from 3306; remaining, i.e. sole or single; by implication,
mere:--alone, only, by themselves.

3443.def: from 3441; to isolate, i.e. bereave:--be desolate.

3444.def:
perhaps from the base of 3313 (through the idea of adjustment of
parts); shape; figuratively, nature:--form.

3445.def: from the same as 3444; to fashion (figuratively):--form.

3446.def:
from 3445; formation, i.e. (by implication), appearance (semblance or
(concretely) formula):--form.

3447.def: from 3448 and 4160; to fabricate the image of a bullock:--make a calf.

3448.def: probably strengthened for oschos (a shoot); a young bullock:--calf.

3449.def:
from the base of 3425; toil, i.e. (by implication)
sadness:--painfulness, travail.

3451.def: from Mousa (a Muse); "musical", i.e. (as noun) a minstrel:--musician.

3452.def: perhaps a primary word; the marrow:--marrow.

3453.def:
from the base of 3466; to initiate, i.e. (by implication) to
teach:--instruct.

3454.def:
perhaps from the same as 3453 (through the idea of tuition); a tale,
i.e. fiction ("myth"):--fable.

3455.def:
from a presumed derivative of muzo ( to "moo"); to bellow
(roar):--roar.

3456.def:
from a derivative of the base of 3455 (meaning snout, as that whence
lowing proceeds); to make mouths at, i.e. ridicule:--mock.

3458.def:
probably ultimately from the base of 3433 (through the idea of
hardship); a "mill", i.e. (by implication), a grinder
(millstone):--millstone.

3460.def: of uncertain derivation; Myra, a place in Asia Minor:--Myra.

3461.def:
from 3463; a ten-thousand; by extension, a "myriad" or indefinite
number:--ten thousand.

3463.def:
plural of an apparently primary word (properly, meaning very many);
ten thousand; by extension, innumerably many:--ten thousand.

3464.def:
probably of foreign origin (compare 4753, 4666); "myrrh", i.e. (by
implication) perfumed oil:--ointment.

3465.def: of uncertain origin; Mysia, a region of Asia Minor:--Mysia.

3466.def:
from a derivative of muo (to shut the mouth); a secret or "mystery"
(through the idea of silence imposed by initiation into religious
rites):--mystery.

3467.def:
from a compound of the base of 3466 and ops (the face; from 3700); to
shut the eyes, i.e. blink (see indistinctly):-- cannot see far off.

3468.def:
from molos ("moil"; probably akin to the base of 3433) and probably
ops (the face; from 3700); a mole ("black eye") or blow-mark:--stripe.

3469.def: from 3470; to carp at, i.e. censure (discredit):--blame.

3470.def:
perhaps from 3201; a flaw or blot, i.e. (figuratively) disgraceful
person:--blemish.

3471.def:
from 3474; to become insipid; figuratively, to make (passively, act)
as a simpleton:--become fool, make foolish, lose savour.

3473.def:
from a compound of 3474 and 3004; silly talk, i.e.
buffoonery:--foolish talking.

3474.def:
probably from the base of 3466; dull or stupid (as if shut up), i.e.
heedless, (morally) blockhead, (apparently) absurd:--fool(-ish, X
-ishness).

3476.def:
of Hebrew origin (5177); Naasson (i.e. Nachshon), an
Israelite:--Naasson.

3477.def:
probably of Hebrew origin (compare 5052); Nangae (i.e. perhaps
Nogach), an Israelite:--Nagge.

3478.def:
or Nazaret nad-zar-et'; of uncertain derivation; Nazareth or Nazaret,
a place in Palestine:--Nazareth.

3479.def: from 3478; a Nazarene, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth:--of Nazareth.

3480.def:
from 3478; a Nazoraean, i.e. inhabitant of Nazareth; by extension, a
Christian:--Nazarene, of Nazareth.

3481.def: of Hebrew origin (5416); Nathan, an Israelite:--Nathan.

3482.def:
of Hebrew origin (5417); Nathanael (i.e. Nathanel), an Israelite and
Christian:--Nathanael.

3483.def:
a primary particle of strong affirmation; yes:--even so, surely,
truth, verily, yea, yes.

3484.def:
probably of Hebrew origin (compare 4999); Nain, a place in
Palestine:--Nain.

3485.def:
from a primary naio (to dwell); a fane, shrine, temple :--shrine,
temple. Compare 2411.

3486.def: of Hebrew origin (5151); Naum (i.e. Nachum), an Israelite:--Naum.

3488.def:
a flower of the same name, from narke (stupefaction, as a "narcotic");
Narcissus, a Roman:--Narcissus.

3489.def:
from a compound of 3491 and 71; to be shipwrecked (stranded,
"navigate"), literally or figuratively:--make (suffer) shipwreck.

3490.def: from 3491 and 2819 ("clerk"); a captain:--owner of a ship.

3491.def: from nao or neo (to float); a boat (of any size):--ship.

3492.def: from 3491; a boatman, i.e. seaman:--sailor, shipman.

3493.def: of Hebrew origin (5152); Nachor, the grandfather of Abraham:--Nachor.

3494.def:
from a derivative of 3501; a youth (up to about forty years):--young
man.

3495.def: from the same as 3494; a youth (under forty):--young man.

3497.def: of Hebrew origin (5283); Neeman (i.e. Naaman), a Syrian:--Naaman.

3498.def:
from an apparently primary nekus (a corpse); dead (literally or
figuratively; also as noun):--dead.

3499.def:
from 3498; to deaden, i.e. (figuratively) to subdue:--be dead,
mortify.

3504.def:
from 3501 and a derivative of 5453; newly planted, i.e. (figuratively)
a young convert ("neophyte"):--novice.

3506.def:
apparently a primary verb; to "nod", i.e. (by analogy),
signal:--beckon.

3507.def: from 3509; properly, cloudiness, i.e. (concretely) a cloud:--cloud.

3508.def:
of Hebrew origin (5321); Nephthaleim (i.e. Naphthali), a tribe in
Palestine:--Nephthalim.

3509.def: apparently a primary word; a cloud:--cloud.

3510.def:
of uncertain affinity; a kidney (plural), i.e. (figuratively) the
inmost mind:--reins.

3511.def:
from a form of 3485 and koreo (to sweep); a temple-servant, i.e. (by
implication) a votary:--worshipper.

3512.def:
from the comparative of 3501; appertaining to younger persons, i.e.
juvenile:--youthful.

3513.def:
probably an intensive form of 3483; a particle of attestation
(accompanied by the object invoked or appealed to in confirmation); as
sure as:--I protest by.

3514.def: from neo (of like meaning); to spin:--spin.

3515.def:
from 3516; to act as a babe, i.e. (figuratively) innocently:--be a
child.

3516.def:
from an obsolete particle ne- (implying negation) and 2031; not
speaking, i.e. an infant (minor); figuratively, a simple-minded
person, an immature Christian:--babe, child (+ -ish).

3517.def:
apparently from a derivative of the base of 3491 (meaning wet);
Nereus, a Christian:--Nereus.

3518.def: of Hebrew origin (5374); Neri (i.e. Nerijah), an Israelite:--Neri.

3520.def: probably from the base of 3491; an island:--island, isle.

3521.def:
from 3522; abstinence (from lack of food, or voluntary and religious);
specially, the fast of the Day of Atonement:-- fast(-ing).

3523.def:
from the inseparable negative particle ne- (not) and 2068; not eating,
i.e. abstinent from food (religiously):--fasting.

3524.def:
nephalios nay-fal'-ee-os

from 3525; sober, i.e. (figuratively) circumspect:--sober.

3525.def:
of uncertain affinity: to abstain from wine (keep sober), i.e.
(figuratively) be discreet:--be sober, watch.

3526.def: of Latin origin; black; Niger, a Christian:--Niger.

3527.def: probably from 3528; victorious; Nicanor, a Christian:--Nicanor.

3528.def:
from 3529; to subdue (literally or figuratively):--conquer, overcome,
prevail, get the victory.

3529.def:
apparently a primary word; conquest (abstractly), i.e. (figuratively)
the means of success:--victory.

3530.def:
from 3534 and 1218; victorious among his people; Nicodemus, an
Israelite:--Nicodemus.

3531.def: from 3532; a Nicolaite, i.e. adherent of Nicolaus:--Nicolaitane.

3532.def:
from 3534 and 2994; victorious over the people; Nicolaus, a
heretic:--Nicolaus.

3533.def:
from 3534 and 4172; victorious city; Nicopolis, a place in
Macedonia:--Nicopolis.

3534.def:
from 3529; a conquest (concretely), i.e. (by implication)
triumph:--victory.

3535.def:
of Hebrew origin (5210); Ninevi (i.e. Nineveh), the capital of
Assyria:--Nineve.

3536.def:
from 3535; a Ninevite, i.e. inhabitant of Nineveh:--of Nineve,
Ninevite.

3538.def:
to cleanse (especially the hands or the feet or the face);
ceremonially, to perform ablution:--wash. Compare 3068.

3539.def:
from 3563; to exercise the mind (observe), i.e. (figuratively) to
comprehend, heed:--consider, perceive, think, understand.

3540.def:
from 3539; a perception, i.e. purpose, or (by implication) the
intellect, disposition, itself:--device, mind, thought.

3541.def: of uncertain affinity; a spurious or illegitimate son:--bastard.

3542.def:
feminine from the same as 3551; pasture, i.e. (the act) feeding
(figuratively, spreading of a gangrene), or (the food) pasturage:--X
eat, pasture.

3543.def:
from 3551; properly, to do by law (usage), i.e. to accustom
(passively, be usual); by extension, to deem or regard:-- suppose,
thing, be wont.

3544.def:
from 3551; according (or pertaining) to law, i.e. legal
(ceremonially); as noun, an expert in the (Mosaic) law:--about the
law, lawyer.

3545.def:
adverb from a derivative of 3551; legitimately (specially, agreeably
to the rules of the lists):--lawfully.

3546.def:
from 3543; what is reckoned as of value (after the Latin numisma),
i.e. current coin:--money.

3547.def:
from 3551 and 1320; an expounder of the (Jewish) law, i.e. a
Rabbi:--doctor (teacher) of the law.

3548.def:
from 3550; legislation (specially, the institution of the Mosaic
code):--giving of the law.

3550.def: from 3551 and a derivative of 5087; a legislator:--lawgiver.

3551.def:
from a primary nemo (to parcel out, especially food or grazing to
animals); law (through the idea of prescriptive usage), genitive case
(regulation), specially, (of Moses (including the volume); also of the
Gospel), or figuratively (a principle):--law.

3552.def:
from 3554; to be sick, i.e. (by implication, of a diseased appetite)
to hanker after (figuratively, to harp upon):--dote.

3554.def:
of uncertain affinity; a malady (rarely figuratively, of moral
disability):--disease, infirmity, sickness.

3557.def:
middle voice from nosphi (apart or clandestinely); to sequestrate for
oneself, i.e. embezzle:--keep back, purloin.

3558.def:
of uncertain affinity; the south(-west) wind; by extension, the
southern quarter itself:--south (wind).

3559.def:
from 3563 and a derivative of 5087; calling attention to, i.e. (by
implication) mild rebuke or warning:--admonition.

3560.def:
from the same as 3559; to put in mind, i.e. (by implication) to
caution or reprove gently:--admonish, warn.

3561.def:
feminine of a compound of 3501 and 3376 (as noun by implication, of
2250); the festival of new moon:--new moon.

3562.def:
adverb from a comparative of the accusative case of 3563 and 2192; in
a mind-having way, i.e. prudently:--discreetly.

3563.def:
probably from the base of 1097; the intellect, i.e. mind (divine or
human; in thought, feeling, or will); by implication, meaning:--mind,
understanding. Compare 5590.

3564.def:
probably contracted for a compound of 3565 and 1435; nymph-given (i.e.
-born); Nymphas, a Christian:--Nymphas.

3565.def:
from a primary but obsolete verb nupto (to veil as a bride; compare
Latin "nupto," to marry); a young married woman (as veiled), including
a betrothed girl; by implication, a son's wife:--bride, daughter in
law.

3568.def:
a primary particle of present time; "now" (as adverb of date, a
transition or emphasis); also as noun or adjective present or
immediate:--henceforth, + hereafter, of late, soon, present, this
(time). See also 3569, 3570.

3569.def:
ta nun tah noon

from neuter plural of 3588 and 3568; the things now, i.e.
(adverbially) at present:--(but) now.

3570.def: a prolonged form of 3568 for emphasis; just now:--now.

3572.def: apparently a primary word; to prick ("nudge"):--pierce.

3573.def:
from a presumed derivative of 3506; to nod, i.e. (by implication) to
fall asleep; figuratively, to delay:--slumber.

3574.def:
from 3571 and 2250; a day-and-night, i.e. full day of twenty-four
hours:--night and day.

3575.def: of Hebrew origin (5146); Noe, (i.e. Noach), a patriarch:--Noe.

3576.def:
from a derivative of 3541; sluggish, i.e. (literally) lazy, or
(figuratively) stupid:--dull, slothful.

3578.def:
from 3581; hospitality, i.e. (by implication) a place of
entertainment:--lodging.

3579.def:
from 3581; to be a host (passively, a guest); by implication, be
(make, appear) strange:--entertain, lodge, (think it) strange.

3580.def: from a compound of 3581 and 1209; to be hospitable:--lodge strangers.

3581.def:
apparently a primary word; foreign (literally, alien, or figuratively,
novel); by implication, a guest or (vice-versa) entertainer:--host,
strange(-r).

3582.def:
as if from xeo (properly, to smooth; by implication, (of friction) to
boil or heat); a vessel (as fashioned or for cooking) (or perhaps by
corruption from the Latin sextarius, the sixth of a modius, i.e. about
a pint), i.e. (specially), a measure for liquids or solids, (by
analogy, a pitcher):--pot.

3583.def:
from 3584; to desiccate; by implication, to shrivel, to mature:--dry
up, pine away, be ripe, wither (away).

3584.def:
from the base of 3582 (through the idea of scorching); arid; by
implication, shrunken, earth (as opposed to water):--dry land,
withered.

3587.def:
from a derivative of the same as 3586 (meaning a razor); to shave or
"shear" the hair:--shave.

3588.def: including the feminine ἡ (hay) and the neuter τό (to) in all their inflections; the definite article; the (sometimes to be supplied, at others omitted, in English idiom):--the, this, that, one, he, she, it, etc.

3591.def:
probably from the same as 43; a mass (as bending or bulging by its
load), i.e. burden (hindrance):--weight.

3592.def:
hede hay'-deh, and the neuter
tode tod'-e

from 3588 and 1161; the same, i.e. this or that one (plural these or
those); often used as a personal pronoun:--he, she, such, these, thus.

3594.def:
from 3595; to show the way (literally or figuratively
(teach)):--guide, lead.

3595.def:
from 3598 and 2233; a conductor (literally or figuratively
(teacher)):--guide, leader.

3596.def:
from a compound of 3598 and 4198; to be a wayfarer, i.e. travel:--go
on a journey.

3598.def:
apparently a primary word; a road; by implication, a progress (the
route, act or distance); figuratively, a mode or means:--journey,
(high-)way.

3599.def: perhaps from the base of 2068; a "tooth":--tooth.

3602.def:
from a derivative of the base of 1416; moaning, i.e.
lamentation:--mourning.

3604.def: of Hebrew origin (5818); Ozias (i.e. Uzzijah), an Israelite:--Ozias.

3605.def:
a primary verb (in a strengthened form); to scent (usually an ill
"odor"): stink.

3606.def:
from 3739 with the directive enclitic of source; from which place or
source or cause (adverb or conjunction):--from thence, (from) whence,
where(-by, -fore, -upon).

3607.def:
of uncertain affinity; a linen cloth, i.e. (especially) a
sail:--sheet.

3608.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 3607; a linen bandage:--linen
clothes.

3609.def:
from 3624; domestic, i.e. (as noun), a relative, adherent:--(those) of
the (his own) house(-hold).

3610.def:
from 3611; a fellow resident, i.e. menial domestic:--(household)
servant.

3611.def:
from 3624; to occupy a house, i.e. reside (figuratively, inhabit,
remain, inhere); by implication, to cohabit:--dwell. See also 3625.

3612.def: from 3611; a tenement, i.e. (specially), a jail:--prison.

3613.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 3611 (equivalent to 3612); a
residence (literally or figuratively):--habitation, house.

3615.def:
from 3614; familiar, i.e. (as noun) relatives:--they (them) of (his
own) household.

3616.def: from 3617; to be the head of (i.e. rule) a family:--guide the house.

3617.def:
from 3624 and 1203; the head of a family:--goodman (of the house),
householder, master of the house.

3621.def: from 3623; to manage (a house, i.e. an estate):--be steward.

3622.def:
from 3623; administration (of a household or estate); specially, a
(religious) "economy":--dispensation, stewardship.

3623.def:
from 3624 and the base of 3551; a house-distributor (i.e. manager), or
overseer, i.e. an employee in that capacity; by extension, a fiscal
agent (treasurer); figuratively, a preacher (of the
Gospel):--chamberlain, governor, steward.

3624.def:
of uncertain affinity; a dwelling (more or less extensive, literal or
figurative); by implication, a family (more or less related, literally
or figuratively):--home, house(-hold), temple.

3625.def:
feminine participle present passive of 3611 (as noun, by implication,
of 1093); land, i.e. the (terrene part of the) globe; specially, the
Roman empire:--earth, world.

3626.def:
from 3624 and ouros (a guard; be "ware"); a stayer at home, i.e.
domestically inclined (a "good housekeeper"):--keeper at home.

3627.def:
oiktereo oyk-ter-eh'-o
from oiktos (pity); to exercise pity:--have compassion on.

3630.def:
from 3631 and a derivative of the alternate of 4095; a
tippler:--winebibber.

3631.def:
a primary word (or perhaps of Hebrew origin (3196)); "wine" (literally
or figuratively):--wine.

3632.def:
from 3631 and a form of the base of 5397; an overflow (or surplus) of
wine, i.e. vinolency (drunkenness):--excess of wine.

3633.def:
oimai oy'-mahee

middle voice apparently from 3634; to make like (oneself), i.e.
imagine (be of the opinion):--suppose, think.

3634.def:
probably akin to 3588, 3739, and 3745; such or what sort of (as a
correlation or exclamation); especially the neuter (adverbially) with
negative, not so:--so (as), such as, what (manner of), which.

3635.def: from oknos (hesitation); to be slow (figuratively, loath):--delay.

3636.def:
from 3635; tardy, i.e. indolent; (figuratively) irksome:--grievous,
slothful.

3637.def: from 3638 and 2250; an eight-day old person or act:--the eighth day.

3639.def:
from a primary ollumi (to destroy; a prolonged form); ruin, i.e.
death, punishment:--destruction.

3640.def:
from 3641 and 4102; incredulous, i.e. lacking confidence (in
Christ):--of little faith.

3641.def:
of uncertain affinity; puny (in extent, degree, number, duration or
value); especially neuter (adverbially) somewhat:--+ almost,
brief(-ly), few, (a) little, + long, a season, short, small, a while.

3643.def:
from a compound of 3641 and ora ("care"); to have little regard for,
i.e. to disesteem:--despise.

3644.def: from 3645; a ruiner, i.e. (specially), a venomous serpent:--destroyer.

3646.def:
from a derivative of a compound of 3650 and a derivative of 2545; a
wholly-consumed sacrifice ("holocaust"):--(whole) burnt offering.

3647.def: from 3648; integrity, i.e. physical wholeness:--perfect soundness.

3648.def:
from 3650 and 2819; complete in every part, i.e. perfectly sound (in
body):--entire, whole.

3649.def:
a reduplicated primary verb; to "howl" or "halloo", i.e.
shriek:--howl.

3650.def:
a primary word; "whole" or "all", i.e. complete (in extent, amount,
time or degree), especially (neuter) as noun or adverb:--all,
altogether, every whit, + throughout, whole.

3651.def:
from 3650 and 5056; complete to the end, i.e. absolutely
perfect:--wholly.

3652.def:
probably a contraction from Olumpiodoros (Olympian-bestowed, i.e.
heaven-descended); Olympas, a Christian:--Olympas.

3653.def:
of uncertain derivation; an unripe (because out of season)
fig:--untimely fig.

3654.def:
adverb from 3650; completely, i.e. altogether; (by analogy),
everywhere; (negatively) not by any means:--at all, commonly, utterly.

3655.def: of uncertain affinity; a thunder storm:--shower.

3656.def:
from 3658; to be in company with, i.e. (by implication) to
converse:--commune, talk.

3658.def:
from the base of 3674 and a derivative of the alternate of 138
(meaning a crowd); association together, i.e. a multitude:--company.

3659.def: from 3700; a sight, i.e. (by implication) the eye:--eye.

3660.def:
but obsolete omo, for which
another prolonged form
omoo om-o'-o is used in certain tenses;

to swear, i.e. take (or declare on) oath:--swear.

3661.def:
adverb from a compound of the base of 3674 and 2372;
unanimously:--with one accord (mind).

3663.def:
from 3664 and the alternate of 3958; similarly affected:--of (subject
to) like passions.

3664.def:
from the base of 3674; similar (in appearance or character):--like, +
manner.

3666.def:
from 3664; to assimilate, i.e. compare; passively, to become
similar:--be (make) like, (in the) liken(-ess), resemble.

3667.def:
from 3666; a form; abstractly, resemblance:--made like to, likeness,
shape, similitude.

3670.def:
from a compound of the base of 3674 and 3056; to assent, i.e.
covenant, acknowledge:--con- (pro-)fess, confession is made, give
thanks, promise.

3671.def: from the same as 3670; acknowledgment:--con- (pro-)fession, professed.

3672.def:
adverb of present passive participle of 3670; confessedly:--without
controversy.

3673.def:
from the base of 3674 and 5078; a fellow-artificer:--of the same
craft.

3674.def:
genitive case of homos (the same; akin to 260) as adverb; at the same
place or time:--together.

3675.def:
from the base of 3674 and 5424; like-minded, i.e. harmonious:--of one
mind.

3676.def:
adverb from the base of 3674; at the same time, i.e. (conjunctionally)
notwithstanding, yet still:--and even, nevertheless, though but.

3678.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of 3688; a little ass:--young ass.

3679.def:
from 3681; to defame, i.e. rail at, chide, taunt:--cast in teeth,
(suffer) reproach, revile, upbraid.

3681.def:
probably akin to the base of 3686; notoriety, i.e. a taunt
(disgrace):--reproach.

3683.def:
from a derivative of 3685 and 5411; profit-bearer; Onesiphorus, a
Christian:--Onespiphorus.

3684.def:
from 3688; belonging to a ass, i.e. large (so as to be turned by a
ass):--millstone.

3685.def:
a prolonged form of an apparently primary verb (onomai, to slur);
for which another prolonged form (onao) is used as an alternate in
some tenses (unless indeed it be identical with the base of 3686
through the idea of notoriety); to gratify, i.e. (middle voice) to
derive pleasure or advantage from:--have joy.

3686.def:
from a presumed derivative of the base of 1097 (compare 3685); a
"name" (literally or figuratively) (authority, character):--called, (+
sur-)name(-d).

3687.def:
from 3686; to name, i.e. assign an appellation; by extension, to
utter, mention, profess:--call, name.

3688.def: apparently a primary word; a donkey:--an ass.

3689.def:
adverb of the oblique cases of 5607; really:--certainly, clean,
indeed, of a truth, verily.

3691.def:
probably akin to the base of 188 ("acid"); keen; by analogy,
rapid:--sharp, swift.

3692.def:
probably from 3700; a hole (as if for light), i.e. cavern; by analogy,
a spring (of water):--cave, place.

3693.def:
from opis (regard; from 3700) with enclitic of source; from the rear
(as a secure aspect), i.e. at the back (adverb and preposition of
place or time):--after, backside, behind.

3694.def:
from the same as 3693 with enclitic of direction; to the back, i.e.
aback (as adverb or preposition of time or place; or as noun):--after,
back(-ward), (+ get) behind, + follow.

3695.def:
from 3696; to equip (with weapons (middle voice and
figuratively)):--arm self.

3696.def:
probably from a primary hepo (to be busy about); an implement or
utensil or tool (literally or figuratively, especially, offensive for
war):--armour, instrument, weapon.

3698.def:
from 3739 and 4218; what(-ever) then, i.e. (of time) as soon
as:--when.

3699.def:
from 3739 and 4225; what(-ever) where, i.e. at whichever spot:--in
what place, where(-as, -soever), whither (+ soever).

3700.def:
of the primary (middle voice)
optomai op'-tom-ahee; which is used for it in certain
tenses; and both as alternate of
3708

to gaze (i.e. with wide-open eyes, as at something remarkable; and
thus differing from 991, which denotes simply voluntary observation;
and from 1492, which expresses merely mechanical, passive or casual
vision; while 2300, and still more emphatically its intensive 2334,
signifies an earnest but more continued inspection; and 4648 a
watching from a distance):--appear, look, see, shew self.

3701.def:
from a presumed derivative of 3700; visuality, i.e. (concretely) an
apparition:--vision.

3702.def:
from an obsolete verb akin to hepso (to "steep"); cooked, i.e.
roasted:--broiled.

3703.def:
apparently from the base of 3796 and 5610; properly, even-tide of the
(summer) season (dog-days), i.e. (by implication) ripe fruit:--fruit.

3704.def:
from 3739 and 4459; what(-ever) how, i.e. in the manner that (as
adverb or conjunction of coincidence, intentional or
actual):--because, how, (so) that, to, when.

3705.def:
from 3708; something gazed at, i.e. a spectacle (especially
supernatural):--sight, vision.

3706.def:
from 3708; the act of gazing, i.e. (externally) an aspect or
(internally) an inspired appearance:--sight, vision.

3707.def:
from 3708; gazed at, i.e. (by implication) capable of being
seen:--visible.

3708.def:
properly, to stare at (compare 3700), i.e. (by implication) to discern
clearly (physically or mentally); by extension, to attend to; by
Hebraism, to experience; passively, to appear:--behold, perceive, see,
take heed.

3709.def:
from 3713; properly, desire (as a reaching forth or excitement of the
mind), i.e. (by analogy), violent passion (ire, or (justifiable)
abhorrence); by implication punishment:--anger, indignation,
vengeance, wrath.

3710.def:
from 3709; to provoke or enrage, i.e. (passively) become
exasperated:--be angry (wroth).

3712.def: from 3713; a stretch of the arms, i.e. a fathom:--fathom.

3713.def:
middle voice of apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary
(compare 3735); to stretch oneself, i.e. reach out after (long
for):--covet after, desire.

3714.def:
from 3735; mountainous, i.e. (feminine by implication, of 5561) the
Highlands (of Judaea):--hill country.

3715.def: from 3713; excitement of the mind, i.e. longing after:--lust.

3716.def:
from a compound of 3717 and 4228; to be straight-footed, i.e.
(figuratively) to go directly forward:--walk uprightly.

3717.def:
probably from the base of 3735; right (as rising), i.e.
(perpendicularly) erect (figuratively, honest), or (horizontally)
level or direct:--straight, upright.

3719.def:
from 3722; to use the dawn, i.e. (by implication) to repair
betimes:--come early in the morning.

3722.def:
from the same as 3735; dawn (as sun-rise, rising of light); by
extension, morn:--early in the morning.

3723.def:
adverb from 3717; in a straight manner, i.e. (figuratively) correctly
(also morally):--plain, right(-ly).

3724.def:
from 3725; to mark out or bound ("horizon"), i.e. (figuratively) to
appoint, decree, specify:--declare, determine, limit, ordain.

3725.def:
neuter of a derivative of an apparently primary horos (a bound or
limit); a boundary-line, i.e. (by implication) a frontier
(region):--border, coast.

3726.def:
from 3727; to put on oath, i.e. make swear; by analogy, to solemnly
enjoin:--adjure, charge.

3727.def:
from herkos (a fence; perhaps akin to 3725); a limit, i.e. (sacred)
restraint (specially, an oath):--oath.

3728.def:
from a compound of 3727 and a derivative of 3660; asseveration on
oath:--oath.

3729.def:
from 3730; to start, spur or urge on, i.e. (reflexively) to dash or
plunge:--run (violently), rush.

3730.def: of uncertain affinity; a violent impulse, i.e. onset:--assault.

3732.def: neuter of a presumed derivative of 3733; a birdling:--bird, fowl.

3733.def:
probably from a prolonged form of the base of 3735; a bird (as rising
in the air), i.e. (specially), a hen (or female domestic fowl):--hen.

3734.def:
from a compound of the base of 3725 and a derivative of 5087; a
limit-placing, i.e. (concretely) boundary-line:--bound.

3736.def: apparently a primary verb; to "burrow" in the ground, i.e. dig:--dig.

3737.def:
of uncertain affinity; bereaved ("orphan"), i.e.

3969.def:
perhaps a contraction for Patrobios (a compound of 3962 and 979);
father's life; Patrobas, a Christian:--Patrobas.

3970.def:
from 3962 and a derivative of 3860 (in the sense of handing over or
down); traditionary:--received by tradition from fathers.

3972.def:
of Latin origin; (little; but remotely from a derivative of 3973,
meaning the same); Paulus, the name of a Roman and of an
apostle:--Paul, Paulus.

3973.def:
a primary verb ("pause"); to stop (transitively or intransitively),
i.e. restrain, quit, desist, come to an end:--cease, leave, refrain.

3974.def: of uncertain derivation; Paphus, a place in Cyprus:--Paphos.

3975.def:
from a derivative of 4078 (meaning thick); to thicken, i.e. (by
implication) to fatten (figuratively, stupefy or render callous):--wax
gross.

3976.def: ultimately from 4228; a shackle for the feet:--fetter.

3977.def:
from a derivative of 4228 (meaning the ground); level (as easy for the
feet):--plain.

3978.def:
from the same as 3979; to foot a journey, i.e. travel by land:--go
afoot.

3979.def:
dative case feminine of a derivative of 4228 (as adverb); foot-wise,
i.e. by walking:--a- (on) foot.

3980.def:
from a compound of 3982 and 757; to be persuaded by a ruler, i.e.
(genitive case) to submit to authority; by analogy, to conform to
advice:--hearken, obey (magistrates).

3982.def:
a primary verb; to convince (by argument, true or false); by analogy,
to pacify or conciliate (by other fair means); reflexively or
passively, to assent (to evidence or authority), to rely (by inward
certainty):--agree, assure, believe, have confidence, be (wax)
conflent, make friend, obey, persuade, trust, yield.

3983.def:
from the same as 3993 (through the idea of pinching toil; "pine"); to
famish (absolutely or comparatively); figuratively, to crave:--be an
hungered.

3984.def:
from the base of 4008 (through the idea of piercing); a test, i.e.
attempt, experience:--assaying, trial.

3985.def:
from 3984; to test (objectively), i.e. endeavor, scrutinize, entice,
discipline:--assay, examine, go about, prove, tempt(-er), try.

3986.def:
from 3985; a putting to proof (by experiment (of good), experience (of
evil), solicitation, discipline or provocation); by implication,
adversity:--temptation, X try.

3987.def:
from 3984; to test (subjectively), i.e. (reflexively) to
attempt:--assay.

3988.def:
from a presumed derivative of 3982; persuadableness, i.e.
credulity:--persuasion.

3989.def: of uncertain affinity; deep or open sea, i.e. the main:--depth, sea.

3990.def:
from a derivative of 4141 (meaning an axe); to chop off (the head),
i.e. truncate:--behead.

3992.def:
apparently a primary verb; to dispatch (from the subjective view or
point of departure, whereas hiemi (as a stronger form of eimi) refers
rather to the objective point or terminus ad quem, and 4724 denotes
properly, the orderly motion involved), especially on a temporary
errand; also to transmit, bestow, or wield:--send, thrust in.

3993.def:
from a primary peno (to toil for daily subsistence); starving, i.e.
indigent:--poor. Compare 4434.

3994.def: feminine of 3995; a wife's mother:--mother in law, wife's mother.

3995.def: of uncertain affinity; a wife's father:--father in law.

3996.def: from 3997; to grieve (the feeling or the act):--mourn, (be-)wail.

3997.def: strengthened from the alternate of 3958; grief:--mourning, sorrow.

3998.def: prolongation from the base of 3993; necessitous:--poor.

3999.def: multiplicative adverb from 4002; five times:--five times.

4000.def: from 3999 and 5507; five times a thousand:--five thousand.

4003.def: from 4002 and 2532 and 1182; five and tenth:--fifteenth.

4005.def:
feminine of the ordinal of 4004; fiftieth (2250 being implied) from
Passover, i.e. the festival of "Pentecost":--Pentecost.

4006.def:
from the perfect of the alternate of 3958; reliance:--confidence,
trust.

4007.def:
from the base of 4008; an enclitic particle significant of abundance
(thoroughness), i.e. emphasis; much, very or ever:--(whom-)soever.

4008.def:
apparently accusative case of an obsolete derivative of peiro (to
"pierce"); through (as adverb or preposition), i.e. across:--beyond,
farther (other) side, over.

4009.def: from the same as 4008; an extremity:--end, ut-(ter-)most participle

4010.def: from 4444; fortified; Pergamus, a place in Asia Minor:--Pergamos.

4011.def:
probably from the same as 4010; a tower; Perga, a place in Asia
Minor:--Perga.

4012.def:
from the base of 4008; properly, through (all over), i.e. around;
figuratively with respect to; used in various applications, of place,
cause or time (with the genitive case denoting the subject or occasion
or superlative point; with the accusative case the locality, circuit,
matter, circumstance or general period):--(there-)about, above,
against, at, on behalf of, X and his company, which concern, (as)
concerning, for, X how it will go with, ((there-, where-)) of, on,
over, pertaining (to), for sake, X (e-)state, (as) touching,
(where-)by (in), with. In comparative, it retains substantially the
same meaning of circuit (around), excess (beyond), or completeness
(through).

4013.def:
from 4012 and 71; to take around (as a companion); reflexively, to
walk around:--compass, go (round) about, lead about.

4015.def:
from 4012 and 797; to flash all around, i.e. envelop in light:--shine
round (about).

4016.def:
from 4012 and 906; to throw all around, i.e. invest (with a palisade
or with clothing):--array, cast about, clothe(-d me), put on.

4017.def: from 4012 and 991; to look all around:--look (round) about (on).

4018.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 4016; something thrown around one,
i.e. a mantle, veil:--covering, vesture.

4019.def:
4012 and 1210; to bind around one, i.e. enwrap:--bind
about.

4020.def:
from 4012 and 2038; to work all around, i.e. bustle about
(meddle):--be a busybody.

4021.def:
from 4012 and 2041; working all around, i.e. officious (meddlesome,
neuter plural magic):--busybody, curious arts.

4022.def:
from 4012 and 2064 (including its alternate); to come all around, i.e.
stroll, vacillate, veer:--fetch a compass, vagabond, wandering about.

4023.def:
from 4012 and 2192; to hold all around, i.e. include, clasp
(figuratively):--+ astonished, contain, after (this manner).

4025.def:
from 4060; a putting all around, i.e. decorating oneself
with:--wearing.

4026.def:
from 4012 and 2476; to stand all around, i.e. (near) to be a
bystander, or (aloof) to keep away from:--avoid, shun, stand by (round
about).

4027.def:
from a compound of 4012 and 2508; something cleaned off all around,
i.e. refuse (figuratively):--filth.

4028.def:
from 4012 and 2572; to cover all around, i.e. entirely (the face, a
surface):--blindfold, cover, overlay.

4029.def:
from 4012 and 2749; to lie all around, i.e. inclose, encircle, hamper
(literally or figuratively):--be bound (compassed) with, hang about.

4030.def:
feminine of a compound of 4012 and 2776; encirclement of the head,
i.e. a helmet:--helmet.

4031.def:
from 4012 and 2904; strong all around, i.e. a master (manager):--+
come by.

4032.def: from 4012 and 2928; to conceal all around, i.e. entirely:--hide.

4033.def:
from 4012 and 2944; to encircle all around, i.e. blockade
completely:--compass round.

4034.def:
from 4012 and 2989; to illuminate all around, i.e. invest with a
halo:--shine round about.

4035.def:
from 4012 and 3007; to leave all around, i.e. (passively)
survive:--remain.

4036.def:
from 4012 and 3077; grieved all around, i.e. intensely sad:--exceeding
(very) sorry(-owful).

4037.def: from 4012 and 3306; to stay around, i.e. await:--wait for.

4038.def:
adverb from 4012; all around, i.e. (as an adjective)
circumjacent:--round about.

4039.def:
from 4012 and 3611; to reside around, i.e. be a neighbor:--dwell round
about.

4040.def:
from 4012 and 3624; housed around, i.e. neighboring (used elliptically
as a noun):--neighbour.

4041.def:
from the present participle feminine of a compound of 4012 and 1510;
being beyond usual, i.e. special (one's own):--peculiar.

4042.def:
from 4023; a being held around, i.e. (concretely) a passage (of
Scripture, as circumscribed):--place.

4043.def:
from 4012 and 3961; to tread all around, i.e. walk at large
(especially as proof of ability); figuratively, to live, deport
oneself, follow (as a companion or votary):--go, be occupied with,
walk (about).

4044.def:
from 4012 and the base of 4008; to penetrate entirely, i.e. transfix
(figuratively):--pierce through.

4045.def:
from 4012 and 4098; to fall into something that is all around, i.e.
light among or upon, be surrounded with:--fall among (into).

4046.def:
middle voice from 4012 and 4160; to make around oneself, i.e. acquire
(buy):--purchase.

4047.def:
from 4046; acquisition (the act or the thing); by extension,
preservation:--obtain(-ing), peculiar, purchased, possession, saving.

4048.def:
from 4012 and 4486; to tear all around, i.e. completely away:--rend
off.

4049.def:
from 4012 and 4685; to drag all around, i.e. (figuratively) to
distract (with care):--cumber.

4051.def:
from 4052; a surplus, or superabundance:--abundance, that was left,
over and above.

4052.def:
from 4053; to superabound (in quantity or quality), be in excess, be
superfluous; also (transitively) to cause to superabound or
excel:--(make, more) abound, (have, have more) abundance (be more)
abundant, be the better, enough and to spare, exceed, excel, increase,
be left, redound, remain (over and above).

4053.def:
from 4012 (in the sense of beyond); superabundant (in quantity) or
superior (in quality); by implication, excessive; adverbially (with
1537) violently; neuter (as noun) preeminence:--exceeding abundantly
above, more abundantly, advantage, exceedingly, very highly, beyond
measure, more, superfluous, vehement(-ly).

4055.def:
comparative of 4053; more superabundant (in number, degree or
character):--more abundant, greater (much) more, overmuch.

4057.def:
adverb from 4053; superabundantly:--exceedingly, out of measure, the
more.

4058.def: of uncertain derivation; a pigeon:--dove, pigeon.

4059.def:
from 4012 and the base of 5114; to cut around, i.e. (specially) to
circumcise:--circumcise.

4060.def:
from 4012 and 5087; to place around; by implication, to
present:--bestow upon, hedge round about, put about (on, upon), set
about.

4061.def:
from 4059; circumcision (the rite, the condition or the people,
literally or figuratively):--X circumcised, circumcision.

4062.def:
from 4012 and the base of 5157; to turn around, i.e. (mentally) to
craze:--+ make mad.

4063.def:
from 4012 and 5143 (including its alternate); to run around, i.e.
traverse:--run through.

4064.def:
from 4012 and 5342; to convey around, i.e. transport hither and
thither:--bear (carry) about.

4065.def:
from 4012 and 5426; to think beyond, i.e. depreciate
(contemn):--despise.

4067.def:
from a comparative of 4012 and psao (to rub); something brushed all
around, i.e. off-scrapings (figuratively, scum):--offscouring.

4068.def:
middle voice from perperos (braggart; perhaps by reduplication of the
base of 4008); to boast:--vaunt itself.

4069.def: a Persian woman; Persis, a Christian female:--Persis.

4070.def:
adverb from 4009; the by-gone, i.e. (as noun) last year:--+ a year
ago.

4071.def:
neuter of a derivative of 4072; a flying animal, i.e. bird:--bird,
fowl.

4072.def:
petaomai pet-ah'-om-ahee, or contracted
ptaomai ptah'-om-ahee

middle voice of a primary verb; to fly:--fly(-ing).

4073.def:
feminine of the same as 4074; a (mass of) rock (literally or
figuratively):--rock.

4074.def:
apparently a primary word; a (piece of) rock (larger than 3037); as a
name, Petrus, an apostle:--Peter, rock. Compare 2786.

4076.def: from 4078; rue (from its thick or fleshy leaves):--rue.

4077.def:
probably from 4078 (through the idea of gushing plumply); a fount
(literally or figuratively), i.e. source or supply (of water, blood,
enjoyment) (not necessarily the original spring):--fountain, well.

4078.def:
a prolonged form of a primary verb (which in its simpler form occurs
only as an alternate in certain tenses); to fix ("peg"), i.e.
(specially) to set up (a tent):--pitch.

4079.def:
neuter of a (presumed) derivative of pedon (the blade of an oar; from
the same as 3976); a "pedal", i.e. helm:--rudder.

4080.def:
a quantitative form (the feminine) of the base of 4225; how much (as
an indefinite), i.e. in size or (figuratively) dignity:--how great
(large).

4082.def: of uncertain affinity; a wallet or leather pouch for food:--scrip.

4083.def:
of uncertain affinity; the fore-arm, i.e. (as a measure) a
cubit:--cubit.

4084.def:
probably another form of 971; to squeeze, i.e. seize (gently by the
hand (press), or officially (arrest), or in hunting
(capture)):--apprehend, catch, lay hand on, take. Compare 4085.

4085.def: another form for 4084; to pack:--press down.

4086.def:
from a compound of a derivative of 3982 and 3056; persuasive
language:--enticing words.

4087.def: from 4089; to embitter (literally or figuratively):--be (make) bitter.

4088.def:
from 4089; acridity (especially poison), literally or
figuratively:--bitterness.

4089.def:
perhaps from 4078 (through the idea of piercing); sharp (pungent),
i.e. acrid (literally or figuratively):--bitter.

4091.def: of Latin origin; close-pressed, i.e. firm; Pilatus, a Roman:--Pilate.

4092.def:
primary preo preh'-o which occurs only as an alternate in certain
tenses); to fire, i.e. burn (figuratively and passively, become
inflamed with fever):--be (X should have) swollen.

4093.def: diminutive of 4094; a tablet (for writing on):--writing table.

4094.def: apparently a form of 4109; a plate:--charger, platter.

4095.def:
pio pee'-o, which (together with another form)
poo po'-o

occurs only as an alternate in certain tenses; to imbibe (literally or
figuratively):--drink.

4096.def:
from pion (fat; perhaps akin to the alternate of 4095 through the idea
of repletion); plumpness, i.e. (by implication) richness
(oiliness):--fatness.

4097.def:
prao prah'-o; (which occurs only as an alternate in
certain tenses)

contracted from perao (to traverse; from the base of 4008); to traffic
(by travelling), i.e. dispose of as merchandise or into slavery
(literally or figuratively):--sell.

4098.def:
peto pet'-o; (which occurs only as an alternate in certain
tenses);

probably akin to 4072 through the idea of alighting; to fall
(literally or figuratively):--fail, fall (down), light on.

4099.def: probably of foreign origin; Pisidia, a region of Asia Minor:--Pisidia.

4100.def:
from 4102; to have faith (in, upon, or with respect to, a person or
thing), i.e. credit; by implication, to entrust (especially one's
spiritual well-being to Christ):--believe(-r), commit (to trust), put
in trust with.

4102.def:
from 3982; persuasion, i.e. credence; moral conviction (of religious
truth, or the truthfulness of God or a religious teacher), especially
reliance upon Christ for salvation; abstractly, constancy in such
profession; by extension, the system of religious (Gospel) truth
itself:--assurance, belief, believe, faith, fidelity.

4103.def:
from 3982; objectively, trustworthy; subjectively,
trustful:--believe(-ing, -r), faithful(-ly), sure, true.

4105.def:
from 4106; to (properly, cause to) roam (from safety, truth, or
virtue):--go astray, deceive, err, seduce, wander, be out of the way.

4107.def:
from 4108; a rover ("planet"), i.e. (figuratively) an erratic
teacher:--wandering.

4108.def:
of uncertain affinity; roving (as a tramp), i.e. (by implication) an
impostor or misleader; --deceiver, seducing.

4109.def:
from 4111; a moulding-board, i.e. flat surface ("plate", or tablet,
literally or figuratively):--table.

4111.def: a primary verb; to mould, i.e. shape or fabricate:--form.

4112.def:
from 4111; moulded, i.e. (by implication) artificial or (figuratively)
fictitious (false):--feigned.

4113.def: feminine of 4116; a wide "plat" or "place", i.e. open square:--street.

4115.def: from 4116; to widen (literally or figuratively):--make broad, enlarge.

4119.def:
pleion pli'-on, or
pleon pleh'-on

comparative of 4183; more in quantity, number, or quality; also (in
plural) the major portion:--X above, + exceed, more excellent,
further, (very) great(-er), long(-er), (very) many, greater (more)
part, + yet but.

4120.def: a primary word; to twine or braid:--plait.

4121.def:
from 4119; to do, make or be more, i.e. increase (transitively or
intransitively); by extension, to superabound:--abound, abundant, make
to increase, have over.

4122.def:
from 4123; to be covetous, i.e. (by implication) to over-reach:--get
an advantage, defraud, make a gain.

4123.def:
from 4119 and 2192; holding (desiring) more, i.e. eager for gain
(avaricious, hence a defrauder):--covetous.

4124.def:
from 4123; avarice, i.e. (by implication) fraudulency,
extortion:--covetous(-ness) practices, greediness.

4125.def: of uncertain affinity; a rib, i.e. (by extension) side:--side.

4126.def:
pleuo plyoo'-o; which is used as an alternate in certain
tenses;

probably a form of 4150 (through the idea of plunging through the
water); to pass in a vessel:--sail. See also 4130.

4127.def:
from 4141; a stroke; by implication, a wound; figuratively, a
calamity:--plague, stripe, wound(-ed).

4128.def:
from 4130; a fulness, i.e. a large number, throng, populace:--bundle,
company, multitude.

4129.def:
from another form of 4128; to increase (transitively or
intransitively):--abound, multiply.

4130.def:
pleo pleh'-o (which appears only as an alternate in
certain tenses and in the reduplicated form
pimplemi)

to "fill" (literally or figuratively (imbue, influence, supply));
specially, to fulfil (time):--accomplish, full (...come), furnish.

4132.def: prolonged from 4130; flood-tide, i.e. (by analogy) a freshet:--flood.

4133.def:
from 4119; moreover (besides), i.e. albeit, save that, rather,
yet:--but (rather), except, nevertheless, notwithstanding, save, than.

4134.def: from 4130; replete, or covered over; by analogy, complete:--full.

4135.def:
from 4134 and 5409; to carry out fully (in evidence), i.e. completely
assure (or convince), entirely accomplish:--most surely believe, fully
know (persuade), make full proof of.

4137.def:
from 4134; to make replete, i.e. (literally) to cram (a net), level up
(a hollow), or (figuratively) to furnish (or imbue, diffuse,
influence), satisfy, execute (an office), finish (a period or task),
verify (or coincide with a prediction), etc.:--accomplish, X after,
(be) complete, end, expire, fill (up), fulfil, (be, make) full (come),
fully preach, perfect, supply.

4138.def:
from 4137; repletion or completion, i.e. (subjectively) what fills (as
contents, supplement, copiousness, multitude), or (objectively) what
is filled (as container, performance, period):--which is put in to
fill up, piece that filled up, fulfilling, full, fulness.

4139.def:
neuter of a derivative of pelas (near); (adverbially) close by; as
noun, a neighbor, i.e. fellow (as man, countryman, Christian or
friend):--near, neighbour.

4140.def:
from a presumed derivative of 4130; a filling up, i.e. (figuratively)
gratification:--satisfying.

4142.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 4143; a boat:--boat, little (small)
ship.

4144.def: from 4126; a sail, i.e. navigation:--course, sailing, voyage.

4147.def:
from 4148; to be (or become) wealthy (literally or figuratively):--be
increased with goods, (be made, wax) rich.

4150.def:
a prolonged form of an obsolete pluo (to "flow"); to "plunge", i.e.
launder clothing:--wash. Compare 3068, 3538.

4151.def:
from 4154; a current of air, i.e. breath (blast) or a breeze; by
analogy or figuratively, a spirit, i.e. (human) the rational soul, (by
implication) vital principle, mental disposition, etc., or
(superhuman) an angel, demon, or (divine) God, Christ's spirit, the
Holy Spirit:--ghost, life, spirit(-ual, -ually), mind. Compare 5590.

4153.def:
adverb from 4152; non-physically, i.e. divinely,
figuratively:--spiritually.

4154.def: a primary word; to breathe hard, i.e. breeze:--blow. Compare 5594.

4155.def:
strengthened from 4154; to wheeze, i.e. (causative, by implication) to
throttle or strangle (drown):--choke, take by the throat.

4156.def:
from 4155; throttled, i.e. (neuter concretely) an animal choked to
death (not bled):--strangled.

4158.def:
from 4228 and another element of uncertain affinity; a dress (2066
implied) reaching the ankles:--garment down to the foot.

4159.def:
from the base of 4213 with enclitic adverb of origin; from which (as
interrogative) or what (as relative) place, state, source or
cause:--whence.

4160.def:
apparently a prolonged form of an obsolete primary; to make or do (in
a very wide application, more or less direct):--abide, + agree,
appoint, X avenge, + band together, be, bear, + bewray, bring (forth),
cast out, cause, commit, + content, continue, deal, + without any
delay, (would) do(-ing), execute, exercise, fulfil, gain, give, have,
hold, X journeying, keep, + lay wait, + lighten the ship, make, X
mean, + none of these things move me, observe, ordain, perform,
provide, + have purged, purpose, put, + raising up, X secure, shew, X
shoot out, spend, take, tarry, + transgress the law, work, yield.
Compare 4238.

4161.def:
from 4160; a product, i.e. fabric (literally or figuratively):--thing
that is made, workmanship.

4162.def: from 4160; action, i.e. performance (of the law):--deed.

4163.def: from 4160; a performer; specially, a "poet"; --doer, poet.

4164.def:
of uncertain derivation; motley, i.e. various in character:--divers,
manifold.

4165.def:
from 4166; to tend as a shepherd of (figuratively, superviser):--feed
(cattle), rule.

4166.def:
of uncertain affinity; a shepherd (literally or
figuratively):--shepherd, pastor.

4167.def:
contraction from 4165; a flock (literally or figuratively):--flock,
fold.

4168.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 4167; a flock, i.e. (figuratively)
group (of believers):--flock.

4169.def:
from the base of 4226 and 3634; individualizing interrogative (of
character) what sort of, or (of number) which one:--what (manner of),
which.

4170.def:
from 4171; to be (engaged) in warfare, i.e. to battle (literally or
figuratively): -fight, (make) war.

4171.def:
from pelomai (to bustle); warfare (literally or figuratively; a single
encounter or a series):--battle, fight, war.

4172.def:
probably from the same as 4171, or perhaps from 4183; a town
(properly, with walls, of greater or less size):--city.

4173.def:
from 4172 and 757; a town-officer, i.e. magistrate:--ruler of the
city.

4174.def:
from 4177 ("polity"); citizenship; concretely, a
community:--commonwealth, freedom.

4176.def:
middle voice of a derivative of 4177; to behave as a citizen
(figuratively):--let conversation be, live.

4178.def:
multiplicative adverb from 4183; many times, i.e.
frequently:--oft(-en, -entimes, -times).

4179.def:
from 4183 and probably a derivative of 4120; manifold, i.e. (neuter as
noun) very much more:--manifold more.

4181.def:
adverb from a compound of 4183 and 3313; in many portions, i.e.
variously as to time and agency (piecemeal):--at sundry times.

4182.def: from 4183 and 4164; much variegated, i.e. multifarious:--manifold.

4185.def:
from 4183 and 5056; extremely expensive:--costly, very precious, of
great price.

4186.def: from 4183 and 5092; extremely valuable:--very costly, of great price.

4187.def:
adverb from a compound of 4183 and 5158; in many ways, i.e. variously
as to method or form:--in divers manners.

4188.def: from the alternate of 4095; a beverage:--drink.

4189.def:
from 4190; depravity, i.e. (specially), malice; plural (concretely)
plots, sins:--iniquity, wickedness.

4190.def:
from a derivative of 4192; hurtful, i.e. evil (properly, in effect or
influence, and thus differing from 2556, which refers rather to
essential character, as well as from 4550, which indicates degeneracy
from original virtue); figuratively, calamitous; also (passively) ill,
i.e. diseased; but especially (morally) culpable, i.e. derelict,
vicious, facinorous; neuter (singular) mischief, malice, or (plural)
guilt; masculine (singular) the devil, or (plural) sinners:--bad,
evil, grievous, harm, lewd, malicious, wicked(-ness). See also 4191.

4193.def: from 4195; a Pontican, i.e. native of Pontus:--born in Pontus.

4194.def: of Latin origin; apparently bridged; Pontius, a Roman:--Pontius.

4195.def: a sea; Pontus, a region of Asia Minor:--Pontus.

4196.def:
of Latin origin; apparently "popular"; Poplius (i.e. Publius), a
Roman:--Publius.

4197.def:
from 4198; travel (by land); figuratively (plural) proceedings, i.e.
career:--journey(-ing), ways.

4198.def:
middle voice from a derivative of the same as 3984; to traverse, i.e.
travel (literally or figuratively; especially to remove (figuratively,
die), live, etc.); --depart, go (away, forth, one's way, up), (make a,
take a) journey, walk.

4199.def:
prolongation from pertho (to sack); to ravage
(figuratively):--destroy, waste.

4200.def:
from a derivative of poros (a way, i.e. means); furnishing
(procuring), i.e. (by implication) money-getting (acquisition):--gain.

4201.def: of Latin origin; apparently swinish; Porcius, a Roman:--Porcius.

4202.def:
from 4203; harlotry (including adultery and incest); figuratively,
idolatry:--fornication.

4203.def:
from 4204; to act the harlot, i.e. (literally) indulge unlawful lust
(of either sex), or (figuratively) practise idolatry:--commit
(fornication).

4204.def:
feminine of 4205; a strumpet; figuratively, an idolater:--harlot,
whore.

4205.def:
from pernemi (to sell; akin to the base of 4097); a (male) prostitute
(as venal), i.e. (by analogy) a debauchee (libertine):--fornicator,
whoremonger.

4206.def:
adverb from 4253; forwards, i.e. at a distance:--far, a great way off.
See also 4207.

4207.def:
from 4206 with adverbial enclitic of source; from far, or (by
implication) at a distance, i.e. distantly:--afar off.

4209.def:
of Latin origin; the "purple" mussel, i.e. (by implication) the
red-blue color itself, and finally a garment dyed with it:--purple.

4211.def:
feminine of a compound of 4209 and 4453; a female trader in purple
cloth:--seller of purple.

4212.def: multiplicative from 4214; how many times:--how oft(-en).

4213.def:
from the alternate of 4095; a drinking (the act), i.e. (concretely) a
draught:--drink.

4214.def:
from an absolute pos (who, what) and 3739; interrogative pronoun (of
amount) how much (large, long or (plural) many):--how great (long,
many), what.

4215.def:
probably from a derivative of the alternate of 4095 (compare 4224); a
current, brook or freshet (as drinkable), i.e. running water:--flood,
river, stream, water.

4216.def:
from 4215 and a derivative of 5409; river-borne, i.e. overwhelmed by a
stream:--carried away of the flood.

4217.def:
apparently from 4219 and the base of 4226; interrogatively, whatever,
i.e. of what possible sort:--what (manner of).

4219.def:
from the base of 4226 and 5037; interrogative adverb, at what time:--+
how long, when.

4222.def:
from a derivative of the alternate of 4095; to furnish drink,
irrigate:--give (make) to drink, feed, water.

4223.def:
of Latin origin; little wells, i.e. mineral springs; Potioli (i.e.
Puteoli), a place in Italy:--Puteoli.

4224.def: from the alternate of 4095; a drinking-bout or carousal:--banqueting.

4225.def:
genitive case of an indefinite pronoun pos (some) otherwise obsolete
(compare 4214); as adverb of place, somewhere, i.e. nearly:--about, a
certain place.

4226.def:
genitive case of an interrogative pronoun pos (what) otherwise
obsolete (perhaps the same as 4225 used with the rising slide of
inquiry); as adverb of place; at (by implication, to) what
locality:--where, whither.

4227.def: of Latin origin; modest; Pudes (i.e. Pudens), a Christian:--Pudens.

4228.def: a primary word; a "foot" (figuratively or literally):--foot(-stool).

4229.def:
from 4238; a deed; by implication, an affair; by extension, an object
(material):--business, matter, thing, work.

4231.def: from 4229; to busy oneself with, i.e. to trade:--occupy.

4232.def:
of Latin origin; the praetorium or governor's courtroom (sometimes
including the whole edifice and camp):--(common, judgment) hall (of
judgment), palace, praetorium.

4233.def:
from a derivative of 4238; a practiser, i.e. (specially), an official
collector:--officer.

4234.def:
from 4238; practice, i.e. (concretely) an act; by extension, a
function:--deed, office, work.

4235.def: a form of 4239, used in certain parts; gentle, i.e. humble:--meek.

4237.def:
perhaps from prason (a leek, and so an onion-patch); a garden plot,
i.e. (by implication, of regular beds) a row (repeated in plural by
Hebraism, to indicate an arrangement):--in ranks.

4238.def:
a primary verb; to "practise", i.e. perform repeatedly or habitually
(thus differing from 4160, which properly refers to a single act); by
implication, to execute, accomplish, etc.; specially, to collect
(dues), fare (personally):--commit, deeds, do, exact, keep, require,
use arts.

4239.def:
apparently a primary word; mild, i.e. (by implication) humble:--meek.
See also 4235.

4241.def:
apparently a primary verb; to tower up (be conspicuous), i.e. (by
implication) to be suitable or proper (third person singular present
indicative, often used impersonally, it is fit or right):--become,
comely.

4242.def:
from 4243; seniority (eldership), i.e. (by implication) an embassy
(concretely, ambassadors):--ambassage, message.

4243.def:
from the base of 4245; to be a senior, i.e. (by implication) act as a
representative (figuratively, preacher):--be an ambassador.

4244.def:
neuter of a presumed derivative of 4245; the order of elders, i.e.
(specially), Israelite Sanhedrin or Christian "presbytery":--(estate
of) elder(-s), presbytery.

4245.def:
comparative of presbus (elderly); older; as noun, a senior; specially,
an Israelite Sanhedrist (also figuratively, member of the celestial
council) or Christian "presbyter":-- elder(-est), old.

4246.def: from the same as 4245; an old man:--aged (man), old man.

4247.def: feminine of 4246; an old woman:--aged woman.

4248.def:
from 4253; leaning (falling) forward ("prone"), i.e. head
foremost:--headlong.

4249.def:
a strengthened form of a primary prio (to saw); to saw in two:--saw
asunder.

4251.def:
of Latin origin; feminine of Priscus, ancient; Priska, a Christian
woman:--Prisca. See also 4252.

4252.def:
diminutive of 4251; Priscilla (i.e. little Prisca), a Christian
woman:--Priscilla.

4253.def:
a primary preposition; "fore", i.e. in front of, prior (figuratively,
superior) to:--above, ago, before, or ever. In the comparative, it
retains the same significations.

4254.def:
from 4253 and 71; to lead forward (magisterially); intransitively, to
precede (in place or time (participle, previous)):--bring (forth,
out), go before.

4255.def:
from 4253 and 138; to choose for oneself before another thing
(prefer), i.e. (by implication) to propose (intend):--purpose.

4256.def:
from 4253 and a derivative of 156; to accuse already, i.e. previously
charge:--prove before.

4257.def: from 4253 and 191; to hear already,i.e. anticipate:--hear before.

4258.def:
from 4253 and 264; to sin previously (to conversion):--sin already,
heretofore sin.

4259.def:
neuter of a presumed compound of 4253 and 833; a forecourt, i.e.
vestibule (alley-way):--porch.

4260.def:
from 4253 and the base of 939; to walk forward, i.e. advance
(literally, or in years):--+ be of a great age, go farther (on), be
well stricken.

4261.def:
from 4253 and 906; to throw forward, i.e. push to the front,
germinate:--put forward, shoot forth.

4262.def:
from 4263; relating to sheep, i.e. (a gate) through which they were
led into Jerusalem:--sheep (market).

4263.def:
probably neuter of a presumed derivative of 4260; something that walks
forward (a quadruped), i.e. (specially), a sheep (literally or
figuratively):--sheep(-fold).

4264.def:
from 4253 and a reduplicated form of 971; to force forward, i.e. bring
to the front, instigate:--draw, before instruct.

4265.def:
from 4253 and 991; to look out beforehand, i.e. furnish in
advance:--provide.

4266.def:
from 4253 and 1096; to be already, i.e. have previousy transpired:--be
past.

4267.def:
from 4253 and 1097; to know beforehand, i.e. foresee:--foreknow
(ordain), know (before).

4271.def:
from 4253 and 1212; plain before all men, i.e. obvious:--evident,
manifest (open) beforehand.

4272.def:
from 4253 and 1325; to give before the other party has given:--first
give.

4273.def:
from 4272 (in the sense of giving forward into another's (the enemy's)
hands); a surrender:--betrayer, traitor.

4274.def:
from the alternate of 4390; a runner ahead, i.e. scout (figuratively,
precursor):--forerunner.

4276.def:
from 4253 and 1679; to hope in advance of other confirmation:--first
trust.

4279.def: middle voice from 4253 and 1861; to promise of old:--promise before.

4281.def:
from 4253 and 2064 (including its alternate); to go onward, precede
(in place or time):--go before (farther, forward), outgo, pass on.

4282.def:
from 4253 and 2090; to fit up in advance (literally or
figuratively):--ordain before, prepare afore.

4283.def:
middle voice from 4253 and 2097; to announce glad news in
advance:--preach before the gospel.

4284.def:
middle voice from 4253 and 2192; to hold oneself before others, i.e.
(figuratively) to excel:--be better.

4285.def:
from 4253 and 2233; to lead the way for others, i.e. show
deference:--prefer.

4287.def:
from 4253 and a derivative of 5087; fixed beforehand, i.e. (feminine
with 2250 implied) a designated day:--time appointed.

4288.def:
from 4289; predisposition, i.e. alacrity:--forwardness of mind,
readiness (of mind), ready (willing) mind.

4289.def:
from 4253 and 2372; forward in spirit, i.e. predisposed; neuter (as
noun) alacrity:--ready, willing.

4291.def:
from 4253 and 2476; to stand before, i.e. (in rank) to preside, or (by
implication) to practise:--maintain, be over, rule.

4292.def:
middle voice from 4253 and 2564; to call forth to oneself (challenge),
